[Sacrum Romanum: Crown and Cross] Season Update Log

[b]I. Seasonal Unit[/b]
[b]3- Star: Doppelsoldner[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/96f5ba6c57f57624b7192cda7c952df9ebeacc90.jpg[/img]
Unit Background
The Doppelsoldner are an elite infantry unit hailing from the ranks of mercenaries in the Holy Roman Empire during the late 15th and early 16th centuries. Named for the heavy two-handed swords they bore and the double wages they earned, these warriors fought on the very front lines, risking their lives for twice the pay of ordinary mercenaries. Founded by Emperor Maximilian I to counter the famed Swiss mercenaries, the unit was composed primarily of seasoned veterans. Their weapon—the flamberge two-handed greatsword—measured up to 180 centimeters in length and weighed over 3.5 kilograms, specially crafted and carried wrapped in leather for protection. It is said that these double-pay mercenaries wielded their immense swords to break through pike formations, particularly those of the Swiss. With mighty swings, they shattered spearheads or swept aside pikes, striking directly at the enemy and collapsing their ranks.
Unit Characteristics：
Imperial mercenaries with unique effects against specific enemies and in certain scenarios.
Masters of the two-handed greatsword, unleashing sweeping area damage with every swing.
Their battle song carries a silencing effect, disabling enemy skills within range.
Skill Design：
Skill 1: Windmill (Unleash a flurry of greatsword attacks)
Skill 2: Song of Landsknecht (Battle song silences enemies)

[b]4- Star: Zealot[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/10e39de2953724749f769f196ab6dcc3e53352da.png[/img]
Unit Background
They are the most faithful guardians of imperial creed, clad in Milanese plate with sigil shields and hammers of judgment. They hold the line like stone and purge heresy with crushing blows.
Yet years facing the dark have stained their souls with a touch of madness. When the heretics surge without cease, the guards' repressed bloodlust is loosed. They cast aside shields, tear of livery of order, and become inquisitors wielding great two‑handed mauls — each swing carrying the purging fire and sacred wrath.
Unit Characteristics：
Carnage on the field lays bare the Zealots' nature, increasing [Mad Malice]. Killing 3‑star‑and‑below units and other Heraldic units grants more [Mad Malice]. At max, transform into "Inquisitor".
The smooth, shell‑like plates can deflect blows, reducing damage taken by 18% and offering some fire resistance; the asymmetrical left pauldron provides superior protection for blocking when meeting the foe.
While transformed into "Inquisitors", they will anoint their weapon with black powder. Each strike burns the target and triggers a small blast
Skill Design：
Normal State
Skill 1: Righteous Charge – Launches a fearless charge toward the target location.
Skill 2: Zeal Whirlwind – Spins the sacred hammer around a pivot of faith, sweeping through foes.
Skill 3: Judgment Day – Takes on the aspect of the judge, purging all in divine fire!
Judge State
Skill 1: Dies iræ – Slams the holy hammer into the earth, unbalancing nearby enemies before sending them flying.
Skill 2: Saeclum in Favilla – Unleashes a flurry of holy hammer swings, each blow erupting in a cascade of small blasts.

[b]5- Star: Order of the Dragon[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/38c3ecf876af9068915779b6b2be9f97c7ec54cd.jpg[/img]
Unit Background
Drawn from the highest nobility and armored in plate etched with the ouroboros, they fight not for coin or fame — for their very being is the Empire's highest honor.
When the horns of expedition sound, their singular "Sacred Expedition" makes their charge dragon‑swift and deadly, rending lines thought unbreakable. Beneath the imperial banner, they are both arbiters of justice and bearers of blessed light.
Unit Characteristics：
An elite order of knights formed by monarchs and nobles from across the land. They answer only to the Emperor’s command, sworn to battle the enemies of the Empire.
When [Emperor's Expedition] is activated, you enter a special control mode where the Unit’s movement and abilities are directed by mouse.
Their masterfully crafted gilded armor not only marks their noble status but also offers formidable protection.
Skill Design：
Skill 1: Emperor’s Expedition – Enter a unique control mode: change your perspective and use the mouse to command Unit movement and unleash skills.
Skill 2: Sacred Verdict – Deliver swift justice with your sword; unleash a flurry of attacks to deal burst damage.
Skill 3: Blessing of Light – Remove continuous damage effects from yourself and restore health.

[b]II. Battle Pass[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ccc488d0e571cfb82fb7b9c41e88d4e41a14d2e7.jpg[/img]
During the "Sacrum Romanum" season, purchase the Battle Pass to unlock additional Battle Pass rewards.

[b]VIII. Season Fame[/b]
Fame Store
Fame of the Dynasty Awakening Season will be reset, and be replaced by Sacrum Romanum Fame for the Sacrum Romanum Season.
[Fame Store] rewards are as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/150edc04f7d48058084332c134073bf738e6de1d.jpg[/img]

Other Adjustment
[Field Battles] and [Ranked Battles] now grant Season Fame. The weekly Season Fame cap for all matchmaking modes is 1,500.

[b]IX. System Optimizations[/b]
New Player Experience Optimizations
This Season, our revamped new player flow will be available across all servers—freshly created characters can immediately experience the latest combat stages and personal tent.
The [Unit Training Camp] has been completely rebuilt, with more battle demonstrations and counter-play content added.
We’ve also introduced enhanced trigger-based tutorials: aspiring warlords will encounter context-aware tutorial pop-ups on the battlefield at just the right moment.
Some weapons now unlock [Specialisation] automatically and feature a trial function—access this via the bottom-right "Trial" button under [P] – [Specialisation].
The weapon and equipment panels now display armor compatibility information. Should you equip incompatible armor, a prompt will warn you before removal.
All matchmaking battle modes now include mouse-hover tooltips for added clarity.

Battlefield Replay Improvements
The [Battlefield Replay] function now supports player-created training scenarios: Talking to [Sheriff] in the [Capital] to craft custom combat stages, then review these battles under [ESC] – [Career] – [Battlefield Replay].

Unit Skill Tags Added
All [Units] skills now display relevant tags in the Barracks, Deployment, and Battle screens, providing clearer function at a glance. Note: In the battle interface, these skill tags may adjust the icons’ positions. If you’d like to restore their previous location, turn off [Show Unit Skill Tags in Battle] under [ESC] – [Settings] – [UI].

Territory War Optimizations
The World Fief info panel now features a rules overview—click the [Rules] button (bottom right) for gameplay explanations on Fief and Territory War mechanics. The rules section also now details how ownership is determined after battles conclude.
For Territory War, defending forces must now meet Prestige requirements on front regions within cities or forts. If a defending House's Alliance falls below the minimum Prestige in that region, its members will be unable to reinforce the frontline until battle ends. (The front itself will remain active.)

House Reputation Adjustments
The methods of acquiring [Reputation] have been updated: [Reputation] can now only be earned by completing Weekly House Challenge Quests. Additionally, higher House levels grant increased Reputation rewards and higher weekly caps.
The use of Reputation has also changed: it is now only consumed in the following cases:
Declaring War on a Fief. The required Reputation varies by Fief type and level.
Every Tuesday and Saturday at 22:00, Reputation will be deducted based on the number of Fiefs held—150 for each Fief.
If the Command House fails to open a Front within 3 minutes, 1,000 Reputation is deducted.
Minimum Reputation required to declare war now varies by Fief type and level.
A new Fief Reputation value has been added, indicating how much Reputation is currently in effect for each Fief. This value determines Front commanders for each Fief.
At the start of every Territory War, all Fiefs reset their Fief Reputation to equal the House's current Reputation.
When a House becomes Front commander for a Fief and fails in attack, Fief Reputation for that Fief will decrease by 20% (up to a maximum total reduction of 100%), but overall Reputation remains unchanged. Fief Reputation is reset after each Territory War.

Battlefield Score
To enhance in-battle feedback, a new [Battlefield Score] system has been introduced.
Players are now awarded real-time scores for various in-match actions.
You can press [Tab] during battle to view the score panel, where players are ranked by total score—higher scores grant higher rankings.

Battle Pass Experience Storage
The [Power Growth] bonus function of the [Battle Pass] has been improved.
50% of the bonus Glory earned from [Power Growth] will be stored in a special pool if you have not purchased the [Battle Pass].
After purchasing the [Battle Pass], all stored bonus experience will be granted at once, allowing you to receive the full [Power Growth] bonus no matter when you make your purchase during the Season.

Other Improvements
Increased maximum storage: The [Supply Dump] – [Personal Storage] can now be expanded by 80 additional slots.
Improved the UI for the new player sign-in event.
Raised the max stack size for several commonly used items and resources.
Added interaction: In your personal tent, clicking on a [Unit] model will trigger a special Unit interaction animation.

[b]X. Balance Adjustments[/b]
Bow Balance Adjustment

The Bow's weapon trait—“Dealing 36% more Armor Penetration to Units target, but 36% less to non-Units target”—has been removed.

Empire Chariot Balance Adjustment

Base Leadership reduced from 320 to 310

Current Health and Damage
When Health is between 80% and 100%, damage dealt is increased by 15%.
When Health is between 60% and 80%, damage dealt remains unchanged.
When Health is between 30% and 60%, damage dealt is reduced by 30%.
When Health is between 0% and 30%, damage dealt is reduced by 70%.

Instant Speed and Control Effects
When Instant Speed is ≥12, all types of Units and Heroes are affected by Knock Up.
When 12 > Instant Speed > minimum collision speed, the Knock Back effect only applies to Infantry Units. Heroes and Cavalry Units are no longer affected by additional control effects.
The impact damage effect during [Squall Edict] status is not included.
*If the corresponding Unit Training Node is activated, the minimum collision speed is set to 6.

“Instability” System
The Empire Chariot Instability System has been added:
Initial Instability Value is 0.
When the Empire Chariot receives damage from different Weapons, Instability Value varies according to Weapon type and skills:
Heavy Weapons inflict more Instability Value per hit, such as the Maul.
Melee Weapons inflict greater Instabilityty Value per hit than Ranged Weapons.
Weapons with combo damage or high-frequency attacks accumulate more Instability Value, such as Dual Blades.
All Ultimate Skills of Weapons inflict extremely high Instability Value, even if they do not have Knock Up effect.
Ambush and Accurate strike both grant additional single-hit Instability Value.
When all Units deal damage to the Empire Chariot, various Unit types and damage types will inflict extra Instability Value:
Melee Units generate greater Instability Value compared to Ranged Units.
Burning Damage causes higher Instability Value than other damage types.
Cavalry Units inflict higher Instability Value when dealing damage.
Chariot collisions result in extremely high Instability Value.
Ambush and Accurate strike both grant additional single-hit Instability Value.
Large Siege Artillery, such as Trebuchet, now inflict higher Instability Value damage. Player-deployed small Artillery will inflict varying Instability Value damage depending on the ammo type.
When the Empire Chariot’s Instability Value reaches its maximum, it will “Overturn”: the Chariot’s maximum speed reduces to 0; speed is decreased by 100% and this effect lasts for 8 seconds. The effect occurs even if the Chariot is not being controlled by a Hero.
If a Hero is controlling the Chariot at this moment, the Hero will be knocked off and will fall to the ground.
If there are allied Heroes from the same faction near the Chariot during “Overturn”, they will also receive the Knock Up effect due to the overturn.
After the “Overturn” effect ends (after 8 seconds), Instability Value resets, and all negative effects caused by the “Overturn” are removed. Instability Value accumulation starts again.
If maximum value is not reached, Instability Value will decrease over time.
Instability Value Recovery reduced by 25 points every 3 seconds

notes.title: August 21 Update Log
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Warlords!
We will conduct maintenance updates during the following time:
APAC: August 21, 14:00-18:00 (UTC+8).
EU/AMS: August 21, 7:00-11:00 (UTC+1).
The maintenance is expected to last for 4 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins *8000, Honor *400, and Unit Medal *20 as compensation.
Warlords, please arrange your playtime accordingly. The update will contain the following:

I. Events
1. The 6th Anniversary Faction Showdown Comes to End
Rewards Introduction:
After more than a month of fierce conflict, the 6th Anniversary Faction Showdown has drawn to its epic conclusion. In the clash between the mighty Terracotta Army and the formidable Grand Coalition, victory goes to the Terracotta Army! Both factions' warriors displayed remarkable tenacity and battle prowess, unlocking all six tiers of event rewards. Now it's time to honor your achievements!
All warriors who participated in the Faction Showdown can log in to claim their full six-tier rewards, including: Treatise*60, Anniversary Reward Box*60, Uncommon Scrolls of Mastery*600, Silver Keys*60, Discount Coupon (40% OFF)*1, exclusive Faction Avatar and other massive rewards! All these rich rewards are yours simply by logging in!
As the winning faction of the Showdown, every member of the Terracotta Army will also receive the exclusive "All Victorious" Title!
Missed out on the event? No need for regret — log in and you'll still receive a commemorative gift.
Raise a toast with your warriors and celebrate Conqueror's Blade's 6th Anniversary together!
How to Claim:
Click the \[Conqueror's Blade 6th Anniversary Event] button at the top of the main interface to claim your rewards.

2. Claim Generous Anniversary Rewards for Free!
Event Introduction:
Conqueror's Blade celebrates six glorious years with gratitude for every Warlord who has fought by our side!
Log in daily during the event and sign in to receive up to Treatise*50 and Illusionist Key*10!
Warlords who logged in between January 1, 2025, and August 22, 2025, can claim an additional special anniversary gift by logging in on August 23, which includes Treatise*10 and will be delivered via in-game mail by 24:00 on the same day.
Sign-In Event Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – September 19 (Before maintenance).
3. Limited-Time Free Doctrine Removal!
Event Introduction:
During the event, Doctrine Removal is free! Enjoy the fun of free combination！
Event Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – 0:00, August 28
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b3cacc0cd0dcaef964456bcd9dd8b7a9d87f3275.jpg"][/img]4. Limited-Time Attire Chest \[Evolving Divine Attires - Azure Dragon] Now Available — Upgradeable Hero Attire \[Azure Dragon] Debuts!
Clad in depths armor, awaken the soul of the dragon — you become the abyss itself!
Event Introduction:
During the event, the \[Azure Dragon] Hero Attire Chest will be available under \[Evolving Divine Attires] on the main interface. Spend an Illusionist Key to draw.
Event Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – September 19 (Before maintenance).
How to Obtain:
  (1) Obtain through the limited-time Attire Chest event \[Evolving Divine Attires].
  (2) Receive all components (Helm, Armour, Gauntlets, Boots) upon first acquisition.
How to Upgrade:
  (1) The initial Attire grade is Tier I; spend specific upgrade materials to increase Attire tier, up to Tier VI.
  (2) Attire starts at Epic quality and evolves to Legendary quality at Tier IV.
  (3) Attire appearance changes with each upgrade.
Upgrade Materials & Draw Item:
  Divine Soul: Obtained by automatically dismantling duplicate Upgradeable Attire acquired from the \[Evolving Divine Attires] event.
  Shattered Armor of Divinity: Obtained by automatically dismantling duplicate Non-upgradeable Attire acquired from the \[Evolving Divine Attires] event.
  Illusionist Key: Obtained through cumulative Sign-ins, Victory Pass, Honour Store exchanges, or by spending Sovereigns.
Special Upgrade Rewards:
Upgrade the \[Azure Dragon] Attire to receive exclusive rewards at certain tier:
  Tier IV: Exclusive Kills Announcer — \[Tidal Surge]
  Tier V: Exclusive Title — \[Between Cloud and Abyss]
  Tier VI: Exclusive Avatar Frame — \[Dragon's Dominion], Exclusive Emote — \[Parting of the Sea]
Probability Details:
  Upgradeable Hero Attire \[Azure Dragon]: 2.72%
  Epic Hero Attire: 10.7%
  Rare items (including rare Hero and Weapon Attire, and Shattered Armor of Divinity): 42.75%
  Uncommon Hero and Weapon Attire: 43.83%
  For detailed probabilities, you can visit \[Main Interface – Evolving Divine Attires] in-game.

  (1) After upgrading \[Azure Dragon] to Tier II \[Awaken], you can complete exclusive Attire achievements and unlock Avatars: Azure Dragon (male) / Abyssal Radiance (female).
  (2) \[Azure Dragon] attire features an exclusive background image in \[P] – \[Personalise] – \[Attire].

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/25df2f68faeadd98590678e6a53ce9a670006913.jpg"][/img]5. Brand-new Appearance System \[Illusion Orb] Arrives — Exclusive Illusion Orb \[Millennia of Vigil] for Halberd Elite!
Forged from the night pearls of the Qin Mausoleum, this artifact allows Halberd Elite to transform into terracotta warriors under special conditions, unleashing the awe of the ancient terracotta army.

Open an \[Anniversary Reward Box] for a chance to obtain this exclusive item.
How to Acquire \[Anniversary Reward Box]:
(1) Receive it for free through the 6th Anniversary Faction Showdown event.
(2) Earn it by exchanging anniversary event items gained from \[Siege Battles] and \[Return to Battlefield] mode.
(3) Purchase directly in the Store.

  Legendary-quality reward: 0.21%
  Epic-quality reward: 34.79%
  Rare-quality reward: 25%
  Uncommon-quality reward: 40%

6. New Anniversary PVE Mode — Return to Battlefield Released!
Event Introduction
Victory to Warlords! Have you yearned for a more exhilarating PVE challenge? The brand-new Anniversary PVE event has arrived!

Gameplay Rules Overview
Starting Leadership Limit: 300
You can earn Leadership by vanquishing foes, completing quests, and overcoming Altar challenges. Use your Leadership to purchase Units, unique Traits, and Artillery from the shop, or draw new Units from the Shrine.
Unit Deployment: Deploy any available Units, including your personal Units and Contracted Units.
Support Units: Level up within the battle to recruit additional Support Units.
Shrine: Spend Leadership to draw for Support Units at the Shrine.
Mystery Shop: Seek out these Mystery Shops hidden across the map and spend your Leadership to unlock wishing Units, Unit Traits, and massive Artillery. Each time the Shop is upgraded, the quality of goods increases!
Unit Development:
  (1) Purchase Unit Traits from the shop to permanently enhance attributes of Units you command. Forge your unique Unit Traits in this mode!
  (2) Unit Traits cannot be applied to Support Units.
  Hero Development:
  Purchase Unit Traits in the shop to raise your Hero's level. Reaching certain Hero levels lets you field an additional squad of Support Units.
Trial Altar:
  Interact with Altars on the map to face mysterious trial challenges. Victory brings generous rewards.
Mission Event:
  Special missions will randomly appear on the map — complete them to earn reward resource.
  Gameplay Map Introduction:
  Sanada Maru: Team up to strike enemy base, complete missions to forge a mighty Chariot, and carve a bloody path through flaming trebuchets and waves of foes!
  The Great Wall: Launch daring raids for flags and fiercely defend the wall! Advance stage by stage along the ramparts, shatter enemy ranks, and deploy cunning tactics against relentless onslaughts!
  Dasuo Fort: Break down the fort together — push relentlessly forward! Advance from the outer walls pushing to the final battle in the fort, all while dynamic reinforcement mechanics deliver an epic siege experience!
Event Duration:
Open all day from August 21 (After maintenance) to September 4.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4b4c92fcc5d4bd48157886cc2c77312cf9ca6333.jpg"][/img]7. Extra Prizes for Specific Mode!
Event Introduction:
Participate in \[Siege Battles] and the exclusive anniversary PVE mode \[Return to Battlefield] to earn random event exchange items, which can be used to exchange rare rewards, including Anniversary Reward Box, Pure Wisdom, Golden Key, Epic Hero Schematic Crate, Treatise, and more! Don't miss your chance to claim the powerful battlefield slayer: \[Party Bombard]!
Event Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – September 4 (Before maintenance).
Exchange Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – 0:00 (UTC+1 EU/AMS), September 11.

8. Anniversary Shopping Festival Begins — Limited-Time Offers on New Arrivals!
Event Introduction:
(1) The 6th Anniversary Celebration brings a series of special offer packs to the Shop. Enjoy ultra-value Monthly Pass for a limited time, along with all-new Lotus Water Pack!
(2) Take advantage of time-limited discounts on regular Attires — Attires for Warlords, Units, Mounts, and more, with prices slashed up to 50% off!
(3) Legendary Historical Attire Chests and Legendary Attire Exchange are now permanently available in the \[Attire Chests].
For detailed information, Warlords can visit the \[Shop] and check the exclusive \[6th Anniversary Shopping Festival] page, or simply click the \[Conqueror's Blade 6th Anniversary Event] button on the main interface.

August 21 (After maintenance) – September 19 (Before maintenance).

9. Anniversary Spending Rewards Unlocked!
Event Introduction:
Spend Sovereigns during the event to earn \[Illusionist Key] and exclusive exchange tokens.
Spending Event Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – 0:00, September 11.
Exchange Shop Duration:
August 21 (After maintenance) – September 19 (Before maintenance).

10. Doctrine Pool Rotation — New Epic Doctrine Now Available!
Doctrine Pool Introduction:
The limited-time doctrine pool \[Hedge of Pikes] is now available in \[War Scholar]. The drop rate of epic doctrines for Polearm Infantry Units is increased here.
New Doctrine Introduction:
Name: Epic Bloodthirsty Doctrine
Quality: Epic Polearm Doctrine
Effect: After dealing damage, gain 12% Life Drain for 6 seconds. If Units' health falls below 30%, gain an additional 12% Life Drain for 3 seconds; if Units' health exceeds 60%, damage dealt increases by 12%.

The \[Marker] issued in battle with the mouse middle button will now sync directly to the Mini-Map and includes new 3D sound effects.
\[Order] issued via the mouse right button will no longer be limited by maximum visible distance, and now feature enhanced visual effects.

notes.notes:
Greetings, Warlords!
[b]We will conduct maintenance updates during the following time:[/b]

[b]The update will contain the following:[/b]
 
[h2]1. [Dynasty Awakening] Launch! Limited-Time Free Doctrine Removal![/h2]
Event Details:
During the event, removing any quality Doctrine will not consume Lotus Water. We hope Warlords can enjoy free adjustments and combinations.
Event Duration:
June 28, 00:00 ~ June 29, 24:00
 
[h2]2. New Season Map — [Hangu Pass] Unveiled![/h2]
Here, the waters of the Wei River break, sheer cliffs converge, and forged fangs thrust forth from cleft mountains — this is Qin's eastern gateway: Hangu Pass!
Here, countless armies have faltered, and numerous heroes have met their end. Now, as the fires of war ignite once more, the fate of the battlefield remains uncertain.
After maintenance on June 26, the new Season Map — [Hangu Pass] will be officially available!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a4888740be791e00c917f107da8c842833b85418.jpg[/img]
[b]Map Structure:[/b]
The Hangu Pass battlefield is divided into three areas: [Camp], [Moat], and [Pass Wall], each with a key contested point.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d5c4778e5633a16fbd37286eb06eaae7f5d180ab.jpg[/img]
[b]Special Mechanics:[/b]
[list]
[*]
Breach the Dam
[/*][/list]
The side controlling the [Camp] flag will deploy [Dam Guard] to defend the dam area.
After defeating the [Dam Guard], you can actively trigger the [Breach the Dam] event. Floodwaters will surge down the channel, eliminating all Heroes and Units within the downstream river area and destroying any floating bridge on the river.
Attention! After the [Breach the Dam] event is triggered, the two Supply Points in the river area will be destroyed and become unavailable. The water level will rise, flooding parts of the riverbank — any Heroes and Units caught in this zone will drown.
After the event ends, a new floating bridge will be rebuilt on the river, and a temporary passage will be constructed at the dam breach for crossing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fe473ea76f952da810e8df802fccee839498c11a.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]
Flame Arrows
[/*][/list]
The attackers' Trebuchet is replaced by [Flame Arrows]. By pressing the G key to aim and release, players can fire several waves of Flame Arrows from the attacking base, dealing area damage—especially to unshielded units. Flame Arrows damage both enemy and allied units, so be strategic about your targets and timing.
After the attackers capture the [Camp] flag, the number of waves per [Flame Arrows] will increase.
 
[h2]3. Hangu Pass Event — [Call of Unity] Begins![/h2]
With the launch of the Season Map [Hangu Pass], participating in [Hangu Pass] battles will reward you with [Qin Brick]. Donate [Qin Brick] during the [Call of Unity] event to earn generous rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4984f91624f643abe4f2cdb75ca1c5d343d7ccf2.jpg[/img]
Event Rules:
Warlords can obtain [Qin Brick] as drops in the [Hangu Pass] mode (weekly drop limit: 200, which resets every Thursday at 00:00).
By donating [Qin Brick], Warlord contributes to the server progress, and gains individual Contribution Points and random reward packs.
Accumulate Contribution Points to gradually unlock personal rewards. You can check each reward stage in the donation progress bar. Once server progress is full, individual donations still grant rewards.
Any undonated items at the end of the event will be reclaimed automatically and converted to Bronze Coins.
Event rewards include: Emote [Tribute to All Under Heaven], Epic Hero Schematic Box, Treatise, Optimal Divine Crow, and more.
 
Drop Event Duration:
June 26th (After maintenance) - July 10th, 00:00 (Elysium Peak server: drops end July 9th, 18:00)
Reward Claim Duration:
June 26th (After maintenance) - July 14th, 00:00
 
[Qin Brick] can also be obtained through the following events:
[olist]
[*]
Limited-Time Sign-In:
[/*]
[/olist]
Log in for 10 days to receive [Qin Brick] *50 and Blessing (12 hours) *10.
Sign-In Duration: June 26th (After maintenance) - July 10th (Before maintenance)
 
[olist]
[*]
Warden Limited-Time Quests:
[/*]
[/olist]
Weekly Quests: (reset every Thursday at 00:00)
（1）Participate in 5 Hangu Pass battles, regardless of win or loss, achieve Score B or above to receive [Qin Brick] *50 and Treatise*1

[h2]5. System Adjustments and Optimizations[/h2]

[h2]6. Other Bug Fixes and Optimizations[/h2]
Fixed an issue in the [Sun City] Siege map where cavalry could get stuck on terrain.
Fixed an abnormal reward issue in [Training Battle] mode.
Fixed incorrect description text in the manual units building popup.
Fixed an issue on certain servers where Doctrine-related side quest progress would not record properly.

[h1]I. Seasonal Unit[/h1]
[h2]Qin's Footbow[/h2]
[h3]Background:[/h3]
Rising from ancient depths, the Terracotta Crossbowmen serve as the deadly long-range support for the Emperor. Clad in practical armor and wielding formidable foot-drawn bows, they strike with precision from 100-150 meters. Their volleys darken the sky, piercing armor, shattering bones, and tearing banners, all to decisively end wars with their strategic firepower. Embodying order and strength, they march to bring wars to a decisive close.
[h3]Combat Style:[/h3]
The footbow represented the most advanced ranged weapon of its time, and the Qin's Footbow were among the most elite Units in Great Qin. Rigorously trained, they possess exceptional strength and skill: sitting, drawing, and firing in one seamless motion. Their bolts with spark inflict continuous damage and fear upon enemies. When the time is right, they decisively detonate these sparks to deliver a fatal blow.
[h3]Unit Characteristics：[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Targets hit by the footbow will be marked with Spark, stacking up to 10 times. The higher the stack, the greater the damage upon detonation.
[/*][*]
The footbow is a large crossbow with long range that can pierce and attack 2 targets. However, since it is a handheld crossbow, the crossbowman moves slowly and cannot push siege engines or climb ladders. All attacks require issuing a command to execute.
[/*][/list]
[h3]Skill Design：[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Skill 1: Set Up/Pack Up Footbow (The unit must set up footbows before attacking and must pack it up before moving again)
[/*][*]
Skill 2: Attack Area (Launches a long-range attack at an area chosen by the Hero. The system automatically adjusts the firing angle based on distance for precise coverage)
[/*][*]
Skill 3: Spark Detonation (Detonate all the enemies with "Spark" within range, the damage depends on the "Spark" stacks)
[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/33cf090e79a3d697682fcb20095fb875b9f19e8e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Halberd Elite[/h2]
[h3]Background:[/h3]
Rising from the ancient earth, the Halberd Elites serve as the elite vanguard for the Eternal Emperor. Clad in sturdy armor and wielding formidable halberds, they embody order and discipline. Their precision strikes pierce armor and shatter bones, bringing wars to a decisive close.
[h3]Combat Style:[/h3]
In the realm of Qin, they are known as the sharpest blades. Wielding halberds approximately 2.8 meters long, these weapons combine the features of a spearhead affixed to the front end of a dagger-axe. They can hook, pull, and thrust with deadly precision. Masterful in their technique, the Halberd Elites launch preemptive strikes on the battlefield, swiftly following up with ferocious attacks that overwhelm foes. Under the stern reward and penalty system, they exhibit unparalleled bravery and invincibility, instilling fear in their enemies.
[h3]Unit Characteristics：[/h3]
[list]
[*]
The elite main battle units of Qin, wielding halberds as their weapon.
[/*][*]
Utilize hooking and dragging attacks combined with strategic movement to control and suppress enemies effectively.
[/*][*]
Upon killing enemies, they gain health recovery and a temporary boost.
[/*][/list]
[h3]Skill Design：[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Skill 1: Cloud Cleave
[/*][/list]
Charge in the designated direction, dragging enemies towards them, ignoring all defenses.
[list]
[*]
Skill 2: Storm Surge
[/*][/list]
Immediately break free from control effect and retreat in the chosen direction, hooking enemies in front and pulling them away. Damage taken is reduced during the skill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7927a0e6d1e352c37b301d6eded0ce39d37a2cc3.jpg[/img]
[h2]Empire Chariot[/h2]
[h3]Background:[/h3]
Chariots were used by the Qin state in warfare for both offense and defense. Assault chariots engaged enemies directly, while defensive chariots were used for garrison duty and transporting supplies. In general historical records, assault chariots are commonly referred to as Chariots and the records of small-scale chariot battles can date back to the Xia dynasty.
[h3]Combat Style:[/h3]
During the Warring States period, chariots were the dominant force on the battlefield. Organized in formations, they charged enemy infantry phalanxes, disrupting their lines and creating opportunities for following infantry attacks. At the time, the number of chariots often served as a key indicator of a state's military strength. High-ranking generals commonly commanded on chariots, and even rulers would sometimes take the field in person, inspiring their troops.
[h3]Unit Characteristics:[/h3]
[list]
[*]
The chariot is not only an assault force on the battlefield but also serves as the warlord's command platform and a symbol of status.
[/*][*]
The chariot can charge at the front lines, pursue fleeing enemies, and assist in protecting the flanks of allied units.
[/*][/list]
[h3]Skill Design：[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Skill 1 Thunder Mandate: (Hold the [Sprint Key] to accelerate the chariot, increasing ramming damage, but continuously consuming horse stamina.）
[/*][*]
Skill 2 Squall Edict: (While at high speed, press the [Jump Key] and rotate the camera to veer. The chariot will ram targets with its body, dealing massive damage and allowing you to change direction with the camera. This greatly consumes horse stamina.）
[/*][/list]

[h1]IX. System Optimizations[/h1]
[h3][b]Barracks Interface Optimization:[/b][/h3]
The [U] - Barracks interface has been redesigned.
  Warlords can now find all owned and unowned units on the new Barracks main page, view detailed information about unowned units, and directly navigate to locations where units can be acquired.
  Each Unit can be tested in the Training Camp, and for some Units, battle demonstration videos are available.
  You can view specialty tags for each Unit to quickly understand their combat characteristics and battlefield roles.
  More comprehensive and accurate filtering functions are now available, making it easier and faster to find specific Units.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5a3563ca851503809b41214a8aa096d4c872b3bd.jpg[/img]
[h3]Unit Building Process:[/h3]
Optimized the process of [b]Unit Build[/b][b]ing[/b] has been optimized:
Unlocking a Unit in the Unit Tree will now automatically complete its build without consuming any materials or Bronze Coins.
Optimized the setting of [b]Barracks [/b][b]Unit Capacity[/b]:
Manual Unit Build is no longer restricted by the Units Capacity limit.
For Units that have already been built, repeating the build will consume the item: Expansion Permit *1.
Only Units built multiple times can be disbanded; otherwise, the disband option will not be available.
 
[h3]Unit Training Camp:[/h3]
More Mastery Units will be added as options in the Unit Training Camp.
 
[h3]Store:[/h3]
Exclusive Unit attires have been newly added to the [Store]. Warlords can view the available attire via [C] - [Store] - [Attire] - [Unit Attire]. The new attire includes: Iron Reapers: Tradition's Power, Sunward Phalanx: Fairytale Guard, Onna-Musha: Lone Fox Unit Attire.
 
[h1]X. Visual and Interaction Adjustments[/h1]
[h3]Hero Outline[/h3]
When a hero is blocked by Units or other dynamic objects on the battlefield, a distinct outline will appear to clearly show the hero's position.
This function can be opened or closed in [Settings] - [Graphics] - [Graphics Settings] - [Hero outline].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/66f520c9b788ad6cc8593e759e67831d5255076a.jpg[/img]
[h3]Dynamic Object Transparency[/h3]
Dynamic objects between the hero and camera now become semi-transparent, making it easier to locate your hero.
This function can be opened or closed in [Settings] - [Graphics] - [Graphics Settings] - [Auto-hide].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c8562c60443cad9134461fce869ce40fa00b7c22.jpg[/img]
[h3]Hero and Unit Overhead Indicators[/h3]
New UI indicators have been added above Hero and Units, making it easier to locate your Hero and Units.
This function can be opened or closed in [Settings] - [UI] - [Hero Overhead Indicators] or [Unit Overhead Indicators].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9ec691ab8892b62c0462cb7c2dd178967908208b.jpg[/img]
[h3]Unit Off-Screen Indicators[/h3]
When Units are outside your field of view, more prominent indicators will point to their direction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/09a28624e2b0aa0396865d77b3d97cbf38a3a6f0.jpg[/img]
[h3]Damage Number Animation Optimization[/h3]
The animations for damage numbers dealt by players in battle have been enhanced. Damage numbers for Brace Weapon types have also been added, allowing for better battle experience.
[h3]UI Visual Style Optimization[/h3]
We will gradually update the overall UI with a more stylized design to better match the characteristics of the game.
 
[h1]XI. New Player Experience Adjustments[/h1]
 
[b]New Player Privileges:[/b] To help new warlords with Unit development decisions, we have introduced an exclusive privilege system for new players. Before reaching level 100, warlords can reset Unit levels, Unit Mastery, and Veterancy Points for free. Additionally, Doctrine removal and sealing of unit tree nodes are also free.
 
[b]New Player Benefits:[/b] The welfare for unlocking Units for new warlords has been upgraded. Newly registered accounts will unlock the 4-star Unit: Kriegsbruders after completing the [Recruitment I] quest. Upon completion, the beginner login bonus event will also be unlocked. On the second day of the event, the login reward will be upgraded to the 5-star Unit Tercio Arquebusiers.
 
[b]Match Battles:[/b] To improve early battle experience for new warlords, a new matching mode [Training Battle] has been introduced, and the required level to unlock matched Siege Battles has been adjusted to level 15. In Training Battle, warlords can focus on and become familiar with maps suitable for beginners, then gradually transition to more intense matched Siege Battles. The New Player Training Camp is not affected by World Campaigns and allows deployment of up to 5-star Units.
 
[b]Training Camp:[/b] Free Training Camp and Unit Training Camp have been optimized, improving the practice experience for Units, Artillery, and Siege Battles.
Access Method 1: [J] - [Training Simulation] - [Free Training Camp] / [Unit Training Camp].
Access Method 2: [TAB] - [Free Training Camp] / [Unit Training Camp], or speak with the respective Trainer to enter.
 
[b]Other:[/b]
The rules for displaying Units in the tent have been adjusted. Units will now change based on recent usage frequency in matched battles.
Guidance effects have been optimized in the Unit deployment, Unit interface, and Skills interfaces.
 
[h1]XII. Territory War Adjustments[/h1]
[h2]Cross-Region Migration Adjustment[/h2]
[list]

In the following servers, migration and expeditions between Longting, Liangyun, and Ostaria Regions can be conducted via Cross-Server Forts or Agents.

In future seasons, we will explore more combinations of open Regions, allowing warlords to migrate through Cross-Server Forts and Agents.
[h2]Adjustment to House Level Requirement for War Declarion[/h2]
The required House level to declare war on the following City Fiefs in Territory War has been adjusted from level 4 to level 3:
Daur, Kerlich, Huegelstadt, Gruenefeld, Tura, Óváros, Kisbér, Hatvan, Horka, Rubusta, Hexi, Gaoda, Narth, Hebao, Jindai, Zandin, Louge, Yixing, Renlin, Mingyu.
 
 
[h1]XIII. BUG Fixes[/h1]
Fixed an issue where the unit type description for [Matchlock Ashigaru] was incorrect.
Fixed an issue where [Demesne Pikemen] could not use [Sprint] while in [Block] formation.
Fixed an issue where [Janissaries] would behave abnormally when following in C-key state.
Fixed an issue in the Battle of Thermopylae where certain areas could trap heroes and prevent movement.
Fixed an issue where Leaders, Vice-Leaders, and Marshals of non-Command Houses at the same Fief could supervise Fronts started by other Houses.
Fixed a rare crash that could occur when entering a stage with DLSS enabled.
Fixed a rare issue where shield break visual effects would behave abnormally after a Unit performed a shield break attack.

notes.title: June 5 Update Log
notes.notes:
Greetings, Warlords!

[b]We will conduct maintenance updates during the following time:[/b] [b]APAC: June 5, 14:00-17:00 (UTC+8).[/b] [b]EU/AMS: June 5, 7:00-10:00 (UTC+1).[/b] [b]The maintenance is expected to last for 3 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins *8000, Honor *300, and Unit Medal *15 as compensation. Warlords, please arrange your playtime accordingly. [/b]
[b]The update will contain the following:[/b]
 
[h1][b]I. Events[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]1.[/b] [Dynasty Awakening] [b]Season is Coming—Season Battle Pass preorder is Available![/b][/h3]
[b]Introduction:[/b]
Preorders for the all-new Season Battle Pass will start after maintenance on June 5. Warlords can go to the Store via [C] to purchase the Season Battle Pass Preorder Pack.
Preordering the Season Battle Pass grants extra rewards including Treatise, Nobility XP, and more. You'll also unlock all [Victory Pass] content and get early access to the new 3-star Season Unit — empowering your journey in the new season!
[b]Event Time:[/b]
June 5th (After maintenance) - June 19th (Before maintenance)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/87bb343990f95c2eda5c09529516420f63a1f482.jpg[/img]
[h3]2. Preorder the new Season Battle Pass and unlock the [Victory Pass]—Receive the New Season Unit![/h3]
[b]Details:[/b]
Preorder [Dynasty Awakening] Season Battle Pass and complete [Victory Pass] challenges to receive 2 Challenge Tokens for the 3-star Season Unit. After the new season begins on June 19, you can directly unlock and obtain the new 3-star Season Unit.
[b]Introduction：[/b]
Warlords can participate in the [Victory Pass] event via [O] – [Activities].
During the event, some [Victory Pass] rewards can be unlocked for free. If you preorder the new Season Battle Pass, you can unlock all [Victory Pass] rewards.
During the event, completing [Victory Quests] will get XP to level up your [Victory Pass] — the higher the level, the better the rewards.
New [Victory Quests] will unlock daily at 00:00, and all quests can be completed anytime during the event period.
[b]Event Time:[/b]
  June 5th (After maintenance) - June 19th (Before maintenance)
[h3]3. Limited-Time Return of the Onslaught Mode[b]! — New Leaderboard and Gameplay Updates![/b][/h3]
[b]Introduction:[/b]
[b]Access:[/b]
  Participate in the mode directly through [J] - [Onslaught]. You can also switch between "Challenge Mode" and "Endless Mode" there.
[b]Details:[/b]
  [Onslaught] is available for a limited time. [Hwarang], [Tiger Fists], and [Silla Guards] are joining the battlefield. New [Tactics] are introduced, [Trait] effects fully updated, and several new battle scenarios have been added for a more challenging experience.
[b]Gameplay Introduction：[/b]
Battle Rules:
   (1) Bring a unit that can be operated by heroes to participate in the battle.
   (2) The battle is divided into multiple rounds, each round consisting of a [Deployment Phase] and a [Battle Phase].
   (3) At the start of the [Deployment Phase], all units and hero's statuses are reset (fully restored), and a certain amount of leadership are provided as funds. During the [Deployment Phase], players can consume leadership to deploy or upgrade units. The [Battle Phase] begins once deployment is complete.
   (4) During the [Battle Phase], if one side's units are entirely defeated, that round ends and the next round's [Deployment Phase] begins.
  Victory Conditions:
    Both sides have a certain amount of [Morale]. At the end of each round, the losing side will have their [Morale] deducted. If the enemy's [Morale] reach zero, the player wins the game. Conversely, if the player's [Morale] reaches zero, the game is lost.
  Talent System:
    Complete an Onslaught battle to earn [Talent Points]. Spend [Talent Points] to unlock new abilities that aid in completing the game.
  Trait System:
    Units deployed during the [Deployment Phase] carry several [Traits]. When enough units with the same [Trait] are on the field, the [Trait] effect is triggered.
  Tactics System:
    Unlock tactics in the talent system. After unlocking tactics, there will be an opportunity to choose a tactic at the start of specific rounds' deployment phases. Tactics have powerful effects that can enhance your overall strength.
  Economy System:
    There is a maximum limit on the number of units that can be deployed on our side, which increases with the number of rounds.
[b]Rewards Preview:[/b]
Earn [Onslaught Points] after each round of Onslaught based on your result and rounds reached.
Accumulate [Onslaught Points] to receive milestone rewards, including Pure Wisdom, Treatise, Epic Hero Schematic Crate, and other valuable items.
[b]Leaderboard Introduction:[/b]
How to Participate:
  Compete for the highest score in [Endless Mode]; your highest single score will automatically enter the leaderboard.
Leaderboard Rules:
  Scores in [Endless Mode] of Onslaught count toward the leaderboard.
  In [Endless Mode], scores are calculated each round based on unit losses for both sides. The highest score you achieve will be used for leaderboard ranking (for equal scores, the player who reached it first ranks higher).
Leaderboard Rewards:
  When the event ends, leaderboard players will receive valuable rewards based on rank, including exclusive Title, Frame, Epic Hero Schematic Crate, Treatise, and more.
[b]Event Time:[/b]
[Challenge Mode] and [Endless Mode] will be open all day after maintenance on June 5 and will close before maintenance on June 19.
After maintenance on June 19, the event page remains open until maintenance on June 26 for you to claim rewards with the points earned.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3fbf93f94b7c61360ca80fa19b76aa627d935d84.jpg[/img]
 
[h3]4[b]、New Season Approaching, Reserve on Official Website for Great Rewards! [/b][/h3]
[b]Event Details: [/b]
The new season and new server reservation will soon open in an official website reservation format. Warlords who successfully reserve and create a character on the new server before 00:00 on June 26 will receive generous rewards via mail after the maintenance on June 26. Exclusive permanent hero attire "Diadochi Attire" and permanent epic title are included!
[b]Event Time: [/b]
Reservation Period: June 6, 12:00 – June 19, 00:00(UTC+8).
New Server Reservation Character Creation Open Until: June 26, 00:00(UTC+8).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ee3e397f27df11b7d5feaccf3dffe7fb5368db6c.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]II. System Adjustments and Optimizations[/h1]
[h3]1. Season Server Transfer System[/h3]
  New Season Server Transfer Reservation:
    After maintenance, reservation for Season server transfer will be available. After successfully applying for server transfer, you can log in directly to the target server after new Season Maintenance. Server transfer applications will remain open until the new Season Maintenance. For detailed server transfer information, please refer to subsequent transfer notices.
    Server Merge Notice:
    After new Season maintenance, some servers ([Lionforge Fjord] and [Lakonía]), ([Aurora Ridge] and [Hades Gate]), will be merged. Detailed information on server merges will be provided in upcoming merge announcements.
 
[h1]III. Other Bug Fixes and Optimizations[/h1]
Fixed an issue where the [Ironcap Archers]'s Skill [Arrow Rain] may not display after interacting with supply points.
Fixed an issue where the attack range of [Symmachean Stalwarts]'s [Brace] was abnormal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6e3359135cdc006256f2cb72f62eb9447292c82a.gif[/img]
Fixed an issue where the damage reduction description of [Symmachean Stalwarts]'s [Brace] was incorrect. The correct damage reduction is 30%.
Optimized the detailed description of Banner Guards' [Plant the Banner]: After using the skill, the unit will plant a banner in place for 15s. While the banner is present, all allied units within range gain 50% defense against all damage types. The banner can be picked up by the Hero controlling this unit; when picked up, weapon skills will be replaced with the exclusive banner skill set.
Fixed a pathfinding issue in the [Harbour City] Siege Battle map that caused units to overlap.
Fixed an abnormal floating pathfinding issue in the [Sun City] Siege Battle map.
Fixed an issue where the in-game language setting did not function correctly in certain cases. After the update, if the language option has not been changed in-game, the game will use the launcher's language setting. If the language has been changed in-game, the display language will follow the in-game setting.
Fixed an issue in the All or Nothing map where the icon state was not correctly displayed for Units with Mastery.
Optimized the Season-Exclusive Doctrines expiration notice. After expiry, you will receive a reminder via in-game mail.

[h1][b]I. Festival Series Events: More Rewards Await You![/b][/h1]
[h3]1. Dragon Boat Festival Login Rewards![/h3]
[b]Event Introduction:[/b]
Celebrating the Dragon Boat Festival brings wishes of peace and happiness! As the festival approaches, we've prepared substantial login rewards for all Warlords!
Warlords who have logged in during the current Season will receive exclusive Dragon Boat rewards via mail on May 31st, including: Treatise x3, Boat Festival Gift x10.
[b]Dragon Boat Gift Item Introduction:[/b]
Upon opening the [Boat Festival Gift], you will randomly receive one of the following items:
  [Bean Paste Dumpling]: Use to get 100 Honour, 50 Skill Points, and 10,000 Hero XP.
  [Fresh Meat Dumpling]: Use to get extra rewards for 3 battles, increasing Hero XP and Units XP gains by 100%.

[h3]2. Dragonhunter’s Mantra Returns with Enhanced Rewards![/h3]

Using [Mechanical Rod], you can draw rewards on the event interface. The Dragonhunter’s Mantra reward pool consists of three phases: [Dragon’s Awakening], [Shadowed Relics], and [Endless Hunt].
Opening [Dragon’s Awakening] 300 times guarantees all rewards, including [Pure Wisdom].
After acquiring [Pure Wisdom] in [Dragon’s Awakening], the [Shadowed Relics] pool unlocks. Opening [Shadowed Relics] 500 times guarantees all rewards, including an [Epic Hero Schematic Crate].
After obtaining the [Epic Hero Schematic Crate] in [Shadowed Relics], the [Endless Hunt] pool unlocks. [Endless Hunt] offers opportunities to acquire the all-new epic mount [Golden Dragon], Legendary Kills Announcer [Valor of the Vanguard], and many other rare items.
[b]Event Duration:[/b]
From after maintenance on May 29, 2025, to 00:00, June 12, 2025.
After 00:00, June 12, 2025, [Mechanical Rod] will no longer drop, but the event interface will remain open until before maintenance on June 19, 2025. Warlords can continue to use their obtained [Mechanical Rod] to earn rewards or purchase [Mechanical Rod] using Sovereigns.
A maximum of 3,000 [Mechanical Rod] can be purchased during the event.

[b]Event Introduction:[/b]
The [Armstrong's Redoubt] is now open. In [Armstrong's Redoubt], the probability for obtaining Epic-quality Doctrines for Javelin units is increased.
[b]Event Duration:[/b]
From after maintenance on May 29 to before maintenance on June 12.
 
[h1]II. System Adjustments and Optimizations[/h1]
[h3]1. Units Balance Adjustments[/h3]
Polearm Infantry Brace Weapons Adjustment:
  Imperial Pike Guards, Pike Militia, Demesne Pikemen, Village Watchmen:
    Brace attack range remains unchanged, but now initiates attacks early as enemies approach the attack range.
    Brace attack's speed boost damage cap increased by 300%. Minimum speed affected by speed boost increases from 4m/s to 9m/s.
  Modao Battalion:
    Number of targets for brace attacks in Modao Defence changed from 2 to 4, with a speed boost damage cap increase of 200%. Minimum speed affected by speed boost increases from 2m/s to 9m/s.
    Under Modao March, the number of targets for Stab/Slash/Push attacks changes from 2/3/1 to 3/3/3.
    Carnage’s number of targets per attack segment when contacting enemies changes from 2 to 3.
  Fortebraccio Pikemen:
    Brace attack Speed boost damage cap increased by 300%. Minimum speed affected by speed boost increases from 5m/s to 9m/s.
  Demesne Pikemen:
    Added [Block Formation], where units will enter brace state upon forming up.
  Imperial Pike Guards:
    Initial health increased from 6884 to 7247.
    [Advance] Piercing Damage coefficient increased from 62% to 80%.
    [Advance] cooldown reduced from 50 seconds to 35 seconds, with a 30% increase to all defenses during the skill duration.
Palace Guards:
  Adjusted [For The Power!] skill attack method: units will first charge towards the enemy, then use Shield Bash upon approaching.
  [For The Power!]'s slashing damage coefficient increased from 80% to 100%, blunt damage coefficient increased from 80% to 100%, and attacks will no longer be deflected when blocked.
  Every enemy killed by [For The Power!]'s shield bash attack reduces [Guard The Throne]'s cooldown by 0.8 seconds.
Imperial Spear Guards:
  Maximum unit size increased from 32 to 40.
  Mastery Node 5: Health recovery increased from 40 health per second to 1% of maximum health per second.
  Mastery Node 6: Damage reduction from 5-star units increased from 200 to 400.
  Mastery Node 7: Damage reduction from Cavalry increased from 200 to 400.
  Spear Sergeants:
  Initial health increased from 7260 to 8508.
  Piercing damage increased from 978 to 1181.
  Maximum unit size increased from 32 to 40.
  Adjusted [Cover Commander] combat style: leveraging the spear's length for more aggressive attacks to enhance attack efficiency, which now reduces enemies' penetration values by 10% per hit, stacking up to 5 times.
  During [Cover Commander], maximum movement speed increased from 5.2 to 7, with added block effects during movement and attack.
  Symmachean Stalwarts:
  Maximum health increased from 7252 to 8432.
  Piercing damage increased from 1003 to 1237.
  Maximum unit size increased from 32 to 40.
  The damage reduction effect during successful blocks in brace state temporarily increased from 12% to 30%, with life recovery effects boosted from 7% to 9%.
  The brace attack's range remains unchanged, but the attack will be launched early as enemies are about to enter the attack range.
  Imperial Javelineers:
  Initial health increased from 6405 to 7035.
  Initial ammo amount increased from 90 to 120.
  Initial piercing damage increased from 1123 to 1201.
  Javelin attack piercing damage coefficient increased from 320% to 350%.
  Shield throw attack piercing damage coefficient increased from 135% to 150%.
 
[h3]2. New Unit Mastery[/h3]
  Demesne Arbalists:
  Node 1: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 2: Increase shooting speed by 12%.
  Node 3: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 4: Increase shooting speed by 12%.
  Node 5: Gain skill: [Piercing Bolts], which allows crossbow bolts to pierce up to 2 additional targets and disrupt cavalry charges; damage decreases by 30% for each target pierced. (Does not coexist with other skills)
  Node 6: Increase damage against cavalry by 400 points.
  Node 7: Increase damage against melee units by 400 points.
  Node 8: [Piercing Bolts] apply a 40% slow to cavalry, lasting 3 seconds.
  Rattan Vipers:
  Node 1: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 2: Increase Piercing Armour Penetration by 100 points.
  Node 3: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 4: Increase Piercing Armour Penetration by 100 points.
  Node 5: Gain skill: [Poison Barrage], causing small area enemies to be poisoned and take damage equal to 1.5% of their current health per second.
  Node 6: Increase damage against infantry by 400 points.
  Node 7: Increase damage against ranged units by 400 points.
  Node 8: Increase [Poison Barrage] poisoning damage by 300 points per second.
  Ironcap Arquebusiers:
  Node 1: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 2: Increase shooting speed by 12%.
  Node 3: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 4: Increase shooting speed by 12%.
  Node 5: Gain skill: [Rapid Fire], greatly increasing shooting speed for 12 seconds.
  Node 6: Increase damage against cavalry by 400 points.
  Node 7: Increase damage against melee units by 400 points.
  Node 8: During [Rapid Fire], randomly throw firecrackers to deal area damage, which will comsume a large amount of ammo.
  Ironcap Archers:
  Node 1: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 2: Increase Piercing Armour Penetration by 100 points.
  Node 3: Increase Piercing Damage by 100 points.
  Node 4: Increase Piercing Armour Penetration by 100 points.
  Node 5: Gain skill: [Explosive Arrows], which shoots 2 rounds of arrows with attached firecracker causing small area explosions.
  Node 6: Increase damage against infantry by 400 points.
  Node 7: Increase damage against ranged units by 400 points.
  Node 8: Reduce [Explosive Arrows] cooldown time by 9 seconds.
 
[h3]3. Basic System Updates[/h3]
Quest System:
  Optimized rules for continuous victory quests. If you exit the game during a battle and lose, your win streak record will reset. If you win, the win streak count will continue as normal.
Server Transfer System:
  Added an item listing check in the market during server transfers and introduced appropriate notifications.
Replay System:
  The [Battlefield Replay] system is now available to all. Warlords can view recent [Ranked Battles] replays on the [ESC] - [Career] - [Battlefield Replay].
Interface Updates:
  New rule introduction content on [P] - [Character], [U] - [Barracks], and [U] - [Unit Tree] interfaces. Click the [Rules] button at the bottom right of the respective tab to view.
Unit Training Camp:
  Additional Units are now available for training in the Unit Training Camp.
 
 
[h3]4. Ranked Battles Related[/h3]
[Ranked Battles] Settlement Time and Rewards Update:
  Starting from the Silla season, [Ranked Battles] settlement time will be changed to 00:00 (server time) on the Monday of the last week of the season. The settlement will last until the new season, during which [Ranked Battles] will be temporarily closed.
  After the maintenance of the new season, Warlords can log into the game and claim their settlement rewards on the [Ranked Battles] interface.
 
[h1]III. Other Bug Fixes and Optimizations[/h1]
Fixed an issue where the shield position of [Psiloi Slingers] was abnormal when advancing with the Battering Ram.
Resolved the issue where [Hwarang] would unexpectedly replenish ammo when equipped with the [Double Strings] Doctrine.
Corrected the discrepancy between displayed and actual skill names in the training node of [Schutzdieners].
Fixed an abnormal unit model display issue after unlocking the final node of [Incendiary Archers] in the Veterancy.
Fixed the issue of unit models floating after being defeated.
Addressed the unresponsive issue when clicking the increase button in the purchase interface of the [Barding & Tack] shop.
Fixed an issue where using formation commands while climbing stairs would lead to voice loss for units.
Corrected the issue where the color of teammate names would display incorrectly on the [Front] interface.
Resolved an issue where weapon-related quests would progress while trying out Legendary attire in the trial level.

Balance Adjustment：
  Introduction：
    Low-star units have long struggled to perform effectively on high-star battlefields, significantly limiting both strategic diversity and tactical depth. With this round of Mastery and Leadership adjustments, we aim to take the first step toward expanding viable unit choices across the battlefield.
    Our plan begins with 2-star and 3-star units. For each of these lower-star units, we try to provide a scenarios where their strengths can be maximized. When Warlords deploy them strategically in the right situations, they will reap significant rewards—turning the tide and achieving victory against stronger foes.
    Currently, low-star units face two major issues. First, many of them suffer from outdated mechanics and underwhelming base stats. We will address this through targeted balance and Mastery adjustments, guided by real-time battlefield performance data. This should help most low-star units meet the strength thresholds of high-star battles. Second, under the influence of Leadership-reduction Doctrines, the Leadership cost-efficiency of 3-star units is only about 50% that of some 4- or 5-star units. We are actively analyzing data to redefine the Leadership cost of low-star units, ensuring that—when used strategically—they can trade favorably against higher-cost enemy units.
     Looking ahead, we will also rework particularly underperforming masteries and adjust weaker 4- and 5-star units, ensuring every point of Leadership spent delivers its intended value.

(3) During the Territory War preparation phase, teammates' preparation status can now be viewed, with prepared teammates displayed with a green background.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/62c775c7bf854578fd93bb439728da99e081b173.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c8952a44049e1c48fa723e1783da70fddb3115c5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8fd50eb28779231718ebebfbe6d4f117cb9e194e.png[/img] 

(7) When joining an ongoing Battle with a band of rebels in the world, players can now choose to leave the battle.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/07925601b5a4e09a4a453f2c2807173a7878c3f1.png[/img]

[h1]III. Other Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/h1]
Fixed an issue where the attribute overview on the [Condottieri Guards] mastery interface displayed incorrect values.
Fixed an issue where the [Tiger Fists] would occasionally remain stationary after using the [Courage Charge] skill.
Fixed an issue where pathfinding to the Fame Envoy sometimes encountered blockages.
Fixed an issue with incorrect display on creation interfaces of some units.
Fixed the issue with the abnormal effect of Epic Combat Doctrine.

notes.title: [Silla] Season Update Log
notes.notes:
[h1]I. Seasonal Unit[/h1]
[h2]3-Star Unit: Silla Guards[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4e818bc8f23173f000dd55195fbfc77ae9597f88.jpg[/img]

[h3]Background:[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Forged from Silla's spear-bearing phalanx tactics, the Silla Guards became a formidable force across the land. Wielding rectangular shields and long spears, this unit dominated battlefields with their signature shield throw tactic. This battle-hardened unit gained distinction through over a decade of fierce engagements.
[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Style:[/h3]
[list]
[*]
The Silla Guards are an elite national defense force armed with square shields and long spears. They can use their shields for effective ranged defense when setting up brace formations and throw them to stun enemies in close combat. Coordinating with allies, they enhance melee engagement efficiency—holding firm to secure their lines or advancing to break enemy formations. They also leverage the reach of their spears, delivering powerful strikes to repel melee infantry units, making them invaluable for choke-point defense and team advancement.
[/*][/list]
[h3]Unit Characteristics：[/h3]
[list]
[*]
A polearm infantry unit clad in heavy black armor, offering balanced attack and defense.
[/*][*]
Utilizes shields for defensive duties, providing better coordination for both defense and offensive pushes.
[/*][*]
Well-timed shield throws and spear strikes maximize their reach advantage.
[/*][/list]
[h3]Skill Design：[/h3]
Skill 1 Shield Throw: Throws shields at enemies, slightly extending attack range beyond the spear, dealing blunt damage. The shield is destroyed upon impact.
Skill 2 Spear Slam: Strikes targets with a spear to prevent enemy units from closing in. If the shield is destroyed, an additional attack is performed.
 
[h2]4-Star Unit: Tiger Fists[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/936ee9b1497268a6a749b19fed7a7884b46cd8c0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Background:[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Silla had a martial art passed down among the people, granting those who mastered it the ability to subdue tigers even barehanded. Masters of this art often lived in seclusion within the mountains, only emerging to serve their country in times of war. Yet, after victory, they sought no reward, returning to the mountains. The world revered them as the Tiger Fists.
[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Style:[/h3]
[list]
[*]
The [b]Tiger Fists[/b] do not rely on weapons in battle. Through years of rigorous training, their bare fists alone are enough to subdue even the fiercest tiger. Their punches were capable of splitting stones. Their momentum is unstoppable. They excel at breaking enemy formations with powerful charges and strikes, yet their resilience allows them to remain steadfast despite enemy assaults.
[/*][/list]
[h3]Unit Characteristics：[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Masters of close-quarters combat, entering the battlefield at the right moment to destroy enemies.
[/*][*]
Their skills can deal massive damage and exert control over enemies in crowded fights.
[/*][*]
Their formidable physique and unyielding will reduce incoming damage and grant resistance to certain control effects.
[/*][/list]
[h3]Skill Design：[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Skill 1 Courage Charge: Charges forward in a short burst, ignoring control effects. The charge also ignores block and knocks down enemies.
[/*][*]
Skill 2 Tiger’s Fury: Swiftly closes in on a target and unleashes a two-round punch combo.
[/*][*]
Skill 3 Mighty Slap: The next attack is a powerful, fully-charged palm strike with high block-breaking capability, knocking back enemies upon impact.
[/*][/list]
 
[h2]5-Star Unit: Hwarang[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fa2cc827c4c60834b6435bbdfa24a1c2da8a7355.jpg[/img]

[h3]Background:[/h3]
[list]
[*]
The King of Silla selected noble youths of distinguished lineage, instructing them in the classics, training them in archery, and adorning them in elegant attire. Ever at the King’s side, they were known as the Hwarang—elite warriors who followed their ruler into battle, their arrows never missing their target, earning them the title of the nation’s finest.
[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Style:[/h3]
[list]
[*]
These noble youths from Silla are anything but sheltered aristocrats. Armed with bows, they are masters of archery, using their agility and keen adaptability to navigate ever-changing battlefields. They can convert damage dealt into health, enhancing their survivability in battles. Additionally, they can continuously adjust their position while shooting—retreating swiftly when at a disadvantage and relentlessly pursuing enemies when victorious. Graceful and swift, courageous and determined, they fight for their homeland without fear or hesitation.
[/*][/list]
[h3]Unit Characteristics：[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Agile and versatile archers, utilizing advanced archery techniques to adapt to complex battle conditions.
[/*][*]
Rapid learners in combat, growing stronger the longer they fight on the battlefield.
[/*][*]
A ranged unit that combines strong survival capabilities with a high skill ceiling.
[/*][/list]
[h3]Skill Design：[/h3]
[list]
[*]
Skill 1：Flying Petals (During the skill’s duration, each successful hit on an enemy can restores health.)
[list]
[*]
Flying Petals - Enhanced (During the skill’s duration, any excess healing beyond the maximum limit gained from damaging enemies is converted into a shield)
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Skill 2：Windstep (After selecting a direction, the Hwarang rolls forward and shoots in that direction, up to two rolls.)
[list]
[*]
Windstep - Enhanced (Increases the number of rolls performed by [b]+1[/b].)
[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h1]II. Limited-Time Return of the Onslaught Mode![/h1]
[b]Access:[/b]

[b]Details:[/b]

  Battle Rules:
    (1) Bring a unit that can be operated by heroes to participate in the battle.
    (2) The battle is divided into multiple rounds, each round consisting of a [Deployment Phase] and a [Battle Phase].
    (3) At the start of the [Deployment Phase], all units and hero's statuses are reset (fully restored), and a certain amount of leadership are provided as funds. During the [Deployment Phase], players can consume leadership to deploy or upgrade units. The [Battle Phase] begins once deployment is complete.
    (4) During the [Battle Phase], if one side's units are entirely defeated, that round ends and the next round's [Deployment Phase] begins.

  Victory Conditions:
    Both sides have a certain amount of [Morale]. At the end of each round, the losing side will have their [Morale] deducted. If the enemy's [Morale] reach zero, the player wins the game. Conversely, if the player's [Morale] reach zero, the game is lost.
    Talent System:
      Complete an Onslaught battle to earn [Talent Points]. Spend [Talent Points] to unlock new abilities that aid in completing the game.

    Formation System:
      Units deployed during the [Deployment Phase] carry several [Formations]. When enough units with the same [Formation] are on the field, the [Formation] effect is triggered.

    Tactics System:
      Unlock tactics in the talent system. After unlocking tactics, there will be an opportunity to choose a tactic at the start of specific rounds' deployment phases. Tactics have powerful effects that can enhance your overall strength.

    Economy System:
      There is a maximum limit on the number of units that can be deployed on our side, which increases with the number of rounds.


  [b]Rewards:[/b]
  Complete weekly limited-time tasks to receive [Conqueror's Gold]. Use [Conqueror's Gold] to exchange for numerous rare rewards in the [Conqueror Vault] such as [Pure Wisdom], [Treatise], [Epic Wisdom], [Limited-Time Doctrine Selection Chest], and more.
  [b]Time:[/b]
  January 24, 2025 (after maintenance) - February 13, 2025 (before maintenance). Purchase of [Conqueror's Gold] will open on February 7th at midnight.
  Open all day.

notes.title: [Sparta] Season Update Log
notes.notes:
[h1]I. New Weapon - Shield & Spear[/h1]
Core Mechanism
- Use sidesteps to adjust positioning, raise your shield, and always face the enemy head-on.
- Gauge the distance between you and the enemy, looking for the right moment to perform a sidestep attack, which will protect you while striking the enemy.
- Combine sidestep attacks, sprint attacks, and active skills to quickly unleash the final segment of the Normal Attack.
- Accumulate rage through blocking and attacking, then unleash the [Spartan Kick].

Class Traits:
- Sidestep
  - This hero has two evasion methods: Roll and Sidestep
    - In normal state, the evasion method is Roll
    - In defensive state, the evasion method is Sidestep. During Sidestep, the hero remains in defensive state
    - After Sidestepping, left-click to directly release the fourth segment of the Normal Attack
  
- Shield Defense
  - Defensive Effects: 
    Successfully blocking prevents being pushed back, knocked down, or knocked away.
  - Buff Effects: 
    Successfully blocking grants 40 rage points.
  - Node: Fury Stance
    - Rage gained from successful blocks increases by 20%.

- Counterattack
  - Base Effect:
    While in shielded state, attack targets. Each hit on an enemy unit grants 15 rage points.
  - Node: War Steps
    - Reduces stamina consumption for sidesteps and sidestep attacks by 25%.
  - Node: Frenzy of Rage
    - Ignore collision when sidestepping to the left, right, or backward.

Skill Description:
- Normal Attack:
  - Four stages; the final stage attack is immune to daze, deals increased damage, and accumulates more rage.

- Aegis Retribution:
  - Base Effect:
    - Cooldown: 16 seconds; deals blunt damage; pressing it again deals blunt damage and stuns the enemy.
  - Control Removal Effect:
    - Releases the skill to remove dazed and knockdown effects.
  - Buff Effect:
    - If the block is successful, block recovery rate is increased by 100% for 5 seconds; each hit on an enemy unit grants 30 rage points.
  - Node: Vow of the Hunt
    - The second stage of the Aegis Retribution increases the damage the enemy receives by 20% for 4 seconds.

- Ares' Cleave
  - Base Effect:
    - Cooldown time: 16 seconds; deals 123% base + 477 blunt damage; pressing it a second time deals 178% base + 1558 slashing damage.
  - Buff Effect:
    - Each hit on an enemy hero grants 30 rage points.
  - Node: Breathing Control:
    - Reduces the cooldown of Ares' Cleave by 2 seconds.
  - Node: Divine Punishment

notes.title: December 19 Update Log
notes.notes:
Greetings, Warlords!
[b]We will conduct maintenance updates during the following times:[/b]
[b]APAC: December 19, 00:00 - 15:00 (UTC+8)[/b]
[b]EU/AMS: December 18, 17:00 - December 19, 8:00 (UTC+1)[/b]
[b]The maintenance is expected to last for 15 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins *35000, Honor *1500, and Unit Medal *75 as compensation. Warlords, please arrange your playtime accordingly. [/b]
[b]The update will contain the following:[/b]
 
[h2]I. [Arabian Nights][b] Returns with New Rewards![/b][/h2]
A fantastical world with the brightest colors. [Arabian Nights] returns with a fresh update, and by participating in the event, you have a chance to earn the new exclusive attire for the Sunward Phalanx!

[b]Info[/b][b]:[/b]

[list]
[*]
Warlords will play a Bingo game on a 12x7 board. Upon successfully completing a row or column, you will receive corresponding rewards. Each time you unlock a row or column, the progress bar will light up. When the progress reaches certain levels, cumulative rewards will be given.
[*]
The lighting up process consists of [Random Lighting] and [Directional Lighting]:
[list]
[*]
[Random Lighting] lights up 5 random areas (may overlap, and each lighting action grants a few Silver Coins).
[*]
[Directional Lighting] allows you to select a specific area to light up.
[/list]
[*]
Warlords can earn [Random Lighting] points by completing daily tasks, or directly purchase [Random Lighting] points using Sovereigns.
[*]
If a random area that has already been lit up is selected, 1 [Directional Lighting] point will be awarded. 50 [Directional Lighting] points are required for 1 directional lighting.
[*]
There are 3 daily tasks. Each day at midnight, a free task refresh will be available (it will not accumulate). The task panel needs to be manually refreshed. Additional refreshes require Sovereigns, and each refresh will increase in price. A maximum of 3 paid refreshes can be made daily.
[*]
The event will last for three weeks. During the fourth week, tasks cannot be completed, but unused points can still be used for lighting up, or you can directly purchase [Random Lighting] actions using Sovereigns.
[*]
After the event ends, any unused points will be automatically reclaimed.
[/list]

[b]Rewards Overview:[/b]
Includes the [Sunward Phalanx] exclusive unit attire [Fairytale Guard], [Treatise], [Illusionist Key], [Crate of Epic Equipment] (Binded), [Pure Wisdom], and other rewards.
[b]Event Time:[/b]
Daily task completion time: 12/19 after maintenance - 01/09, 00:00
Event duration: 12/19 after maintenance - 01/16 before maintenance.
[img]https://cdn.boomingtech.com/upload_img/78ad2b4c804beac4c586f6b2729c769a.jpg[/img]
[h2]II. Limited Time Return of Ice Cold Colosseum![/h2]

[b]Intro:[/b]

[list]
[*]
Victory Rules:
[list]
[*]
Each side starts with 13 resources. Whenever a player's Hero or Vanguard Hero is defeated, 1 resource is lost. If either side loses all resources, their BOSS will appear. The side that defeats the enemy BOSS will win the final victory.
[/list]
[*]
BOSS:
[list]
[*]
When only one side's BOSS appears, it will stay at the back of the battlefield. When both BOSSes are present, they will move in phases toward the center of the battlefield.
[/list]
[*]
Units:
[list]
[*]
Units in this mode are provided by the system. When a player is defeated, all units earned are lost, and three new random units are granted. Upon revival, only the units on the field are kept, while others are lost.
[/list]
[*]
Chests:
[list]
[*]
When a Hero or Vanguard Hero is defeated, a chest will drop. The player who collects the chest will receive an additional random unit and a 30-second maximum health boost. Before the BOSS appears, collecting chests will also boost the BOSS’s health.
[/list]
[*]
Easter Egg:
[list]
[*]
Players who collect a chest have a chance to receive a new magical unit.
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Event Time:[/b]
12/19 after maintenance - 01/02 before maintenance.
Daily timeslot can be viewed in [J] - [Battle] - [Activity].
 
[h2][b]III. Obey the Call of Destiny! Elite Troops Await! Free Max-Level Units![/b][/h2]
Embarking on the path to greatness is no easy feat. Even the mightiest Warlords require fearless warriors to aid them! A brand-new rewards event is now live! Several elite armies have come forth in honor of the Warlord’s name.
[b]Intro:[/b]
During the event, all Warlords will receive a [Volunteer Unit Trial Card] (7 days) and [Blessing] (7 days) to kickstart the new Season with ease and success!
Complete the event quests to recruit one max-level unit from five 4-Star units in the Unit Tree. These units are among the most popular and frequently used in high-Stage Ranked Battles. (Includes: [Palace Guards], [Imperial Pike Guards], [Men-at-Arms], [Imperial Archers], and [Prefecture Heavy Cavalry])
Warlords who purchase the [Sparta] Battle Pass will gain an even greater advantage, as they can freely recruit one max-level unit from three 5-Star units in the Unit Tree! (Includes: [Iron Reapers], [Winged Hussars], and [Shenji Grenadiers])
[b]Event Time:[/b]
12/19 after maintenance - 01/09 23:59
[b]Event Requirements:[/b]
Available to all Warlords of Level 9 and above.
 
[h2]IV. New Season Sign-In Event, Get Plenty of Valuable Resources by Logging In![/h2]
Raise your shield, grip your spear! The new Shield & Spear weapon is now officially available. Sign in to receive crafting resources and help create legendary weapons!
[b]Event Time:[/b]
12/19 after maintenance - 01/09 before maintenance.
 
[h2]V. Smuggler’s Treasure Returns![/h2]
Spartan warriors have plundered wealth from the battlefield, and the mysterious Iron Fire Consortium has moved some of it to the Auctioneers. Warlords can visit NPC - [Smuggler] - [Exotic Goods] to make purchases.

  Weekly Purchase Limit: 50

[h1][b]I. Events[/b][/h1]

[b]Info:[/b]
