[h1][b]II. Adjustments and Optimizations[/b][/h1]
[h3]1. [Lionfire] Season Settlement[/h3]
[Lionfire] Season is coming to an end, with season settlement scheduled after the maintenance on 12/5. Please log in promptly after maintenance to claim your rewards and avoid expiration.

Changes after season settlement (details can be checked via [O] - [Events]):

  (1) [Ranked Battles]
    12/4 will be the final day for ranked battles this season. Ranked battles will be suspended from 12/5 until the new season begins.

  (2) [Territory War]
    There was the last Territory War affecting season settlement on 11/30. The Territory War on 12/3 was replaced by [Drill War].
    Territory War will reopen after season settlement on 12/5.

  (3) [Server Transfer]
    The server transfer reservation system for the new season will open after maintenance on 12/5 and will be available until the new season starts. Detailed transfer rules and available servers can be checked via [ESC] - [Account Service] - [Season Server Reservation].

[h3]2. Adjustments Related to Territory War & House[/h3]
(1) During Territory War, the [Unit Resupply] and [Replenish Food] functions of Border Forts will be unavailable, similar to the rules of the Wayside Inns.

(2) Improved the display of the front list on the Map page for the [Legion].

  Attack List
    Only shows siege fronts opened by the rallying units obtaining Command Authority. This front is allowed for quick joining.

  Defense List
    Shows the fronts where friendly NPC forces' fiefs are under attack. This front is allowed for instant joining.
    Also shows fronts where rallying units are pursued while moving or attacked during camping. This front is not allowed for instant joining.

(3) Optimized the behavior and distribution of AI defending units of fiefs in Territory War.
(4) Overall increased the strength of AI defending units of fiefs in Territory War, with strength scaling up as the fief level increases.
(5) Two-star units can join the house's shared units after unlocking all mastery.
 
[h1][b]III. [/b][b]UI[/b][b]&[/b][b]UX[/b][b] Optimizations[/b][/h1]
(1) Optimized the interaction layout of the [Season Challenge], making it more convenient to view other seasons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/70656d464128c1f23bc1d7126341164ed6e65557.jpg[/img]
 
(2) Added a capacity percentage display to the wagon and warehouse capacity indicators.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/844a1b7b5befd0f2e136b913b8eb6455f2cba839.jpg[/img]
 
(3) Optimized the display of the [L] - [Quests] when there are no quests available.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/505831f48e30c047aae832d947eb9c8274bb5f62.jpg[/img]
 
(4) Enhanced the purchasing experience in the system shop by adding quantity input and adjustment features.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e01309c7eb8a6d147d65dd64ded608f33953477c.jpg[/img]
 
(5) Optimized the reward display for the [Marching Orders], making it easier to understand the reward at a glance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cbb1994b99b55e9f4d1abc7396ff1bee6c20a08e.jpg[/img]
 
(6) Added the function for party members to follow the leader or leave the party by right-clicking on the leader while in the open world. Also, party members cannot pursue players in the same party.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3db94d54033b8084c1c4f455cc729c2d4a09cf84.jpg[/img]
 
(7) Added a text limit reminder for the House Notice and Announcement and increased the display range of text.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/003adf2a164347a1da792c8233a7d12ba1b15e60.jpg[/img]
 
(8) Optimized some item icons to make them easier to be recognized.
(9) Fixed the bug where the Mastery of units was not displayed correctly in the [Open World] and [Free Battles] tabs of the [Warband Builds].
(10) Enhanced the guidance UI for beginners by adding mouse feedback effects and expanding interaction ranges for smoother operation.
(11) Improved the experience of excavating the Conqueror's Reckoning: When there are Ancient Treatises in the inventory, the corresponding doctrine pool will appear in the War Scholar interface. Additionally, the required drawing times of the Conqueror's Reckoning were adjusted from 20 to 10.
(12) Added a plus sign prompt for the selection location of artillery at supply points and the respawn UI during battles.
(13) Optimized the unreasonable interaction ranges of some UI components to prevent them from obstructing mouse movement.
(14) Fixed a batch of misaligned UI elements and inconsistencies in text content.
 
[h1][b]III. Bugs fixed and Other Optimizations[/b][/h1]
(1) In the [Custom Lobbies], you can now adjust whether artillery is consumed in the room settings, which is by default set to not consume.
(2) Fixed the issue where the daily [Test Your Skills] and [First Victory] quests cannot be completed in Deathmatch.
(3) The name of the active skill [Charge] of [Sipahis] has been standardized for different language, with no impact on the actual effect.
(4) Fixed the issue where the control-effect-immunity of the [Titanic Physique] rune did not apply to dismounted attacks.

notes.title: November 14 Update Log
notes.notes:
Greetings, Warlords!
We will conduct maintenance updates during the following:
APAC: November 14, 14:00-17:00 (UTC+8)
EU/AMS: November 14, 7:00-10:00 (UTC+1)
The maintenance is expected to last for 3 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins*8000, Honor*300, and Unit Medal*15 as compensation. Warlords, please arrange your playtime accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

I. Events

1. [All or Nothing] Event Returns. Fight to Win the Exclusive Lionfire Season Weapon Attire!
Info:
Stars can be earned by winning consecutive battles in the All or Nothing event. Losing will clear stars earned back to zero. Earn stars to increase your Treasure Trove's quality:
    (1) 1 star: Iron Treasure Trove
    (2) 2 stars: Silver Treasure Trove
    (3) 3 stars: Gold Treasure Trove

Your first Gold Treasure Trove is bound to give you a Season Weapon Attire Selection Box.

Protection Charm will protect you from losing your stars upon defeat.
Protection Charm: Use them in the deployment stage to prevent losing stars upon defeat. This item is consumed if it takes effect, but returned to you if you win the battle.
This time, All or Nothing will adopt a "Leadership Return" mode. No Leadership returns when your units die, and 50% Leadership of the Remaining Forces returns when your units retreat. All units are available for you to deploy except for Lionfire Season Units, Chevaliers, and Falconetti Gunners.

Additional Rules:
    (1) Equipment, Units, and Artillery are all pre-provided. In this All or Nothing, the equipment for heroes is reforged.
    (2) The leadership of each hero is set at 1800.
    (3) The attacking side can deploy 2 Rare Artillery, while the defending side can deploy 1 Rare Artillery.

Greetings, Warlords!
[b]We will conduct maintenance updates from 08:00-11:30 on September 12th (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to last for 3.5 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins*8000, Honor*400 and Unit Medal*20 as compensation. Warlords, please arrange your playtime accordingly. [/b]
[b]The update will contain the following:[/b]
 
[h1][b]I. Events[/b][/h1]
[h3]1. Doctrine Pool Rotation[/h3]
[b]Info:[/b]
[Bold Advance] is now available. In [Bold Advance], the chance to excavate epic melee cavalry doctrines is increased.
[b]Time:[/b]
9/12 after maintenance - 9/29 before maintenance
 
[h1][b]II. Adjustments and Optimizations[/b][/h1]
[h3]1. [b]Transfer[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]
After a successful transfer request for the season reservation, the transfer will take place during the maintenance of the new season. After the transfer, items and resources in the inventory, supply dump, wagons and resource piles will be automatically transferred to the new server [b](excluding items and resources within the Auctioneers)[/b].
[/*]
[*]
During the transfer, it is not possible to carry items and resources that have been listed by the [Auctioneers], as well as unclaimed items and resource piles. [b]It is advised to empty the Auctioneers before maintenance to avoid any losses.[/b]
[/*]
[*]
In order to minimize potential losses caused by the issues above, [b]the item listing function for the Auctioneers will be temporarily disabled from September 12 (after the maintenance) until September 19 (before the next maintenance). During this period, the purchase, removal, and resource pile collection of items already listed will not be affected.[/b]
[/*]
[/list]
[h1][b]III. Bug Fixed and Optimizations[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]
Fixed the issue of abnormal task redirection in [Greeting of Beacon].
[/*]
[*]
Fixed the issue where players may use mortal artillery remaining in Eagle Eye view when they switch to the Eagle Eye view during the process of taking over the Artillery.
[/*]
[*]
Optimized the effect description of the doctrine [Artemis] (without changing the current actual effect).
[/*]
[*]
Fixed the issue of the abnormal outline and shadows of high-tier [Blazing Plumes] attire.
[/*]
[*]
Fixed the issue of the overlapped text effects of heroes' emote action [Divination].
[/*]
[*]
Fixed the issue where the battering ram could not break the city gate of Abrivia in the Territory War.
[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: September 5 Update Log
notes.notes:
Greetings, Warlords!
[b]We will conduct maintenance updates from 08:00-12:30 on September 5th (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to last for 4.5 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins*10000, Honor*500, and Unit Medal*25 as compensation. Warlords, please arrange your playtime accordingly. [/b]
[b]The update will contain the following:[/b]
 
[h1][b]I. Events[/b][/h1]
[h3]1. [Lionfire] Season is coming. Preorder the New Season Pass Now![/h3]
[b]Info:[/b]
The new Season Pass will be available after maintenance on 9/5. You can press [C] to purchase the Season Preorder Pack.
Preorder Pack involves extra rewards such as Treatises and Battle Pass EXP. [u]It can also[/u] unlock [Chivalric Oath] events and the new season 3-star unit [Reitar Pistoleers] in advance!
[b]Time:[/b]
9/5 after maintenance - 9/19 before maintenance
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a4a4860ac097ff12cce764e9815ba04cbf20408e.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=kwXjcuvSDnE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]2. Preorder the New Season Pass, Unlock [Chivalric Oath], and Get the New Season Unit for Free![/h3]
[b]Info:[/b]
By preordering the [Lionfire] Season Pass and completing the [Chivalric Oath] challenges, you will be granted [Reitar Pistoleers] Unlock Order * 2. After the new season begins on 9/19, you can immediately get the new season 3-star unit.


[b]Rules:[/b]

[list]
[*]
Open [Chivalric Oath] via [O] - [Activities].
[/*]
[*]
You can unlock part of the [Chivalric Oath] rewards for free during the event. Preordering the new Season Pass allows you to unlock entire rewards.
[/*]
[*]
During the event, you can obtain exp and increase your [Chivalric Oath] level by completing [Daily Request]. The higher level of [Chivalric Oath] grants you more generous rewards.
[/*]
[*]
The new [Daily Request] unlocks at midnight each day and is available during the event.
[/*]
[/list]


[b]Time:[/b]
9/5 after maintenance - 9/19 before maintenance
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b0d206e13f471bc8e30dec256fb96935e64ccb83.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]3. New Recall&Recruitment Event "Gather to Beacon"[/b][/h3]
Participate in the "Gather to the Beacon" event and win plentiful rewards!


[b]Info:[/b]

[list]
[*]
Everyone can be the recruiter and receive rewards including universal Pay-off Vouchers, Treatises and Epic Hero Schematic Crates when the recruited players finish quests.
[/*]
[*]
[New players] and [returning players] who are recruited will have different quests with rich rewards.
[/*]
[*]
Each account can only have one character participating in the event, and the rewards are limited to that character only. Each account can only receive the rewards once.
[/*]
[*]
Each account can recruit up to 10 players including returning players and new players.
[/*]
[*]
After the event ends, the event items will no longer trigger any quests and all uncompleted quests will be removed.
[/*]
[/list]

[b]Requirements to be Recruited[/b]

[list]
[*]
The accounts [u]that have[/u] not logged in since [b]8/6, 2024, 00:00[/b] can join in the [Greeting of Beacon] event.
[/*]
[*]
The accounts that were created after [b]9/5, 2024, 00:00[/b] or [u]have not[/u] created any character can join in the [Recalling of Beacon] event.
[/*]
[/list]


[b]Event Entrance:[/b]

[list]
[*]
[b]Check the details in the [O] - [Recommended] - [[/b][b]Gather to Beacon[/b][b]] interface.[/b]
[/*]
[/list]


[b]Time:[/b]

[list]
[*]
Time for completing quests and claiming rewards: [b]9/5, 2024 after maintenance - 10/8, 2024, 00:00 (UTC+8)[/b]
[/*]
[*]
Rewards will be distributed via mail with a validity period of 30 days and cannot be claimed if expiring.
[/*]
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b60c5e994efd3d92125e6895080c08f585b79a04.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bb905b6bdebd2db47b129a387ec3c567ce1671dd.jpg[/img]
[h3]4. Attire Treasure Rotation[/h3]
[b]Info:[/b]
[Hero's Return] & [Cinder Lotus] Attire Treasure are now available! Hero Attire [Embroidered Uniform Officer] & Legendary Nodachi Attire [Akuma's Claw] are now back for a limited time!
[b]Time:[/b]
9/5 after maintenance - 9/19 before maintenance
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b72ac45a2cb2c468f4892965675674b74f28fe91.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6cb19989bab60dcd74dfc6e338d13f6bab9b4c41.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]II. Adjustments and Optimizations[/b][/h1]


[h3][b]1. Season Settlement[/b][/h3]

  [b]Territory War & Ranked Battle[/b]
[list]
[*]
After the maintenance on September 5th, there will be a season settlement for [Territory War] & [Ranked Battles] of the [Alexander] Season. Please log in promptly after maintenance to claim the rewards. After the maintenance for the new season, the rewards will expire.
[/*]
[*]
[Territory War] will remain open from the day of season settlement to the maintenance day of the new season, when [Military Exercise] will be closed instead. The time slot will remain the same.

The exchange limit for items in the [Empire's Treasury] will reset after the maintenance.
[/*]

[h3][b]2. [/b][b]Transfer[/b][/h3]

[list]

[/*]

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c4676d613bf3afda9c3aa11e0fa09b9120b55117.gif[/img]


[h3][b]4. Other Adjustments[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*]
Adjustments have been made to the rewards for the Recall Sign-In and Recall Treasuries for returning players after the maintenance on September 5th.
[/*]
[/list]


[h1][b]III. Bug Fixed and Optimizations[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]
Fixed the issue where activating the unit training node [Shield Bash] of [Palace Guards] would result in the missing damage effects of [Shield Bash] action.
[/*]
[*]
Fixed the issue where the [Health Drain] effect was not calculated in the Combat Dismount skill of the Nodachi weapon.
[/*]
[*]
Fixed the issue where Ballista artillery would obstruct Ally's projectile.
[/*]
[*]
Fixed the issue where the low-health sound effects of heroes in the main city would not disappear.
[/*]
[*]
Optimized the visual effects of the [Weapon Dance] skill influence of the Poleaxe.
[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: August 29 Update Log
notes.notes:
Greetings, Warlords!
[b]We will conduct maintenance updates from 08:00-11:30 on August 29th (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to last for 3.5 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins*8000, Honor*400, and Unit Medal*20 as compensation. Warlords, please arrange your playtime accordingly. [/b]
[b]The update will contain the following:[/b]
 
[h1][b]I. Events[/b][/h1]
[h3][b]1. Warfare Pack[/b][b]: Challenge Pack[/b][b] Rotation [/b][/h3]
[b]Info:[/b]
In [Store] - [Warfare Pack], [Wrath of the Nomads], [Soldiers of Fortune] and [Blood of the Empire] Challenge Packs are unavailable. [Expedition], [Snowstorm] and [Northmen] Challenge Packs are for sale.
 
[b]Time:[/b]
08/29 after maintenance - 09/19 before maintenance.
 
[h1][b]II. Adjustments and Optimizations[/b][/h1]


[h3]Unit Mastery System[/h3]

  [b]Vassal Longbowmen[/b]
  Info:
    Node 1: increases Piercing Armor Penetration by 80 points
    Node 2: increases health by 420
    Node 3: increases piercing damage by 40
      Node 4: increases health by 450
      [b]Node 5: [Steel Spike Arrow][/b]
        Hitting a target unit with [Normal Ammunition] & [Overwatch] will reduce the target's movement speed by 25% with the effect doubled against cavalry. It also increases the rate of fire by 30%, lasting for 10 seconds.

      Node 6: increases shooting accuracy of [Covering Fire] by 50%.
      Node 7: deals an additional 400 piercing damage with [Normal Ammunition] & [Overwatch] against Ranged Infantry.
      [b]Node 8: [Wall of Agincourt][/b]
        [Normal Ammunition] & [Overwatch] hitting a unit consecutively within 5 seconds will increase the damage dealt from Vassal Longbowmen by up to 40%. The effect doubles on cavalry.



  [b]Sipahis[/b]
  Info:
    Node 1: increases slashing defense by 60.
    Node 2: increases piercing defense by 60.
      Node 3: increases blunt damage by 80.
      Node 4: increases movement speed by 8%.
      [b]Node 5: [Steel Riders][/b]
        [Croupade] increases damage and damage reduction by 5% for each enemy hit; stack up to 5 times, last for 5s.

      Node 6: increases armor penetration against shield infantry by 400
      Node 7: reduces damage from shield infantry by 300
      [b]Node 8: [Glory of Empire][/b]
        [Impassioned] will cause the enemies within range concussed for 1.5 seconds






[h1][b]III. Bug Fixed and Optimizations[/b][/h1]

1.Fixed the occasional issue of abnormal display of assist points in the [Unit Details] interface during battlefield settlement.

2.Fixed the incorrect skill icons for certain firearm units in the [U] interface.

3.Fixed the problem where the advancement of building materials in certain servers failed to increase upon completion of Fief Quests.

4.Fixed the abnormal visual effects of the Legendary Dual Blades Attire [Thunder Strike] in Stealth status.

5.Optimized the display effects of the male character wearing the "Laird of the Isles", "Laird of the Isles (Glory)" and "Laird of the Isles (Azure)" attires.

[h3]Greetings, Warlords! [/h3]

We will conduct maintenance updates from 08:00-11:30 on July 11th Beijing time (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to last for 3 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute Bronze Coins*8000, Honor*300, and Unit Medal*15 as compensation. Warlords, please arrange your play time accordingly. 

The update will contain the following: 


[h2]I. EVENT [/h2]

[h3]1. Brand-New Siege Map-Mystara Castle![/h3]

Nestled within mountains lies a thousand-year-old fortress. From the ancient Aegean city-states' wars to the sacred Crusades, its outer walls have been baptized by iron and fire countless times. Numerous heroes perished, countless empires vied, yet the castle still stands tall, much like a old veteran, mocking the ambitious who were thirsty for his blood.
As the battles in the "Alexander" season heat up, we're excited to introduce a brand new siege map for our Warlords- Mystara Castle! 

[b]Map Intro:[/b]

Mystara Castle is situated in a gorge surrounded by mountains, leaving the southwest and southeast gap to resist enemies. Throughout history, attackers often focus their main attack on the lowlands to the southwest of the castle. notes.title: [Alexander] Update Log
notes.notes:
[h2]1) Season Units[/h2]

[h3]Psiloi Slingers (3 Stars)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c10e9e3e0743e034932b36fa757b2cdf3536c0e2.jpg[/img]

[b]Back Story[/b]

   "The island of Rhodes, located on the Aegean Sea, with its important strategic position, has always been the object of ambition for aspiring nations. Throughout its long history of resisting foreign invasions, the resilient and intelligent residents of Rhodes have developed a unique form of warfare, the art of stone throwing: with just a pile of rocks and a roughly made sling, farmers, craftsmen, and even frail shepherds can transform into powerful warriors capable of killing enemies from hundreds of feet away in wars.

  Initially, the noble generals and kings looked down upon this "peasant" strategy. Only the Conqueror recognized the potential of this tactic. He incorporated the stone-throwers of Rhodes into his army. The great battle that took place in Chaeronea proved the wisdom of the king. In this ultimate battle between Macedonia and Persia, the stone-throwers invoked the name of the sun god, hurling a myriad of stones towards the enemy. The proud elite Immortals of the Persian Empire found themselves cornered and ultimately defeated by this army composed of commoners. After the war, the Conqueror collectively bestowed upon this legion the title of heroes. In an era where lineage meant everything, they, with humble origins, became the heroes of a great conquering age."

[b]Battle Style[/b]

      They are the stone-throwers from Rhodes, dressed simply in coarse cloth and straw hats, carrying a bag of stones, wielding shields and slingshots. Their primary attack method is stone-throwing, using slingshots to hurl stones with force. This technique allows them to inflict significant armor-piercing damage at close to medium range, with a chance to stun enemy units. Moreover, the resilient and clever stone-throwers of Rhodes are well-versed in the art of stone-throwing, able to turn nearby pebbles into weapons at any moment to replenish their ammunition.

[b]Unit Characteristics:[/b]
[list]
[*] Able to replenish ammo at anywhere. Stuns enemies from afar and deals high burst damage when close.
[/list]
[b]Skills:：[/b]
[list]
[*] Skill 1: Attack Area (Begins firing in the designated area.)
[*] Skill 2: Say "Cheese" (Shakes their slingshots and fires in unison, dealing greater damage than normal attacks with a higher chance to stun.)
[*] Skill 3: Quarry (Squats down to quarry and replenish ammo.)
[/list]
[h3]Companion Cavalry (4 Stars)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/baa1a325935a5e7de9ca651c1f75b38474ccfcb7.jpg[/img]

[b]Back Story[/b]

       "By the side of the kings of Macedonia often stand guards known as "Companions," noble-born and fiercely loyal. The kings view them not just as subordinates, but as brothers-in-arms. Each "Companion" of a Macedonian king will follow their king anywhere, until the king passes or the last drop of blood is shed.

  The majority of the "Companion" cavalry are born of nobility, hence they often bear the finest equipment: riding swift steeds, wielding the lethal lance, and resorting to sharp swords once their lances are broken in combat. Under the banner of the conquering king, these units become an unparalleled elite force, playing a pivotal role on the battlefield. Poets have likened the king's tactics to a "hammer and anvil": if the infantry units holding the line in a tug-of-war with the enemy are the "anvil," the Companion cavalry are the "hammer," swooping in to exploit enemies' weaknesses and shattering them in a single charge. After several rounds of hammer strikes, even the mightiest of foes will crumble. In the grand Eastern conquest, this legion has accompanied the conquering king all the way to the ends of the world, beyond the farthest reaches of the sea."

[b]Battle Style[/b]

  They are the most loyal companions of Alexander, playing a crucial role in his tactics. Often launching flank attacks on enemy formations with the king, they draw immense inspiration simply by being by his side, enhancing their combat abilities significantly.
he Companions Cavalry are also highly skilled in guerrilla tactics, utilizing dual weapons to adapt to various battle scenarios. Their exceptional flexibility allows them to engage at the right moment, creating significant advantages for their side with their high burst damage.

[b]Unit Characteristics:[/b]
[list]
[*] A highly mobile light cavalry with low defense.
[*] Works great when striking with the hero in guerilla-like attacks.
[*] Deals sustained damage while using their short swords and draws close to the hero, waiting for the opportune moment to strike.
[/list]
[b]Skills[/b]

[b]Skills[/b]
[b]Spear:[/b]
[list]
[*] Skill 1: Gale Strike (Revolves their spears and stabs at the enemy, dealing high damage.)
[*] Skill 2: Storm Pound (Leaps from their mounts and strikes with their spears from the air. May knock enemy units down.)
[/list]
[b]Short Sword:[/b]
[list]
[*] Skill 1: Zephyr Blade (Remains on guard, striking at anyone who draws close to the hero.)
[/list]

[h3]Sunward Phalanx (5 Stars)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cbdc2149bbd1d142fc1c2a4930c8d0626c29cf6a.jpg[/img]

[b]Back Story[/b]

      "The father of the Conqueror, the former ruler of Macedonia, created a new legionary tactic, known as the Macedonian phalanx: warriors clad in heavy armor, wielding long spears, formed an unstoppable phalanx and advanced. The Conqueror further elevated this legionary tactic to its pinnacle: he commissioned the creation of spears longer than people of that time could imagine. When warriors equipped with these long spears formed their lines and pointed their spearheads towards the enemy, the very nature of war was fundamentally altered. War ceased to be a game of individual valor and became a unified front of thousands. The clash transformed, inexorably consuming and dispersing the enemy like scattered troops and mercenaries. Stirring battle cries turned into subdued commands, as even the most skilled and valiant warriors found attacking such a formation akin to striking a mountain or the vast sea.
   This highly effective strategy aided the Conqueror in vanquishing all his foes. On the battlefield, his units stood like a silent mountain, slowly advancing towards the enemy. The figure of the emperor before the formation thus became immensely towering, bowing seemingly as the sole choice to this great monarch."

[b]Battle Style[/b]

       Wearing the iconic style helmets, linen cuirasses, and leather kilts, the finest warriors of Macedonia wielded spears of extraordinary length, their arms secured by large round shields, advancing in an indomitable phalanx formation. Shielded by their round shields, they stood fearless against attacks from afar. Following the king's command, they could adopt the phalanx formation, moving steadily back and forth with their long spears, continuously compressing the enemy's lines. 

[b]Unit Characteristics:[/b]
[list]
[*] Through skillful manipulation of the distance from the enemy, Macedonia could evade harm while seizing the opportune moment on the ever-changing battlefield, swiftly penetrating for the kill!
[/list]

[b]Skills[/b]

Skill 1：
[list]
[*]  Imperial Spears (The Sunward Phalanx props their spears up and begins to Brace.)
[*]  Fierce Advance (The Sunward Phalanx advances with their spears held high. You may choose the direction in which they advance.)
[/list]
Skill 2：
[list]
[*] Ares' Flurry (The Sunward Phalanx strikes forward multiple times.)
[/list]

notes.title: June 13 Update Log
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, Warlords! [/h3]

We will conduct maintenance and updates on June 13th from 14:00 to 17:00 (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is 3 hours. After the maintenance, we will distribute 8,000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honor, and 15 Unit Medals as compensation. Please plan your gaming time accordingly.

We're pleased to present the following updates for this maintenance:

[h2]I. EVENT NOTICES[/h2]

[h3]1、Event [The Arabian Nights] is coming to an end.[/h3]

[b]Event Info:[/b]

The event will end at midnight on June 13th, any incomplete event tasks will not be able to be finished. The event interface will remain until maintenance on June 20th. 'Targeted Decryption Points' can be obtained by consuming 50 Sovereigns for 1 point. Any unused decryption points will be automatically reclaimed to bronze coins. Please be aware of the event end time, Warlords.。

[b]Purchase available from：[/b]

 June 13th 00:00 ~ June 20th before maintenance.

[h3]2、New server mode and a new server transfer system, "Season Server Reservation," will be launched! [/h3]

[b]Time:[/b]

June 14, 2024 16:00(UTC+8) ~ maintenance before the start of the new season 

[b]Info：[/b]

Warlords can reserve a server for the new season during the off-season period through the "Season Server Reservation" system. After the new season maintenance, they can log in to the corresponding server. Warlords who miss the reservation can also use the "Real-time Server Transfer" within 14 days of the new season character login. For detailed information on server transfers, please refer to the server transfer announcement.

[h2]II. Adjustment and Optimization[/h2]

[h3]1、Units[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue for units equipped with the 'Devastation' doctrine, where the doctrine could not be triggered during formation movement.

[*] Fixed the issue where the "Devastation" doctrine could not be triggered under certain attack behaviors when units equipped with "Devastation" finished their formation.
[*] Fixed the issue of the "Devastation" doctrine could not be triggered in [Cover Commander].
[*] Fixed the issue where the number of target attacks remained unchanged during units' basic attacks when equipping the 'Devastation' doctrine.
[*] 
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added a volume control module for each section in the [Settings]. The volume control module is divided into three categories: music, sound, and voice. Warlords can now freely adjust these settings according to their preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/41573ecbfc0fe9438dbafd38d024c2ec50ed3ac9.png[/img]

[*] Map 

Temporarily removed Haojing from the "Practice Field" list. The map will become available again once the issue is fixed. Matchmaking for Haojing will still be retained.

[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue of model clipping with the horse attire " Embroidered Uniform Officer".

notes.title: New Season Avalon is Available Now! Patch Notes.
notes.notes:
[h2]Conqueror’s Blade: AVALON Descends December 14[/h2]

[h3]THE LEGEND REBORN[/h3]

Turn myth into a once and future legend in Conqueror’s Blade: Avalon. Embark on noble quests in the new Season inspired by King Arthur legend, and fight alongside legendary units inspired by knights of the Round Table. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c9dccff79aea3e745f5726b6b7c2c33f83aa3635.jpg[/img]

[h3]Season Units[/h3]
S17 Season Units 
[h3]Bedivere Rangers (3-Star)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e6e83fb1f72d1af5b632de3f0780a3520c4aabf2.png[/img]
[h3]Background[/h3]
"Our determination is akin to silver bathed in fire, radiating a brilliant glow. The courageous heart of the one-armed hero Bedivere serves as a constant inspiration, urging us to confront the world of blood and sand with unwavering spears!"
They are the valiant Bedivere Rangers, serving under the command of Bedivere. In homage to their esteemed leader, they don the shoulder armor known as the "Arm of Bedivere." Regardless of the ferocity of the enemy, these warriors faithfully follow Bedivere onto the battlefield shrouded in smoke, demonstrating unparalleled courage. The Bedivere Rangers exhibit the fierceness of a diving dragon and the swiftness of a soaring eagle, executing unexpected attacks on their adversaries with precision and expertly crafted ammunition.
The Bedivere Rangers exhibit swift responsiveness to dynamic battlefield scenarios, seamlessly transitioning between offensive and defensive tactics. Their mastery lies in executing fast-paced, nimble light attack strategies, transforming into razor-sharp blades that cut through obstacles. On the battlefield, they are akin to a dazzling silver flash of lightning, instilling fear in the hearts of their adversaries.
[h3]Playstyle[/h3]
Under the leadership of Bedivere, this group of light cavalries, skilled in the use of lances, stands as an elite chivalric order with a specialization in mobile tactics. Clad in lightweight equipment, they have honed their lance skills, allowing them to swiftly maneuver through enemy lines and launch decisive attacks. Their rigorous training and extensive combat experience enable them to execute strikes and tactical retreats with remarkable flexibility, all while showcasing exceptional horsemanship. As their commander, Bedivere employs his strategic acumen and spearhead to inspire the unit, transforming them into a formidable force on the battlefield.
•	Skill 1: Charge (Same as other Lancers’ Charge skill)
•	Skill 2: March of Avalon (Activated during charging, recovers HP and be able to charges towards the designated location again)
•	Skill 3: Camlann Assault (Activated during charging, increase damaged and be able to charges towards the designated location again)
The three Charge skills do not share a cooldown, enabling the unit to take full advantage of their light cavalry attributes and execute charges repeatedly.
[h3]Galahad Spearmen (4-Star)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9e4ff7847f1cb5f7280e06c9adbf26aac194aa38.png[/img]
[h3]Background[/h3]
"With our spears piercing through the enemy's armor and the sturdy shield in our hands safeguarding the ground beneath our feet, we stand invincible against ten adversaries—all thanks to the strength of our clearest and purest souls!"
The Galahad Spearmen form an elite force under the noble command of the pure-hearted knight, Galahad. Having sworn an oath in the midst of a storm, they pledged that once they adorned the holy helmet—a symbol of justice and perseverance—they would fight relentlessly for their lord and the sacred land beneath their feet, even if it meant sacrificing their lives. They hold great reverence for Galahad's pure and pious heart and staunchly believe that the legendary Holy Grail will guide them on the path of heroic warfare. Upholding the sacred faith of the Knights of the Round Table, they wield their blood-soaked spear tips to forge glorious legends.
The Galahad Spearmen serves as both an impenetrable frontline defense and formidable spear throwers. When the enemy approaches, they unleash their spears with full force, creating a deadly storm in the air that swiftly annihilates foes. These guards exhibit loyalty and reliability akin to winter wolves and embody bravery and fearlessness reminiscent of summer eagles. With helmets gleaming under the golden sunlight, they persistently fight for the purest faith in their hearts.
[h3]Playstyle[/h3]
Led by Galahad, the Celtic Heavy Shield Javelin units are an elite force proficient in the use of Javelins and Heavy Shields. They are renowned on the battlefield for their tight formations and precision with Javelins, employing the Shield Wall tactic against enemies and responding swiftly to counterattacks. As their leader, Galahad instills the group with his noble character and courage. They exhibit unmatched discipline and unity in battle, defending justice like true Celtic warriors.
•	Skill 1: Spear Throw (Same as other Javelin soldiers, throws a javelin to the designated location)
•	Skill 2: For Galahad (Increase the javelin damage after charging)
[b]Combines the defense of heavy shield unit and the damage of javelin unit. A counterstrike-focused shield bearer that moderately counters Cavalry, suitable for a wide range of applications.[/b]
[h3]Lancelot Knights (5-Star)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/30781087316fa0497b6e01572f12243c3ee66f97.png[/img]
[h3]Background[/h3]
"They should be afraid. When the rays of thousands of suns converge on our sword blades, we will tear apart all the rats until they are wiped out under the wrath of the lion."
Well-trained, the Lancelot Knights stand as the strongest elite among the Knights of the Round Table. They not only possess excellent swordsmanship skills but also embody the characteristics of Lancelot himself: gentleness, refinement, and politeness. On the battlefield, they are invincible, akin to the lion; off the field, they are pious and elegant gentlemen who inspire those around them with the virtues of knighthood.
In close combat, Lancelot Knights often emerge victorious against powerful opponents due to their excellent fighting skills. They excel in solo combat, inducing panic and despair in their enemies. No one surpasses them in combat prowess, facing opponents with unparalleled ease. Seasoned and undaunted, they allow their sharp swords to blossom like roses—a magnificent tribute to all their foes.
[h3]Playstyle[/h3]
The Lancelot Gladiator Knight, led by Lancelot, is a highly skilled knight group specializing in sidearms and unwavering defense with the buckler. They are celebrated for their swift strikes and exceptional maneuvers on the battlefield, engaging the enemy with agility, piercing through openings with their sidearms, and offering some protection with the buckler. As their leader, Lancelot inspires the group with his adept swordsmanship and unwavering determination, enabling them to showcase their unique individual abilities in one-on-one duels and making them the elite choice on the battlefield.
•	Skill 1: Rapid Advance (Stabbing forward while granting invulnerability for a short time)
•	Skill 2: Lancelot's Dueling Techniques (After a Shield Bash, quickly strike and cause control effect or heavily wounded to enemy, reducing their combat ability)
High burst damage with a Dueling Sword, while relatively fragile on its own, Lancelot's Dueling Techniques provides burst damage, Rapid Advance ensures short-term survivability.

notes.title: December 7th Update Notice
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/94adc456dfd8b1a749c6336a70c336c85c7b9f51.png[/img]

[h2]Greetings, Warlords! [/h2]

We will carry out maintenance and updates from 12:30-15:30 (UTC+8) on December 7th Beijing time. The estimated maintenance duration is 3 hours. After the maintenance, players will receive 8000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honor, and 15 Unit Medals as System Maintenance compensation. Please arrange your Game time accordingly.

The update will contain the following:

[h1]I. EVENT NOTICES[/h1]

[h2]1. Warfare Pack Season Challenges Rotation[/h2]
[b]Event Info:[/b]
The [Blood of the Empire] and [Expedition] Challenge Packs will be taken off the shelves, and the [Snowstorm] and [Wolves of Ragnarok] packs will become available.
[b]Time:[/b]
From December 7th after maintenance until December 21st before maintenance.

[h2]2、Sovereign Proof of Wealth Modification Instructions[/h2]
[b]Modification Instructions:[/b]
After the maintenance on December 7th, the purchase entrance for Sovereign Proof of Wealth will be temporarily closed. However, active and unexpired generals will still be able to complete quests and claim rewards.
The Sovereign Proof of Wealth will be reopened after the maintenance on December 14th, and at the same time, the rewards for the Sovereign Proof of Wealth will be upgraded and adjusted.

[h1]II. ADJUSTMENTS[/h1]

[h2]1.New Season, New Server! [Excalibur] Is Here![/h2]
With the launch of the [Avalon] season on December 14th, the new server [Excalibur] (EX) will be online. The pre-creation will start next week!

[h2]2.Transfer Server System Adjustments[/h2]
      Due to potential issues that may arise while the new server transfer system is operating, it may affect normal gameplay for all players. To ensure everyone can apply for a server transfer as soon as possible without affecting subsequent gaming, we will first close the server transfer system and reopen the old server transfer system after maintenance on December 7th.

      Generals can continue playing the game normally after applying for server transfer. The transfer requirements and rules are consistent with the current transfer system, but generals who have already completed the transfer cannot apply for another transfer (there will be a special prompt on the page). After the transfer application is successful, the server transfer will be carried out during the maintenance on December 14th, and you can directly log in to the target server after the maintenance.
     
      In order to express our apologies, we will add an additional 5 Treatises to the maintenance rewards on December 7th. All generals who have logged in from November 30th until the maintenance period can get the rewards through emails after the maintenance in 30 days. The emails have a limited time for claiming the rewards, so please claim them as soon as possible.

      We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused. We are working to optimize the [Real-time] server transfer system, and will make it available for use as soon as possible.

[h1]III. Bug Fixes and Other Adjustments[/h1]
1. Fixed the issue where right-clicking on Empire Coins would not lead to the Empire's Treasury.
2. In [Field PvP Battles] mode, the "Current" channel is temporarily closed.
3. Optimize the auto-reconnect mechanism for server disconnections.
4. The issue with respawn time after reconnecting due to disconnection has been fixed.
5. Fixed the issue where changing units might cause skill locking with a certain probability.
6. Fixed the issue where the Unit's head model would behave abnormally when changing Unit Attire.
7. Fixes the issue where some Units couldn't face the enemy while using their skills.

notes.title: News Update on November 30th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fca2e6d862440c2903c0c8ea2eb84e98295dda1b.png[/img]
[h2]Greetings, Warlords! [/h2]
We will update the game during our maintenance on November 30th, which will last for 3 hours and run between 12:30-15:30 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 8,000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honor, and 15 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:
[h2]I. EVENT NOTICE[/h2]
[h3]1. Monastic Living, The Oath of Allegiance, [Avalon]: The Legendary Knights of the Round Table Season is about to begin!
Event Info:[/h3]
The chosen sword grants me strength to bear the responsibility of a king! [Avalon] Season Pass preorders are now open!
Generals can press the 'C' key to access the Store and preorder the Season Pass Gift Set, acquire more supply items, and support their new journey!
Battle Pass content:
Avalon Base Season Pass x1
Treatise x1
Season XP Item x2
Unit Medal x10
Bronze Coin x50,000
Price: 680 Sovereigns
[h3]Time:[/h3]
From November 30th maintenance to December 14th maintenance.
The Basic Season Pass will take effect after the maintenance for the new season is completed, allowing you to immediately receive the limited Hero Attire: Nightmare of War.

[h3]2. Preorder the Season Pass, battle with your friends, and get the new Season Units for free!
Event Info:[/h3]
Preorder the Avalon Season Pass to receive 2 unlock orders for the 3 Stars unit, the [Bedivere Rangers]. After the season launches on December 14th, you can Unlock Now and obtain the [Bedivere Rangers] 3 Stars unit.
Enter the O-Events page to participate in the [Knight's Oath Expedition] event.
During the event, you can unlock some [Chivalric Oath] rewards for free. Generals can preorder the [Avalon] Season Pass during the event, promote the [Chivalric Oath], and unlock all rewards!
During the event, upgrading [Oath of Knights] at any time allows you to immediately receive the additional rewards from previous levels.
Complete [Daily Request] tasks to gain XP and level up, receiving generous rewards.
[Daily Request] unlock at midnight every day, and during the event period, all tasks can be completed without expiration.
[h3]Time:[/h3]
From November 30th maintenance to December 14th maintenance.

[h3]3、Attire Treasure Rotation
Event Info:[/h3]
The World Serpent's Attire Treasure and Shadowlight Attire Treasure are now open. Time Limited return of the Shortsword & Shield Attire [The World Serpent's Treasure] and Hero Attire [Polar Owl]!
[h3]Time:[/h3]
From November 30th maintenance to December 14th maintenance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9fa06f3e74a6341b12e1ea9fece3d2ae6c0b7e70.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/105b4723d924750000a5930f7167cccef92700b4.jpg[/img]

[h3]4、 Selective Doctrine Pool rotation, "Pikemen Storm" Time Limited On.
Event Info:[/h3]
The [Excavate] - [Pikemen Storm] doctrine pool is now available, featuring a higher chance to grant epic polearm infantry doctrines.
[h3]Time:[/h3]
From November 30th maintenance to December 21th maintenance.

[h3]5. The System for Server Transfer is fully promoted, and the Instant Server Transfer function is launched for the first time!
System Description:[/h3]
The Character Transfer System will open after this maintenance. Generals can apply for a transfer through [ESC]-[Account Service]-[Character Transfer]. Once submitted, the transfer application will be irreversible. Please consider carefully when confirming the transfer. After applying, you will exit to the login page, and your character will enter the transfer status. It is expected that the character transfer will be completed in 15-30 minutes, and Generals can directly log in to the target server afterwards. If there is a large number of simultaneous transfer requests, the waiting time for transfers will be extended. Generals, please be patient and pay attention to the prompts and information on the character login interface. After a successful transfer application, the same character cannot be transferred again within 30 days.
Detailed server transfer rules can be found in the [b][Knightfall Season Server Transfer Rules][/b] News.
[h3]Server Transfer Opening Time:[/h3]
From Nov 30th after maintenance until Dec 13th, 23:59

[h2]II. ADJUSTMENTS[/h2]
[h3][Knightfall] Season Settlement is about to take place[/h3]
The [Knightfall] Season will settle during the maintenance on November 30, [Rank Battle] will be temporarily closed until the new season starts, and the original [Rank Battle] will be replaced by [Free Battles]. The Daily Activities details can also be checked by clicking [J] - [Activity Mode].

[h2]III. Bug Fixes and Other Optimizations[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Add multiple Requests to Log In failure notifications
[*]Fixes a bug where Siege Engines & Artillery may occasionally not display the projectile trajectory.
[*]Fixed the issue where it might be impossible to dismount Siege Engines & Artillery if they were placed too close to ladders.
[*]Fixed the issue of the Great Bombard being passable to turn rapidly through action.
[*]Optimize the reconnection mechanism for in-game network instability issues.
[*]Fix the issue where cloaks may occasionally display abnormally.
[/olist]

notes.title: Nirvana Horse Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f7da67428fae3db4cbd6f90544a5036e7036c67d.png[/img]
[h2] Our performance optimization strategy:[/h2]
[list]
	[*]While maintaining the visual effects, ensure the consistency of the highest quality graphics and optimize any unreasonable performance allocation. For example, supplement the models, special effects, and animations with a more complete LOD, and reduce the performance consumption of faraway scenes.

	[*]Redesign the underlying program code, using better strategies to restructure the underlying logic.

	[*]More detailed and reasonable default settings have been applied for different levels of graphics, and more graphics options are now available. These settings are finely tuned to achieve a better balance between visual quality and performance. No effects have been removed. they are just allocated more reasonably. Players can also customize the options according to their personal preferences, and performance will be improved compared to before under the same graphics quality.
[/list]

[h2] Specific modifications:[/h2]

[h3] While maintaining visual effects, modify art materials and optimize unreasonable performance allocation[/h3]
	Models, special effects, animations, UI, and sound art resources have been reset or modified, including but not limited to:
[list]
	[*]Over 300 Hero models, 500+ Weapon models, and 100+ Horse equipment models, along with related animation files.
	[*]Over 300+ Unit entities, horse models, Attires, and related animation files are included.
	[*]Over 8,000 scene object models 
	[*]Over 5,600+ character scene effects
	[*]500+ UI Materials
	[*]50+ music materials, 13,000+ sound effect materials.
[/list]
	Combine similar items and remove complex objects in over 40 scenes, including but not limited to:[list]
	[*]Reducing the complexity of the model combination.
	[*]Combining models of the same type to reduce the absolute number and the number of triangular surfaces.
	[*]Modifying the distant scenery vegetation to reduce the performance consumption of faraway scenes.
[/list]
[h3] Refactoring the underlying code, the following underlying systems have undergone code refactoring:
[/h3]
	Graphics-related systems:
[list]
	[*]Optimizing materials, shadows, and lighting, among other graphic algorithms to reduce the GPU's computational overhead.
	[*] Optimizing static objects, dynamic objects, trees, and other models' clipping algorithms to reduce the CPU consumption of submitting rendering commands.
	[*]Optimizing the graphics system DrawCall batch submission algorithm.
	[*]Loading certain textures selectively, and reducing the usage of video memory and RAM.
	[*]Adjusting the task scheduling strategy of the graphic system, and making better use of CPU resources.
	[*]The rendering algorithms for highlighted objects and semi-transparent objects have been optimized.
	[*]For special effects, particles, decals, and other systems, more reasonable budget control strategies are used in high, medium, and low settings.
	[*]The performance effect after a Unit's death has been optimized.
[/list]
	Client-related System:
[list]
	[*]Cleaning up 11 unsuitable UI interfaces in the game.
	[*]UI system rendering and logic optimization for 58 interfaces.
	[*]The soldier creation system is optimized to avoid sudden lags when recruiting at supply points.
	[*]Optimizing the Point Capture system logic.
	[*]Optimizing the logic of the Season Challenges system.
	[*]Optimizing the system logic for changing levels.
	[*]Optimizing the logic of the Unit in Formation system.
	[*]The script system's garbage collection mechanism has been optimized, reducing occasional lagging issues.
	[*]Optimizing the LOD algorithms for animation, particles, and special effects systems to balance both visual quality and performance requirements.
[/list]
	Other Systems:
[list]
	[*]Optimizing audio effects, UI, Devastate, fabric, and other System synchronization Materials creation logic to avoid lags during the Create process.
	[*]Optimizing the frame rate smoothing algorithm to avoid large fluctuations.
	[*]Optimizing the multithread scheduling for new Intel CPUs, and making better use of CPU resources.
	[*]Fixing a series of crashes caused by multi-threading issues.
	[*]We have made more refined and reasonable default configurations for different levels of graphics settings, and also opened up more customization options. These settings have been adjusted to provide a more balanced visual and performance experience.
[/list]

[h3]The purchase limit for the Weekly Golden Order Pack is adjusted to 2.[/h3]
[h3]The purchase limit for the Weekly Unit Unlock Packs is adjusted to 3.[/h3]


[h1]II. BALANCE CHANGES[/h1]

    In the current version, several unit types, including sword & shield units, archer units, crossbowmen units, firearm units, and melee cavalry units, are not performing as well as we'd like them to. This is mainly because they have remained unchanged for a long time and their basic attributes on the battlefield are not up to par. Additionally, their roles and counter relationships are not as distinct as we would like them to be. While we have attempted to address these issues through unit mastery, it has inadvertently made the weaker units even weaker. We intend to make a series of adjustments, along with future unit mastery updates, to ensure that each unit finds its unique role and enriches battlefield strategies.
[list]
[*] [b]Sword & Shield Units: [/b]These units should excel in both offense and defense, especially in dealing with ranged attacks.
[*] [b]Lancer Cavalry Unit: [/b]Special rushing abilities should complement, not replace, the traditional long-distance charge.
[*] [b]Archer Unit: [/b]Units with extremely long-range attacks should have an advantage against long-range and unshielded units.
[*] [b]Crossbowmen Unit:[/b] Units with piercing multiple-target attacks should be effective against offensive units but struggle against shielded units.
[*] [b]Firearm Unit: [/b]These units should deal high single-target damage with lower accuracy and fire rate. Increasing soldier count is necessary to ensure attack efficiency.
[*] [b]Melee Cavalry Unit: [/b]While a small soldier count is a contributing factor to their underperformance, it's not the main issue. The unit's mechanics will be continuously improved in the future.
[*] [b]Leadership: [/b]To introduce more diverse strategies, leadership for lower-star units will be adjusted.
[/list]
These are all the changes:

[h2]Sword &Shield Units[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved block ability against ranged attacks, with the ability to block arrows while moving and fighting
[/list]
[h2]Cavalry Units[/h2]

[/list]

[*] Formation: Add Wedge formation, remove Serpent Formation
[*]   Unit Traits【Highspeed】 → 【 Long-distance Charge 】
[/list]
[h2]Ranged Units[/h2]

[*] Ironcap Archers: Piercing Armor Penetration 1011 → 1239

notes.title: New Season "Knightfall": Content & Balance Changes
notes.notes:
[h2]A legendary battle awaits in the new Season.[/h2]

Devote yourself to the Order of the Sword in [b]Conqueror’s Blade: Knightfall[/b], the new Season available now as a free update! Pledge yourself as an acolyte and fight alongside your brothers in a new Seasonal Campaign, [b]unlock brand-new Units[/b], earn exclusive rewards from the Knightfall Battle Pass, and celebrate with launch events and sales.

[previewyoutube=aAozgQYwErI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Unlock Seasonal Units[/h2]

Battle alongside the Brotherhood and unlock the following new Seasonal Units via Unit Challenges:
[list]
[*]  [b]Schutzdieners (3-Star)[/b] — *Available Now*: This Unit can heal and harm, making them the ideal companion on the battlefield.
[*]  [b]Kriegsbruders (4-Star)[/b] — *Coming September 25*: Command the first sword and shield Cavalry Unit in Conqueror’s Blade to devastate the enemy.
[*]  [b]Zweihanders (5-Star)[/b] — *Coming October 9*: This Unit’s two-handed greatswords excel at smashing through frontline formations.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bebbe2ae3ade975a598c1fdd6a259a0863193ac8.png[/img]

[h2]Knightfall Battle Pass: Earn Exclusive Free & Premium Rewards[/h2]

Prove chivalry isn’t dead and earn rewards fit for a true knight of the Order of the Sword. Over 100 levels of Free and Premium rewards can be redeemed by completing Seasonal Challenges, earning Glory, and leveling up your Battle Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f43f5e3a974236f73369d5bf6586c97dfac6d0cd.jpg[/img]

Adorn your new Teutonic-inspired Units with the [b]Ritterbruder Unit Attire[/b] and ride into battle atop your noble steed in the [b]Order Grandmaster’s Mount Set[/b]. Ascend to the rank of Grandmaster and claim the highest reward at Tier 100—[b]Order Grandmaster Hero Attire[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2d746c8dd30b1e1c119a76302f3a7e6ad474e176.jpg[/img]
[b]Greycloak Zealot’s Hero Attire[/b] is granted as an instant reward when you purchase the Battle Pass in-game for 1,000 Sovereigns. Plenty more amazing rewards can be earned on the Free Pass, too!

[previewyoutube=MtJ8yU03Amg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Seasonal Campaign: Knightfall[/h2]
[list]
[*] Embark on a brand new journey in the Seasonal Campaign beginning in the Borderlands or Ostaria (and journey to Ungverija later on in the Season), and play every week to follow the story and secure your standing. Battle in twice-weekly Territory Wars (beginning September 19) with your House and complete Stages to prepare for the final fight in [b]Conqueror's City[/b] at the end of the Season.
[/list]
[h2]Season Launch Events & Sales[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Dive into New Doctrine Pools:[/b] A new Doctrine Excavation Site has reopened! Talk to the War Scholar and use your Treatises to find Javelin Doctrines until September 27.
[*] [b]Astrological Attire Chests:[/b] Unlock the contents of the Centauri Star and Golden Sun Attire Chests with Golden Keys for a chance to receive the Centaur's Wrath Bow and Ordre du Ciel Hero Attire, Mount Set, and Banner until September 27.
[*] [b]Peruse Attire Shop Updates:[/b] Check out the Attire Chest menu (‘G’), to behold the Antique Tyrannical Set, Antique Tattered Henchmen Unit Attire, and the Antique Undefeated Attire available until November 30.
[*] [b]Colosseum Returns:[/b] Prove your battle prowess in the returning PVP mode—Colosseum. Fight in 6v6 battles on newly-adjusted maps until September 27.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c381e0c13cb0271566614aed8e19e936ecc43013.png[/img]

Download and play [b]Conqueror’s Blade: Knightfall[/b] today!

For more information about the new Season, check out the latest patch notes. New to the game? [b]Conqueror’s Blade[/b] is available to download and play for free from the official website and Steam. Get the latest [b]Conqueror’s Blade[/b] news by subscribing to the official newsletter and connecting with us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, and Discord.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
https://www.conquerorsblade.com/en/news/997/

    In the current version, several unit types, including sword & shield units, archer units, crossbowmen units, firearm units, and melee cavalry units, are not performing as well as we'd like them to. This is mainly because they have remained unchanged for a long time and their basic attributes on the battlefield are not up to par. Additionally, their roles and counter relationships are not as distinct as we would like them to be. While we have attempted to address these issues through unit mastery, it has inadvertently made the weaker units even weaker. We intend to make a series of adjustments, along with future unit mastery updates, to ensure that each unit finds its unique role and enriches battlefield strategies.
[list]
[*] [b]Sword & Shield Units: [/b]These units should excel in both offense and defense, especially in dealing with ranged attacks.
[*] [b]Lancer Cavalry Unit: [/b]Special rushing abilities should complement, not replace, the traditional long-distance charge.
[*] [b]Archer Unit: [/b]Units with extremely long-range attacks should have an advantage against long-range and unshielded units.
[*] [b]Crossbowmen Unit:[/b] Units with piercing multiple-target attacks should be effective against offensive units but struggle against shielded units.
[*] [b]Firearm Unit: [/b]These units should deal high single-target damage with lower accuracy and fire rate. Increasing soldier count is necessary to ensure attack efficiency.
[*] [b]Melee Cavalry Unit: [/b]While a small soldier count is a contributing factor to their underperformance, it's not the main issue. The unit's mechanics will be continuously improved in the future.
[*] [b]Leadership: [/b]To introduce more diverse strategies, leadership for lower-star units will be adjusted.
[/list]

From September 7th after maintenance until September 21st before maintenance

[b]Spear Sergeants[/b]
When in Cover Commander mode, damage taken is immediately reduced by 60% → 40%, damage dealt is increased by 45% → 30%, and the decay rate of this effect is accelerated within 6 seconds.

notes.title: Jul 13 Unit Balance Changes Preview
notes.notes:
Based on recent battle statistics and community feedback, we'll be rolling out the following balance to units on July 13.

[h3]Modao Battalion[/h3]
1. The Modao Battalion is a polearm-type unit and can equip all polearm doctrines (apart from Charge ones).
2. The damage dealt by [Modao Defense], [Modao March] and [Carnage] is now considered as Brace damage.
3. Slightly increased the brace hitbox of [Modao Defense].

[h3]Iron Reapers[/h3]
1. Changes to [Very Heavy Armor]: Gain immunity to Dazed while attacking. Grants an initial damage reduction to all types of damage of 48%. Each hit taken reduces the damage reduction by 2.5%, down to 18% after 12 hits.
2. Greatly increased the block break of flail attacks, so that they can break through the block of shield units in a single hit.
3. Flail attacks reduce the enemy's defenses by 10% until they retreat.

[h3]Monastic Knights[/h3]
Changes to [Very Heavy Armor]: Gain immunity to Dazed while attacking. Grants an initial damage reduction to all types of damage of 48%. Each hit taken reduces the damage reduction by 2.5%, down to 18% after 12 hits.

[h3]Fortebraccio Pikemen[/h3]
Reduced the speed at which they turn while moving or during Brace, making it more difficult for them to quickly turn and follow the enemy's movement.

notes.title: Sengoku: Blazing Katana Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Unit Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ec0d5c5d85a16ced55726d4fedbbf4f70d8833a8.jpg[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3692433663122671675

[h2]Unit Mastery [/h2]

[h3]Overview[/h3]

Unit mastery is a brand-new unit growth system available alongside what's already there. A unit's mastery gradually unlocks as you level it up, enabling you to increase its attributes and alter its skills or mechanics.
[b]First Units to Receive Mastery:[/b]
Pike Militia
Prefecture Guards
Mace Sergeants
Palace Guards
Halberdier Sergeants

[b]Mastery[/b]
Access
You'll be able to access [Mastery] while checking the details of [unit].
You can use the filter in the bottom right of the Barracks to quickly see which units mastery is available for.
Mastery unlocks at level 36.
Infantry Scroll of Mastery
Item required to unlock the mastery of infantry units. They come in uncommon and rare quality.
You'll be able to earn these from the all-new PvE mode [Latent Potential], buy them from the [Honor Shop] and from limited-time events.
Mastery Nodes
Leveling up a unit unlocks more mastery levels as well.
Mastery Level - Required Level (T2 Units) - Required Level (T3 Units) = Required Level (T4 Units)
1 - 10 - 10 - 12
2 - 11 - 11 - 14
3 - 11 - 11 - 14
4 - 12 - 12 - 16
5 - 14 - 14 - 18
6 - 14 - 14 - 18
7 - 16 - 16 - 20
8 - 18 - 18 - 24
Mastery units have 8 mastery nodes. The items required to unlock each mastery node depend on that unit's tier.
Mastery Level - Scroll of Mastery Quality - Required Quantity (T2 Units) - Required Quantity (T3 Units) - Required Quantity (T4 Units)
1 - Uncommon - 5 - 5 - 10
2 - Uncommon - 10 - 10 - 20
3 - Uncommon - 10 - 15 - 25
4 - Uncommon - 15 - 25 - 40
5 - Rare - 4 - 8 - 10
6 - Uncommon - 15 - 25 - 40
7 - Uncommon - 20 - 40 - 60
8 - Rare - 6 - 12 - 20

[h3]Latent Potential[/h3]


[b]Reward Chances[/b]
You get one reward chance for the [Latent Potential] each day, up to a maximum of 4. Winning a Latent Potential battle deducts a reward chance and nets rewards.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3709322795934656018

[h2]Honor Shop[/h2]

[h3]Overview[/h3]

•	You can purchase items for Honor in the Honor Shop.
•	The Honor Shop unlocks at level 100.
Mastery
•	Access
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bb266a18c1bb6a9eee215a7e3a10102d9627b454.png[/img]

￮	Navigate to the [Unit Tree (U)] to access the [Honor Shop].
•	Honor Shop Items

￮	Purchase limits reset weekly.
Item Name - Weekly Quantity - Honor Cost
Uncommon Infantry Scroll of Mastery - 1 - 5-300
Uncommon Infantry Scroll of Mastery - 6 - 15-450
Rare Infantry Scroll of Mastery - 1 - 2,000

￮	Lifetime Limited-Buy Items
Item Name - Quantity - Honor Cost
Mace Sergeants Token - 1 - 10,000
Mace Sergeants: Protect - 1 - 5,000

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]

We've updated the tutorial, meaning that players who join after the Sengoku season goes live get to experience different tutorials.
•	Veteran Players
￮	Nothing will change in terms of the tutorial for characters created before the Sengoku season. They'll still have access to the Hero's Path.
￮	They'll also be able to purchase the Mace Sergeants from the Honor Shop.
•	New Players (Sengoku Season)
￮	Characters created after the Sengoku season goes live will no longer have access to the Hero's Path.

notes.title: [Sengoku] Quality of Life Update Preview
notes.notes:
With the June 1 update and the release of the new [Sengoku] season, we're improving what Honor is for, the tutorial and the character customization system. We've also made changes to improve the game's performance.

[h2]Honor Shop[/h2]

We're adding a new Honor Shop, widening the use of Honor so that you've got more to spend all the Honor you gain on.

The Honor Shop unlocks at level 100. Inside, you'll be able to spend Honor on unit mastery items (has a weekly buy cap), a [Mace Sergeants] Token and doctrines exclusive to the unit (these have a total purchase cap).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bb266a18c1bb6a9eee215a7e3a10102d9627b454.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5510f332fef9d266fbf33022e2be310c728cecec.png[/img]

We'll continue to update the stock available at the Honor Shop in the future too!

[h2]Performance Improvements[/h2]

A new season is on the horizon, but our effort to improve game performance won't end here. Following our changes, the standard test computers we used (configuration below), saw an average increase of 10 FPS.
Benchmark Configuration:
[code] Monitor: 1080P
CPU: Intel i7 7700K
GPU: GTX 1060 (6G)
RAM: 16G
DirectX 11 [/code]

[b]The performance changes contain the following:[/b]
[list]
[*] New - Fullscreen Exclusive Mode
[/list]
By playing on Fullscreen Exclusive (Settings - Graphics - Display Mode - Fullscreen Exclusive), you'll have an overall smoother experience.
[list]
[*] Improved - Unit Overhead Info Loading & Display Logic
[/list]
By splitting up the information load of heroes and units (HP bar, name, defense values, etc.), we've reduced the amount of information that loads at any one time. What's more, by improving the information of visible objects rendered in real-team, we've further reduced the resources the game takes up.
[list]
[*] New - Option to Hide Dead Units
[/list]
We've added an option to Hide Dead Units under Settings. The models of dead units will now be removed after a while to further reduce resource usage.

Improving performance is a long-term effort, and we'll continue to share with you all as we make further improvements.

[b]You can find our previously published notice on performance improvements here:[/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3683420125085983946

[h2]New - Team Colors[/h2]

Following feedback we've received regarding teams' unit colors, we've added the following color options to [Settings] - [Unit Color]:
[My Units - Crimson], [Enemy Units - Chestnut] & [Enemy Units - Raven]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7be915bffbbe860c0f8304a00d7f6b15a4193487.png[/img]

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]

Conqueror's Blade is a medieval action game that's difficult to master and caters toward a specific audience. It's been quite difficult for us to find a way in which to quickly help new players get accustomed. With the new season, players entering Conqueror's Blade for the first time will experience an all-new tutorial that'll hopefully enable them to learn the ropes quicker than ever.

[b]We've made the following main changes to the tutorial:[/b]
All PvE stages are more focused on teaching the player about units, touching upon brace, damage types and back attacks.
We've also added a tutorial for each related action, making them an integral part of the stage itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/441715ce00bf58aff9150a21bb6303913870fdc1.png[/img]

We've also used tooltip boxes to touch upon other features, enabling newer players to come to terms with these faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0545474e003d7039bfeee9e49ab25424962632e9.png[/img]

We've also made a new unit for the tutorial, the [Mace Sergeants], and they have exclusive doctrines and Mastery available to them too. By guiding new players to focus on training this one unit, they'll better understand what makes up Conqueror's Blade's core.

Players who created a character before the start of the [Sengoku] season can purchase the Mace Sergeants Token and their doctrines from the [Honor Shop].

[h2]Character Customization[/h2]

Our old character customization options have gone mostly unchanged since our launch. And so, we felt it was time to add some new options with this season. We've improved the detail for character faces, hair and added new face presets.

Characters created before the new season can speak to the Warden to receive a [Disguise Kit x1]. Naturally, none of our old customization options are going away, so you're free to use these if you prefer those.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/86f63ba3da60ed0839bcbd23c761ca5fd2dd024a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cba99484f49e99d1eb818f0e2a2affac33e5c9a5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/933e07790413dcc426e0733744d231ce5f44e1f7.jpg[/img]

(These are only part of the new options and may be subject to change)

Keep an eye out for our Season Update Log and future notices for more info! See you in the [Sengoku] season!

notes.title: March 16 Balance Changes
notes.notes:
Based on recent feedback and online data observation, we plan to make balance adjustments to the Symmachean Stalwarts, Dagger-Axe Lancers, and Chevaliers in the Mar 16 update.

[h3]Symmachean Stalwarts[/h3]
Removed the 12% extra damage bonus of [Brace]. The damage reduction effect and HP recovering effect upon successful block remained unchanged.

[h3]Dagger-Axe Lancers[/h3]
Reduced [Rally to Me]’s damage by 4.5%, and armor penetration by 10% when counter-attacking. The charge damage remained unchanged.

[h3]Chevaliers[/h3]
Reduce the average number of arrows fired by the Demesne Arbalists and Demesne Crossbowmen when using [Glory Charge] and [Lance Thrust].
When the Demesne Arbalists or Demesne Crossbowmen are not equipped with the Double Shot doctrine: 
[Glory Charge]: 1 arrow per round (same as before adjustment).
[Lance Thrust]: Chance to shoot 1-2 arrows per round. The average number of arrows is reduced from 2 to 1.7.
When the Demesne Arbalists or Demesne Crossbowmen are equipped with the Double Shot doctrine:
[Glory Charge]: Chance to shoot 1-2 arrows per round. The average number of arrows is reduced from 2 to 1.7.
[Lance Thrust]: Chance to shoot 1-3 arrows per round. The average number of arrows is reduced from 3 to 2.5.
As always, we are committed to providing a better gaming experience for you in Eternal and beyond. If you have any questions or suggestions regarding these adjustments or any other issues in-game, please contact us. Your feedback is much appreciated!

notes.title: Play Conqueror’s Blade: Eternal Now | Seasonal Update Log
notes.notes:
[h2][i][b]Journey into legend in Conqueror’s Blade: Eternal, the new Season now available as a free update! [/b][/i][/h2]
Check out the full [url=https://www.conquerorsblade.com/en/news/877/]Seasonal Update Log[/url] 

The Eternal Battle Pass is also available to buy now in-game, with the Wandering Hero Attire granted as an instant unlock and more premium rewards to be earned throughout the Season.

[previewyoutube=5-443FyrEOg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Three New Seasonal Units[/h2]

New warriors inspired by the legendary heroes of Ancient China will be available to unlock and add to your ranks via Unit Challenges throughout the Season:
Wuxing Pikemen (3-Star) — Available Now: Burn up the battlefield with this Unit’s distinctive destructive skills.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3653018925181400769
Crescent Monks (4-Star) — Coming March 6: Sweep and swing your way to victory with the Crescent Monks’ signature weapon.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3653019115625706118
Yanyuedao Cavalry (5-Star) — Coming March 27: Turn the tide of battle with this rousing cavalry Unit.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3653019115629267380

[h2]Eternal Battle Pass: Exclusive Free & Premium Rewards[/h2]

Over 100 levels of Free and Premium rewards can be claimed by completing Seasonal Challenges, earning Glory, and levelling up your Battle Pass this Season. Fit your corps with the Wu's Braves Unit Attire, and ride into battle atop a noble steed in the Wayward Wind Mount Set. Ascend to Tier 100 and claim the ultimate prize for any true legend—-the Hundred Victories Hero Attire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/24830199086185dbe869c2c2eab063a0ea9c3ec6.png[/img]

Wandering Hero Attire is granted as an instant reward when you purchase the Battle Pass in-game for 680 Sovereigns. There are plenty of amazing rewards to be earned on the Free Pass, too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f7920fc4248bd4f888cdf5c6939a03c16b977ee8.png[/img]

[h2]New Mode: Escalation (Siege)[/h2]

Escalation is a brand-new Siege mode where you can prove your tactical prowess! Switch out your Units at will and gain an advantage, but be careful—your foes can do the same. Escalate and outmanoeuvre the enemy to seize victory! Escalation is available to play at select times (check the Patch Notes for details), and you can learn more about it right here.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3653017658296154941
[h2]New Features: Enhancements & Firepower[/h2]

Inspired by the Huolongjing (an Ancient Chinese guide to fire weapons), the fiery strength of the new Artillery—-the Divine Crow—is sure to turn the tide of battle with its extensive range and blast radius. Learn more about the Divine Crow in Steam :: Conqueror's Blade :: Breaking News! Watch the Skies! The Divine Crow is Here! (steamcommunity.com) , and prepare for its arrival in mid-March.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3653018925184995859
Reforge your equipment to create something even better. Use the new Artificer's Stone item at the Artificer's Forge to refine your gear and improve its attributes! Learn more about the new system in Steam :: Conqueror's Blade :: Development Journal: Equipment Reforging (steamcommunity.com) .
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3653019115614964534
[h2]Seasonal Campaign: Eternal[/h2]

Begin a brand new Seasonal Campaign in the Borderlands or Liangyun (and journey to Longting later on in the Season), and play every week to follow the story and secure your standing. Battle in twice-weekly Territory Wars with your House and complete Stages to prepare for the final fight in Daicheng at the end of the Season.

[h3]Territory Wars [/h3]

Territory Wars [u][b]begin on February 28[/b][/u] and will be waged every Tuesday and Saturday throughout Eternal. Participate in epic server-wide PvP battles which form the lion’s share of endgame content in Conqueror’s Blade. 

Take part in Territory Wars by joining a player-controlled Free House, Alliance, or Cohort (NPC-controlled House). Expand your empire by fighting alongside your fellow warlords via the ‘Battle’ interface or in the Open World to gain control of fiefs. 

[h2]Season Launch Events[/h2]

Celebrate with launch events and herald the start of Conqueror’s Blade: Eternal!
Sign-in Event: Collect Dragon Coins, Artificer’s Stones, Ancient Treatises, and more just by signing in to Conqueror’s Blade.
Drops & Exchange: Play Matchmaking Battles and sign in to earn Dragon Coins and exchange them for rewards such as Bronze, Ancient Treatises, and Artificer's Stones.
New Doctrine Pool: A new Doctrine Pool has opened at the War Scholar where you can use your Ancient Treatises.
Doctrinal Alchemy Boost: Enjoy a higher chance to receive Tier IV and Tier V Doctrines.
Bountiful Bundles: Check out the in-game Store for delightful deals on limited-time and permanent Bundles!
