notes.title: Development Journal | Feb. 24 Unit Balance Changes
notes.notes:
[h3]I. Kheshigs[/h3]

[b][Statistics][/b]

[list]
[*]  Win Rate: 53.89% (No.1)
[*]  Avg. Hero Kills: 0.88 (No.1 - 35% higher than No.2)
[*]  Avg. Unit Kills 20.68 (No.2 - only 0.86% lower than No.1)
[/list]

The Kheshigs' win rate is the highest on all servers and by a big margin. On some servers, it is as high as 55%+ (units with 53% can be defined as powerful).
By analyzing the unit, we've realized that the Kheshigs are powerful because they have strong attacks with which to counter infantry and as they can take down heroes very quickly, giving an enemy hero little chance to strike back or flee. Their high damage and mobility make them a threat to both units and heroes, and this makes them perform better than other units. Furthermore, their bleed effects have too long durations, preventing heroes hit from using Bandage to heal up. All in all, this has had a somewhat negative effect on the overall gameplay experience.

Changes

[list]
[*]  [Frenzied Onslaught] No longer dazes heroes.
[*]  [Kheshigs]' bleed effects no longer work on heroes.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Following the changes to [Kheshigs], we will issue a Kheshigs Doctrine Removal Token to all Warlords who created the unit before Feb. 24.
[/list]

[h3]II. Pavise Crossbowmen[/h3]

[b][Statistics][/b]

[list]
[*]  Win Rate: 48.74%
[*]  Avg. Unit Kills: 10.05
 (Both of these equal to around No.30, meaning they are fairly weak overall)
[/list]
Cavalry units are fairly strong in the current meta, with Kheshigs, Cataphract Lancers and Tundra Yeomen having a win rate exceeding 52%. Our design goal with the Pavise Crossbowmen has been for them to somewhat counter cavalry. Unfortunately, they aren't performing as well as expected and have been dropping steadily in usage rate for the past few seasons. We want to increase their power against cavalry units to bring more varied tactical choices.

[u]Changes[/u]

[list]
[*]  We are increasing the damage [Pavise Crossbowmen] deal to 4-star and above cavalry by 15%.
[/list]

[h3]III. Javelin Infantry[/h3]

[b][Statistics][/b]

[list]
[*]  Top Avg. Hero Kills: 0.42 (60% of what 5-star ranged units have)
[/list]

Javelin units previously excelled at killing enemy heroes, however, this is no longer the case when compared to 5-star units following the release of the Houndsmen and the buffs to the Kheshigs and Tercio. We want for more Warlords to try using javelins and increase the gains and sense of achievement when landing hits. With this, we hope to strengthen their unique role in battle and improve the experience of using them.

[b]Changes[/b]

- Initial Ammo:
[list]
[*] [Imperial Javelineers] 60 >> 90
[*] [Javelin Sergeants] 96 >> 120
[*] [Javelin Militia] 56 >> 84
[*] [Demesne Javelineers] 70 >> 94
[*] [Black Dragon Javelineers] 60 >> 90
[/list]
- Skill Damage Multipliers
[list]
[*] [Imperial Javelineers] Piercing Armor Penetration: 200% >> 250% | Piercing Damage: 220% >> 280%
[*] [Javelin Sergeants] Piercing Damage: 320% >> 350%
[*] [Javelin Militia] Piercing Armor Penetration: 150% >> 220%
[*] [Demesne Javelineers] Piercing Armor Penetration: 150% >> 220%
[*] [Black Dragon Javelineers] Piercing Damage: 220% >> 260%
[/list]

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade January 27 Update Log
notes.notes:
Hello, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on January 27th, which will last for 4 hours and run between 12:30-16:30 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 12,000 Bronze Coins, 400 Honor, and 20 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

The Year of the Ox is now behind us as we welcome the Year of the Tiger. The [Tiger's Vigor] event is now coming with tons of rewards: [Tiger General] Attire Chest, Treatises, and random daily packs including New Year Lucky Bags and Red Envelopes! With these handsome rewards and great events, we wish you a great new year and plenty of victories! Please check the [Tiger's Vigor] event notice for more info.

[h3]I. SPRING FESTIVAL EVENT QUEST[/h3]

After the Tyrant's invasion, there are some strange folks wandering near the walls of Conqueror's City. They come from Yan, and they claim that the Yanhua gate in Jining city has been destroyed in war and must be repaired. But as was created a long, long time ago, they do not know what technique was used to create the bricks. Among their ranks are a general of Yan and a rich nobleman dressed in fancy clothes. Why don't you ask them why they have come?

[*] 	Improved the visuals of some menus and texts.
[/list]

[h3]VII. Hero Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]	[Pike Hero][/b]
	After checking player feedback and analyzing data, the pike hero's [Wandering Dragon] invulnerability window exceeds our expectations. It currently performs too well and is too difficult to play against. So, we have decided to make the following changes:
[Wandering Dragon] Reduced the invulnerability window of all stages to 0.3 seconds (was 0.5 seconds). 
[Sky Dragon]: Adjusted the damage of the second phase to 150% base blunt damage + 1,433 points of blunt damage (was 175% and 1,183 points).
	[Sky Dragon]: Adjusted the damage of the third phase to 170% base blunt damage + 2,218 points of blunt damage (was 200% and +1,868 points).
	We will continue to keep an eye on the performance of the various professions and continue to improve the game. We will also work on displaying CC immunity and similar effects with visual and other effects in future versions.

notes.title: Development Journal | Jan. 27 Balance Changes
notes.notes:
To further improve the state of Conqueror's Blade, we have been looking over recent data and feedback and will be making a series of balance changes to heroes and units with this week's update (Jan. 27).


[h3]I. PIKE HERO BALANCE CHANGES: [/h3]

[b][Statistics][/b]

- Usage Rate: 21.5% (Most used hero, with Spear being the second at 11%)
The Pike is the most used profession and its statistics are overall high, especially its ability to survive and escape in chaotic battles, which is superior to other medium armor heroes. So, we're making changes to the [Wandering Dragon] skill to slightly reduce the Pike hero's extreme burst potential, and enable other weapons to stand against them.

[b]- Changes:[/b]

[Wandering Dragon]
Reduced the invulnerability window of all stages to 0.3 seconds (was 0.5 seconds). 
[Sky Dragon]
Adjusted the damage of the second phase to 150% base blunt damage + 1,433 points of blunt damage (was 175% and 1,183 points). 
Adjusted the damage of the third phase to 170% base blunt damage + 2,218 points of blunt damage (was 200% and 1,868 points).

[h2]II. UNIT BALANCE CHANGES [/h2]

[h3]1.	Imperial Spear Guards[/h3]

[b][Statistics][/b]

- Usage Rate Rank: 40
- Win Rate Rank: 60
- Average Damage: 370.8k (rank 10)
The Imperial Spear Guards is a defensive 4-star tower-shield unit. But they cannot properly make use of their defensive ability in the current meta. So, we've decided to rework their design and boost some of their skills, giving them an increase in both defense and how they are used.

[b]- Changes:[/b]

[olist]
[*] Shield hitbox’s width increased by 13% while in formation, reducing the chance of arrows to pass through their defense.
[*] Replaced the [Advance] skill by [Shield Advance]: The Imperial Spear Guards gathers in formation and advances forward. They become immune to CC after finishing formation and will knock back enemies they hit with their advance.
[*] Empowered [Cover Commander]. While using Cover Commander, they become immune to CC for 2 seconds and gain 30% increase to all types of damage and defense for every 3 hits they take.
[*] [Front Defense] characteristic changed to [Front Barrier]: When in formation, they will raise their empowered shields once every 20 seconds, knocking back the next enemy that gets close.
[/olist]

[h3]2.	Spahks Cavalry
[/h3]
[b][Statistics][/b]

- Usage Rate Rank: Second to last of all units
The Spahks Cavalry is greatly underpowered, whether it be their burst potential, sustained damage, or ability to withstand damage. Their CC skills are not enough to ameliorate this weakness. So, we've decided to improve their CC ability based on their characteristics.

[b]- Changes:
[/b]
[olist]
[*] [Burst] changed to [Assault]: Grants an extra 15% movement speed. [Trample] can be used while [Assault] is active.
 [Trample]: Trample nearby enemies. Enemies that have been hit by [Assault] within the last 3 seconds are stunned for 4.5 seconds and take increased damage from Spahks Cavalry.
[*]Using [Battle Stomp] grants CC immunity for 1 second, and increases all defenses by 20% for 3 seconds.
[/olist]

[h3]3.	Tercio Arquebusiers[/h3]

[b][Statistics][/b]

- Usage Rate: 1.1% (Far beneath the 30% usage rate of Shenji Grenadiers)
The damage of all Arquebusiers infantry has increased following the previous changes to Arquebusiers units, but some Arquebusiers infantry are still unable to perform well in the current meta. Currently, the Shenji Grenadiers is the most used one. We believe that this is because Arquebusiers have too few skills, that the characteristics of those units aren't strong enough, and don't feel good to use. So, we're planning on increasing the ability of various firearm infantry based on their weapon characteristics to make battles more varied and interesting.
This time we are focusing on the Tercio Arquebusiers. We have decided to boost their ranged and melee active skills, thereby increasing their playability.

[b]- Changes:[/b]

1. Added a new ranged skill [Bullet Barrage]: The Tercio Arquebusiers load extra bullets and fire at a faster rate. Bullet Barrage consumes plenty of ammo but has impressive firepower. Following the barrage, their barrels need to cool down and they will switch to melee stance.
2. Added a new melee skill [Brave Advance]: The Tercio Arquebusiers raise their blades and charge forward, striking twice in quick succession.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade January 20 Update Log
notes.notes:
Hello, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on January 20th, which will last for 3 hours and run between 12:30-15:30 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 8,000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honor, and 15 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

[h3]I. ADJUSTMENT PREVIEW ON MOUNT GEAR FORGING[/h3]

We are planning on making changes to mount gear forging with the Feb. 17th update. Forging saddles, chanfrons, leg guards or bardings with Rare/Epic Mount Armor Schematics will grant one or several extra attributes, including piercing defense, slashing defense, and blunt defense. Ride into battle and face your foe at your best!
We'll explain our design idea in more detail in the coming days, so keep an eye out for future notices to learn more. Thank you for your continued support!

[h3]II. WORLD MAP CHANGES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

We are making rather big adjustments and improvements to fief quests with this update.

[b]1. We're adding Kit Quests to the list of fief quests.[/b]
In Kit Quests, you can hand in kits in return for honor, city construction, or exchange kits for other kits that you need, or even for treasures to aid in your conquest of the world.
- Kit Quests will be available in town and fort fiefs.
- Kit Quests will require kits of a certain era. (Read on further down for more info)
Appendix 1: Kit Quests

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/63a77a76281740aecca03b33f9df42046d86dfdd.png[/img]

[b]2. Added the ability to batch-submit items to fief quests.[/b]
This quality of life change makes it possible to submit resources of a certain category, rather than a specific resource. This means that it will be easier to submit the required quest resources and gather more resources to the Fief.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9e77bca5da017404b1550fd0a2dabaa6bf54def2.jpg[/img]
 
When submitting resources of a category, they'll first be taken from your inventory and wagon. Resources will be submitted in the order they are stored.
- Ctrl + left click to see which items you can submit.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3037b7dc134c735dd8cfed9eac0f3f8709d5ea82.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fb44223a7259c96d647e1add1a6bb2765047bbd5.jpg[/img]

[b]3. Improvements to some fief quests[/b]
- You may now submit tradeable artillery to [Artillery Quests] for [Growing Tribute IV, Fief Construction III, Fief Construction IV, and Fief Quest IV].
- [Artillery Quests] will no longer be issued for [Growing Tribute IV] in regional capitals, Conqueror's City, and Conqueror's Gate.
- The weekly [Jennet/Courser] quest for [Fief Quest II] can be finished for a total of 250 times. The required number of horses will be increased to 6 and 4 respectively.
- Added quests to [Fief Quest] and [Fief Construction] that require horses.
- Improved the prompt shown after reaching the maximum number of completions for a fief quest.
  
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/538283cebd3881e8d49223ec473dcbe6fa86a63c.jpg[/img]

[*] 	We are temporarily disabling the feature to edit War Orders when declaring war during system updating.

[*] 	Now, non-tradeable artillery will now have a non-tradable icon within your wagon, supply dump, and when choosing artillery for a battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b3eed3234f7ac85d5f5692e4f1a8b7ea2d3cb13c.png[/img]

[*] 	Fixed an issue where the number of participants in a Territory War battle was displayed differently depending on whether you were in the battle or not under some circumstances.
[*] 	Fixed an issue where the silver coin cost was sometimes displayed incorrectly when refining resources and forging artillery/kits.
[/list]

[h3]III. BALANCE CHANGES[/h3]

Adjusted the speed boost of the pike's [Wandering Dragon] to no longer stack with the weapon rune [Feline Swiftness].

[h3]IV. BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

[list]
[*] 	Fixed an issue where the battle info was displayed in duplicate on the [Golden Poleaxe Bay (Landing)] map's loading screen.



[*] 	Fixed an issue where respawn points lacked immortality protection for some Siege maps and added respawn points for the attackers further from the battle. For example, on the Linwu Fortress and Kurak Castle maps.

[*] 	Fixed an issue where pressing Esc while in the Unit Tree after clicking into a non-infantry unit's details would take you back to Melee Infantry instead of the unit you had selected.

notes.title: Development Journal | Jan. 6 Balance Changes
notes.notes:
Last week we shared our thoughts on and the direction we are going with balance changes in the previous Development Journal. And we are now rolling out a series of changes to some of the units, weapons, and runes in need of changes. This first batch will be going live on Jan. 6, 2022.

Jan. 6 Planned Balance Changes

[h2]I. Unit Changes[/h2]

[b]- Changes This Time[/b]

[h3]1. Axe Raiders[/h3]
[b][Stats][/b]
-Average damage taken: 531,100 (Ranked 1st among all units. 23.4% higher than the 2nd unit)
-Average damage dealt: 273,200 (Ranked 1st among all units. 15.7% higher than the 2nd unit)
-Picked Rate : 6.8% (Ranked 3rd among all units.)
The Axe Raiders currently has the most average damage taken and unit kills among all units, which far exceeds our intentions. That's why we are making changes to it while retaining the unit's unique design intact.
  - Control effects (dazed, stun, knockback, knockdown, send flying) can now affect the Axe Raiders and they will no longer immediately recover from such effects.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6d8f9be26fe9f0f497fb07ab75446a840c53d41c.gif[/img]

  - Currently when the Axe Raiders' Deadly Resolve is triggered, it is incredibly difficult for any hero or unit to retaliate during its 8-second duration, greatly reducing the effectiveness and value of other units. So, the Axe Raiders will now take 30% increased damage within 1 second of being affected by control effects (dazed, stun, knockback, knockdown, send flying). This should serve to tune down their currently overpowered passive defensive capabilities.

[h3]2. Modao Battalion[/h3]
[b][Stats][/b]
-Average damage taken: 395,200 (Ranked 4th among all units.)
-Average damage dealt: 157,800 (Ranked 9th among all units.)
-Picked Rate : 9.1% (Ranked 1st among all units.)
The Modao Battalion is a unit capable of standing against cavalry while in formation, but their damage reduction is overpowered while in [Battalion] formation. This had led to them being great at dealing with all types of units, and therefore an almost must-have unit at your disposal.
[b]  - Change:[/b]
 We are replacing the 20% damage reduction against all types of damage while in [Battalion] formation with a [33% damage reduction against cavalry, and 8% damage reduction against Infantry].

[h3]3.  Northern Lance Cavalry[/h3]
[b][Stats][/b]
-Average damage dealt: 163,100 (Ranked 7th among all units.)
-Picked Rate : 0.2% (Ranked 62nd among all units.)
-Accuracy while charging: around 15% at 20m.
While being a highly unique cavalry unit, the Northern Lance Cavalry is fairly weak and not as useful as we would like. We hope to take them up a notch with a series of improvements to their mechanics.
[b]  - Changes:[/b]
1) Increasing the number of bullets shot and accuracy rate of their fire lances while charging, addressing the issue that they hardly ever hit enemies while charging.
2) Adjusting the damage hitbox of [Valour] so that the unit can hit enemies more accurately, reducing misses by 60%.
3) Increasing the buff the Northern Lance Cavalry gains from movement speed. They will now gain a boost to attack while moving: their damage increases with more movement speed, capping out at 15% extra damage.

[h3]4. Firearm Infantry[/h3]
[b][Stats][/b]
-Picked Rate : (Take Tercio Arquebusiers as an example)
1.9% (Ranked 14th) in Season Dynasty. 0.7%(Ranked 29th) in Season Tyranny. 
-Accuracy and damage decay range: Around 20m. A range close enough to get dished out by Axe Raiders and cavalry.
As the damage and accuracy of firearm infantry declines at farther distances, they have a difficult time dealing burst damage in battles. This has led to some defensive-oriented units being hard to counter, and to less variety in unit usage.
[b]  - Changes:[/b]
1) Reducing the damage decay based on the range for firearm units. [20m] damage decay reduces to a maximum of 10% (down from 20%); [20-40m] reduces to a maximum of 18% (down from 30%); maximum decay range increases to 56m (up from 48m), leading to a minimum of 65% damage.
2) Increasing the overall accuracy of firearm units. Attacking enemies at around 30m has the highest increase of 15% accuracy.
3) Fixing an issue with incorrect sound effects for the shots of some firearm infantry.

[h3]5. Cataphract Lancers[/h3]
[Stats]
-Picked Rate : 1.1% (Ranked 24th among all units.) 
-Average damage dealt: 222,500 (Ranked 5th among all units.)
According to players' feedback, the Cataphract Lancers still don't work as well as expected after a series of changes, and their Follow Charge's damage is fairly limited. So, we're improving their Follow Charge again.
  - We have changed the underlying AI of Cataphract Lancers and the skill should now feel better to use. When the Cataphract Lancers is near the commanding hero, the unit will slightly speed up while getting closer to the target.

[h3]6. Fortebraccio Pikemen[/h3]
[b][Stats][/b]
-Picked Rate : 0.2% (Ranked 62nd among all units.) 
In Season Tyranny, there are 5 cavalry units in the top 10 highest-damage units. To form up a more reasonable relations between units, performance of units that can counter cavalry should be improved. To address this, we have increase Modao Battalion's ability when agaisnt cavalry. Meanwhile, as the unit with the longest melee weapon, the Fortebraccio Pikemen should be able to counter cavalry to a great extent, but that is currently not the case.
[b]  - Changes:[/b]
1) Increased the Fortebraccio Pikemen's damage to cavalry while using Brace by 15%.
2) Increased the damage of Brace based on enemy movement speed by up to 15%. Using Brace against charging cavalry will reach this number.

[h2]- Preview For the Future[/h2]

[h3]Imperial Spear Guards[/h3]
    Right now, the heavy shield infantry units are at a confusing position in battlefields. They can neither take nor dish out enough damage. And It is rather difficult to utilize them well in battles; all in all, they can't really affect the outcome of battle to a satisfying degree. While we have started looking at how to change units of this category, these changes might require a bit of extra time for power and stability tests. We estimate that the Imperial Spear Guards' changes will be available on Jan. 27. We also hope they'll become a liked wall of shields!

[h2]II. Hero/Weapon Changes[/h2]

[h3]- Hero/Weapon Buffs[/h3]
    We have noticed that some weapons are less used and have a lower win rate than the average. Our focus this time has been to make adjustments to these two lackluster weapons. We will naturally continue to make adjustments to other weapons where balance changes are required in the future.

[h3]1. Longsword & Shield[/h3]
[b][Stats][/b]
-Used Rate: 5.5% (Ranked 10th among all weapons.) 
-Win Rate: 50.11%（Ranked 8th among all weapons.)
The Longsword & Shield is the only weapon that can heal, but its healing is currently too low to truly make an impact. It is often the case that you're killed before you can get healed up, and the weapon lacks in both offense and defense.
[b]  - Changes:[/b]
Triggering Mercy of Heaven will grant a 15% reduction to melee damage taken for 3 seconds. Also heals you for 5% of your health every 3 seconds during its duration.

[h3]2. Short Bow[/h3]
[b][Stats][/b]
-Used Rate: 5.8% (Ranked 8th among all weapons.) 
-Win Rate: 49.84%（Ranked 9th among all weapons.)
The Short Bow is a highly mobile weapon, but some of its skills have too long of a cooldown, detracting from the experience. We want the Short Bow to be able to better combo together its skills and basic attacks.
[b]  - Changes:[/b]
1) Poison Arrow's cooldown reduces to 7 seconds (was 8).
2) Angry Hornets' cooldown reduces to 48 seconds (was 50).
3) Parting Shot's cooldown reduces to 25/23/20 seconds (was 30/28/25).
4) Wrath of Artemis' cooldown reduces to 48 seconds (was 50).

[h3]III. Seasonal Runes[/h3]

We also analyzed the power of runes and their usage during the last season.  To increase the diversity of picked runes, we are improving weapon runes whose picked-rate is below 10%, and nerfing those above 60%.

[h3]- Common Runes[/h3]
  - We are changing the effect of [Camel's Saddle] to "[Bandage]'s cooldown reduced by 50% and duration by 40%] (it previously reduced both cooldown and duration by 50%). This means it can now be used more times to make it more effective. 
  - Increasing the effect of [Camel's Stomp] to "Crit rate increased by 32" (was 24), and increasing its cost to 2 points (was 1 point).
  - Increasing the effect of [Tortoise's Resolve] to "While in a flag area, damage taken is reduced by 12%" (was 10%).
  - Increasing the effect of [Tortoise's Shell] to "Fall damage is reduced by 60%" (was 30%).
  - Boosting the effect of [Tortoise's Calm] to "[Bandage] removes poisons and bleeds, and grants immunity to poison and bleed for 10 seconds" (previously granted immunity to poison and bleed for 5 seconds).
  - Increasing the effect of [Ursa's Bravery] to "While in a flag area, stamina recovery rate is increased by 35%" (was 20%).
  - Increasing the effect of [Ursa's Ferocity] to "Each 1 enemy hero you kill increases damage dealt by 12% for 15 seconds" (was 10% for 10 seconds).
  - Increasing the effect of [Ursa's Bloodthirst] to "Each 3 enemy soldiers you kill increases damage dealt by 10% for 15 seconds" (was 10% for 10 seconds for each 5 soldiers killed).
  - Increasing the effect of [Tiger's Ward] to "While in a flag area, damage dealt is increased by 12%" (was 10%).
  - Increasing the effect of [Tiger's Wrath] to "Movement speed is increased by 8% while at below 40% health" (previously triggered while below 30%).
  - Increasing the effect of [Tiger's Tail] to "Armor penetration increased by 45" (was 40).

[h3]- Weapon Runes[/h3]
1. Longsword & Shield
  - Increasing the effect of [Rapid Action] to "All damage increased by 100 while at above 70% health" (was 70). We have also fixed an issue where the bonus damage didn't trigger in some situations.
2. Shortsword & Shield 
  - Altering the effect of [Wargod Wings] to "All damage is increased by 10% while above 50% health, and damage taken is reduced by 8% while below 50%" (previously increased damage by 12% and granted 8% to all defenses).
  - Increasing the duration of [Wargod Beak] to "For every 1 hero kill or assist, nearby allies have their damage increased by 10% and damage taken reduced by 10% for 12 seconds" (was 8 seconds).
3. Musket
  - Increasing the effect of [Blazing Glory] to "Using [Fine Gunpowder] reduces the cooldowns of [Scatter Shot] and [Five Rounds Rapid] by 2 seconds" (previously reduced cooldowns by 1.5 seconds).
4. Bow
  - Fixed a bug where the damage bonus of Hail of Arrows didn't match.
  - Fixed a bug where the damage bonus of [Bone Piercer] didn't match.
5. Short Bow
  - Increasing the effect of [Spectre's Hatred] to "The damage of poison is increased by 120% and its duration is decreased by 50%" (damage was previously increased by 100%).
  - Altering the effect of [General's Fury] to "On every 3rd [Basic Attack], fire 3 arrows at 50% power" (was 40% power). The three arrows fired might not all hit their intended targets making the damage increase less obvious. So, we are increasing the damage of each arrow, making this rune more potent on medium distances.
6. Dual Blades
  - Increasing the effect of [Mithras' Light] to "Restore 15% health for every 1 hero kill or assist" (was 8%).

notes.title: CONQUEROR'S BLADE DECEMBER 16TH UPDATE LOG
notes.notes:
Hello there, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on December 16th, which will last for 3 hours and run between 12:30-15:30 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 8,000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honor, and 15 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

[h2]I. NEW SEASON PREVIEW[/h2]

Highlanders Season available on Dec. 21

The horns of war are sounding once more! Let us witness the legend of the Celtland warriors together!

That sound... The Highlanders are piping on their bagpipes!
The Highlanders season is coming to Conqueror's Blade on Dec. 21st as a free update.

[h2]UNITE THE CLANS: 3 NEW UNITS[/h2]

Freedom is calling. Recruit warriors from the far reaches of the Highlands and unlock three new Seasonal Units comprised of the bravest and best the realm has to offer. Band together with your kinsmen and draft the following Highlanders throughout Season Highlanders.

• Bagpipers (3-Star): The first unit of its kind, a morale-boosting band whose musical weapon of choice buffs their allies with rousing melodies.
• Claymores (4-Star): These sword-wielding heroes from the Battle of Gallows Hill brandish prized greatswords, gaining more defence as they attack.
• Houndsmen (5-Star): The first animal unit to join the fray in Conqueror’s Blade, this hunting company will heed the call alongside their fiercely loyal dogs of war.


[h2]DEFEND THE HIGHLANDS: NEW MAP[/h2]

Order your new fighters to defend or attack Quinn Ruins, the historic site of the first Highlander settlement and a place held sacred by its people. The Wealish have invaded this precious homeland and ignited the will of the Highlanders, daring them to reclaim their consecrated land. This new Siege Map invites two teams of 12 players to battle for ownership, while avoiding being decimated by tar traps and incendiary catapults. 

[h2]PREORDER THE NEW BATTLE PASS[/h2]

The Season Battle Pass is now available to pre-purchase in-game. With over 100 levels of Premium rewards to unlock, your quest for liberty will reward you with everything from new Hero and Unit Attire, to Emotes, Weapon Skins, and so much more. Conqueror’s Blade is, of course, a free-to-play game, so there are plenty of rewards to be found on the Free Pass too.

[h2]PREPARE FOR SEASON HIGHLANDERS![/h2]

Prepare to make history in Season Highlanders with pre-season prep events!

We will update the game during our maintenance on November 18th, which will last for 2.5 hours and run between 12:30-15:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins, 300 Honour, and 12 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

[h2]I. EVENT NOTICE[/h2]

[h3]New [Tyranny] season map—[Conqueror's City - Counterattack][/h3]

The war against the Sarazhan empire is nearing the final phase. It is time to reclaim Conqueror's City and bring judgment upon Cambyses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/eda0bf38b4d773254cf10a9cb952d64ef1a8018e.png[/img]
 
[h3]Check [This Week’s Exciting Events] for when it is available.[/h3]
[list]
[*] 	[Bloodmoon] limited-time attire challenge event has ended. Rewards can be claimed (or paid off) until November 25th (before maintenance). Do so before it is too late.
[*] 	The [Cataphract Lancers] changes will take effect on November 25th. Stay tuned!
 Whether towns or villages, whether forests or mountains, the Cataphract Lancers never fail to valiantly charge at their enemy head-on. They're known as the ‘Reckless Demons'.
[/list]

[h2]II. TERRITORY WAR CHANGES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[list]
[*] 	To improve the overall smoothness of World Map battles, there will be no Pre-deployment phase for battles on the World Map except fief sieges and battles of stationed rallies. When starting battles including [pursuits, bandits and rebels, and marching war rallies] on the World Map, the battle will begin loading immediately.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6af0860ea9acdb57946dfaf98776bccfdbec64c3.gif[/img]

[*] 	You may select your primary unit from within the Open World menu. You can alter this at any time from within the World Map - Units menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/68767cba1efef85c82a8316e29008370e768cbfe.jpg[/img]

[*] 	Removed the Change Unit button from the Open World menu.
[*] 	Now, when a house leaves or is removed from an alliance, the alliance will be set on a 7-day cooldown during which no new houses may join it. The 7-day cooldown restarts with each house that leaves or is removed during this period.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0bad0723604ce454a5c544ac95a07b923243834a.jpg[/img]

[*] 	Improved upon how Imperial Restorationists get promoted. Apart from the Supreme Commander, Marshal, and Deputy Marshal titles, there will no longer be a limit to the number of players that can hold a title.
[*] 	Regional lords will now upgrade their fiefs when they have enough resources to do so.
[*] 	Adjusted how Prosperity is lost for fiefs that are degraded. A fief that is degraded will now have its Prosperity reset to 100. If a fief loses more than is required for the downgrade, the remaining penalty will be deduced starting from 100. E.g.: If a fief has 30 Prosperity and loses 60 Prosperity during a battle, it will be downgraded by one level and its Prosperity will be reduced from 100 to 70.
[*] 	Added detailed records for fief upgrades/downgrades and Prosperity changes to the Fiefs Chronicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a991fb8a7a30a0f422124a15be110cc6470b465b.jpg[/img]

[*] 	Territory War Reports for Imperial Restorationists will now contain battle information for their legion in the fief.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e0fad74343c707961ff00384f7a75d936548a3e4.jpg[/img]

[/list]
 

[h2]III. BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[list]
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the [Shenji Grenadiers: Reserve] doctrine didn't take effect if only a few units were remaining.
[*] 	Adjusted the [Shenji Grenadiers]'s portrait in the unit menu.
[*] 	Adjusted the [Shenji Grenadiers]'s [Throw Grenades] skill description to make it easier to understand how it actually works.
[*] 	Throw grenades using a method depending on the target area, dealing area damage, and knocking down enemy units hit. This skill has its own ammo cost. Following this, the unit will gain an increased rate of fire and accuracy, enabling them to pressure the target area for 10 seconds. Giving them another command will interrupt this effect.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the [Black Dragon Archers] showed the wrong type in the Unit menu.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the [Janissaries Hackbuteers] unit's final node didn't have the description of identification.
[*]	Resolved an issue where Prefecture Guards’ skill [Prefecture Drill] would not take effect after using [Cover Commander].
[*] 	Slightly increased the duration of the [Feline Swiftness] rune's movement speed increase, so that a single [Evade] will no longer cover its entire duration.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where some players couldn't use 'Remember account' with some game versions.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where units would consume the wrong amount of food when changing units while leaving a city.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where players that didn't belong to the Free Houses or the Imperial Restorationists would see the tyrant's war rally lines in green.
[*] 	Added a second confirmation window when alliances remove a house from their roster. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/adf17f77a98bb2493ab246f78c8057c049e78b2d.jpg[/img]

[*] 	Added a control guide to the World Map - Units and World Map - Open World menus. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/48cef96b2f4fc0f73872b952975142f19e568267.jpg[/img]

[*] 	Resolved an issue where an error code would be displayed in some menus.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the camera wouldn't follow on the World Map after clicking the the ruling house prompt.
[*] 	Improved the visuals of some menus and texts.
[*] 	Resolved an issue with the Throwing Axes III quest description.
[*] 	Resolved an issue with the quest counter for the 'Use bows or crossbows to kill 100 enemy soldiers' weekly Valour quest.
[*] 	Adjusted how artillery components drop from Siege, Field, and Pursuit battles. Destroying uncommon, rare, and epic artilleries has a high chance of dropping artillery components of an equal level, with a low chance of dropping components one level higher. Destroying legendary artilleries has a high chance of dropping legendary components. 
[/list]

After the maintenance we will give all players 12,500 Bronze Coins, 500 Honour, and 20 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.

[h3]2. Sandstorm Gorge Ranked Battle Time Change[/h3]

Following our surveys on Ranked Battle times on the SG server, the Ranked Battle times will with this update be changed to conform to those of the LA, DI, and JC servers. This should solve some matchmaking issues and enable you to find games quicker, for an overall better gameplay experience.
[Sandstorm Gorge] New Ranked Battle times:

Fridays 15:00-19:00 (UTC+3)

[h3]3. [Crimson Wasteland] Drop Event[/h3]

The [Crimson Wasteland] drop event is ending, and the exchange menu will be available until November 18th (before maintenance).


[h2]II. TERRITORY WAR CHANGES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

After having monitored Territory War and receiving feedback from you Warlords, we will continue to iterate on and improve the World Map gameplay experience.
[list]
[*] 	Now, you can replace your primary unit while on the world map and not in a battle by pressing the units button. There you can also check the units of your allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4804480e5544339056e8c2c3058577ee4dc5ec88.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/45cce4e3bb948f46ec25fde93c726f687511181b.gif[/img]

[*] 	Made adjustments to how the Warband Builds and Pre-battle Deployment windows work. Now, your primary unit will always be shown in the leftmost slot. When used, the second unit will instead take its place. Should your primary unit fall and you haven't set another unit as your primary unit, your second one will automatically take its place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4df052a9f25c549ff498a1cd82a154df55b4b37e.gif[/img]

[*] 	Now, temporary camps set up by faction lords in war rallies may provide food replenishments and healing for Imperial Restorationists.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5b84f9403c5d6af4c26eac0ec926e86d7eba794c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2bb092ee384d5d503dd8959a89fb0ce19d95db17.jpg[/img]

[*] 	Now, the members of the house that will command the next battle of a fief will receive a more obvious notification. By opening the map (key “M”) upon receiving it, they can directly access the corresponding fief's menu.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/46fd91bf3ab8390491214ab7f373a7eefc30ec1f.jpg[/img]

[*] 	To make it more difficult to miss important battle notifications, high-tier house members will receive a rather obvious notification when their house will command the next battle of a fief. May your battles be victorious!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1943e222dab0f1bcff4032592499732a3e237c70.jpg[/img]

[*] 	We've also added Acclaim comparison to Imperial Restorationists' battle reports.
[*] 	Increased the cooldown for joining a new alliance after the house leaves or is kicked from their previous one to 7 days.
[/list]


[h2]III. BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[list]
[*] 	Improved unit pathfinding on the ladder below A on [Emerald River], making their movement smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7d231ff466904ea52b123e27b9f4202d71cd9188.png[/img]

[*] 	Improved a pathway near C on [Sun City] and blocked it off with wooden boxes to prevent heroes from entering and getting stuck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1faa0ecc47caa18f99280000cac9b943391531d8.png[/img]
 
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the reinforcements wouldn't advance after capturing the docks on Heilung Fjord.
[*] Improved the weapon tutorial. Players will no longer be required to select a second weapon with which to challenge Master-at-Arms.
[*] 	Resolved an issue with the descriptions regarding debuffs for the poleaxe hero's [Grim Harvest] and [Halberdier's Thrust] skills.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where not all attires would be displayed if using the mouse scroll to scroll down in the unit [Customization] menu.
[*] 	Changed the house quest [Great Achievements]'s description in Territory War. A house now needs to occupy fiefs for 1/2/3 time(s) in fief battles.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the label text of some units didn't fit within the label.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where it sometimes wasn't possible to scroll down to the very bottom of the Customization menu using the mouse scroll.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the red notification marker of a camp being attacked would erroneously appear on the Units button.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the countdown of rallies in Territory War wasn't always displayed.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where players could get stuck within a fief on the world map under some circumstances.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where Imperial Restorationists might be prompted to an enemy faction's war rally when trying to quick-join a war rally.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the volume for the Shenji Grenadiers' skills and lines would sometimes be very high.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where black block would appear where the Shenji Grenadiers threw their grenades.
[*] 	Lords issuing a war rally will now raise high their faction's banner when doing so.
[*] 	Improved pathfinding for some parts of the world map.
[*] 	Improved the visuals of some menus and texts.
[/list]

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade November 4th Update Log
notes.notes:
Hello there, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on November 4th, which will last for 2.5 hours and run between 12:30-15:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins, 300 Honour, and 12 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:


[h2]I. BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[list]
[*] 	Resolved a bug where Grayhair Garrison will gain extra recovery on blocking.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the Axe Raiders would remain in melee even after regaining their ammo. 
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the Axe Raiders would trigger a [Deadly Resolve] when dropping below 65% health.
[*] 	Adjusted the location of the airwalls near the supply points on either side of A on the [Turul Város] siege map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/75e11737b84f82a40c37bbcd4542508650d731c1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/aa85583538ca0793f41d3d9aad03dcd4c0966fc6.png[/img]
 
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the respawn point didn't display properly on the Frontier Camp map.
[*] 	Reduced the respawn and capture time on the beginner’s Augolia map for the tutorial Siege Battle.
[*] 	Added records of Prestige reduction caused by fiefs being degraded to house reports in the Territory War Report.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5b1b7a56b92c11bdbfe960dc8fba1b3757ddaa7d.png[/img]

[*] 	Added warpaths that run between rallies and their destinations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e6e980084aa5d70995361efffa7af88d1f2b15c8.png[/img]
 
[*] 	To avoid confusion, a war declaration that doesn't result in a Prestige loss will instead have its prestige change displayed with '--' in the Prestige details menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c2903cf419e93652deb9eeb4d949aee87949a652.png[/img]
 
[*] 	Improved the visuals of texts in some menus.
[*] 	Bandits of Sarazhan invaded and the common people struggled for survival. Fortunately, you Warlords beat back the threat and restored peace. With their rascals gone, local markets in places like Zadeni are once again open for business.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/05c01641fac08d06ffdfd5401bcf5b32a18cd8e2.png[/img]

[*] 	Resolved an issue with wrong icons on artilleries in use by others.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the background may display wrongly in the Seasonal Unit Challenges menu when changing seasons.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where only one yellow notification would appear (players had to close the first one to trigger the following one) after earning multiple weapon attires at the same time.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the UI sometimes wouldn't display correctly after joining a rally.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where it was sometimes only possible to see rallies in the current region.
[*] 	Upgraded the report-player menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/46ddb225048e8cad01bb6015f13fb7f299e59386.png[/img]

[*] 	Improved the visuals of the menu when interacting with fiefs on the world map.
[*] 	Prestige requirements have been removed from declaring war against Conqueror's City and Conqueror's Gate.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the chat bubble atop the tyrant's rallies would be empty.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where some weekly packs couldn't be obtained when one's inventory was full.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the Sanguine Tide mount attire appeared with two reins.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where banner unlock conditions couldn't be seen in the Unit Customization menu.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the hems of the [Cloudfrost] and [Daylight Rainbow] sets were too big and clashed.
[*] 	Resolved a localization issue where [Free Battles] and [Open Battles] weren't differentiated in some languages.
[/list]

[h2]II. HERO BALANCE CHANGES[/h2]

[h3]	[Spear]:[/h3]

[b]	[Dismounting Strike]:[/b]
Base piercing damage caused has been reduced to 180% (was 260%)

[h3]	[Nodachi]:[/h3]

[b]	[Bloodcraze]:[/b]
The buff [Bloodcraze] will no longer end when casting [Monstrous Blade] or [Dragon's Leap].
[b]	[Samurai's March]:[/b]
Increased the second strike's block break.
[b]	[Blood Oath III]:[/b]
Now grants 2 stacks of [Health Drain] (previously refreshed the duration of Bloodcraze).
[b]	[Basic Attack]:[/b]
Adjusted the attack interval between the three stages of basic attacks, making it possible to chain attacks.
[b]	[Sprint Attack]:[/b]
Adjusted Sprint Attack's attack animation.

[h3]	[Poleaxe]:[/h3]

[b]	[Push Back]:[/b]
The attack distance of [Push Back] has been increased to 4.2m (was 2.8).
[b]	[The Old Billhook III]:[/b]
Cooldown has been increased to 8 seconds (was 7).
Enemies hit will be slowed by 40% for 8 seconds (was 6).
[b]	[Weapon Dance]:[/b]
Added a new extra effect: Each enemy hit will grant 5% damage reduction to all types of damage for 5 seconds, stacking up to 10 times.
[b]	[Bec de Corbin]:[/b]
Adjusted its extra effect. Each enemy hit will now increase damage by 5% for 3 seconds, stacking up to 10 times. Previously it reduced the armor of hit enemies.
[b]	[Grim Harvest]:[/b]
Added a new extra effect: Enemies hit will have all of their defenses reduced by 20% for 5 seconds.
[b]	[Halberdier's Thrust]:[/b]
Adjusted its extra effect. The first strike deals 300 Bleed damage per second for 3 seconds, and the second strike deals 600 Bleed damage per second for 5 seconds. Previously only the second strike dealt Bleed damage.
[b]	[Combat Dismount]:[/b]
Increased block break.

notes.title: Oct. 28 UPDATE LOG
notes.notes:
Hello there, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on October 28th, which will last for 2.5 hours and run between 12:30-15:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins, 300 Honour, and 12 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

[h3]I. EVENT NOTICE[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3af96d5c8096e9cdb39bd9afccbd3494119a97cb.jpg[/img]

The Halloween event Blood Wasteland begins.

[h3]II. TERRITORY WAR CHANGES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

    After having monitored Territory War and receiving feedback from you Warlords, we will be making the following changes:

[list]
[*] 	To ensure that the Ruler's Flag remains relevant during all stages of a season for the contention of the ruling house, it will now grant a 10% (up to a maximum of 1,500) of the house current Prestige within the area. It previously granted 200.
[*] 	We have come to believe that prosperity currently is not working as we wanted it to, so we are making the following changes: A fief with 30 prosperity or greater won't have its prosperity changed when upgraded. If it has less than 30, it will be raised to 30 after the upgrade. A fief that is demoted will have its prosperity set to 20.
[*] 	We're also changing the effect Territory War has on a fief's prosperity so that players are more inclined to defend the center part of a fief. For each time the center is occupied, the fief's prosperity will drop by 15. If the attackers claim the defenders' base, the fief's prosperity will drop by 50.
[*] 	Added Prestige details to the Noble Houses' house menu. Here you can see records and reasons of house's recent prestige changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c25a753c2dcb090b81b45a6a26e267bb4fcb3b6b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ac4a917864050bd2bbfb4927b676b3c23d6cb497.png[/img]

[*] 	Imperial Restorationists can check time remaining till next war rally during Territory War.
[*] 	Improved the visual experience when opening Territory War reports.
[*] 	Improved the artillery deploy UI marker in Territory War so that it is easier to see.
[/list]

[h3]III. HERO BALANCE CHANGES[/h3]

[list]
[*] 	Shorten the skill delay time of [Marked for Death] and [Rough Justice] for Dual Blades and Poleaxe heroes.
[*] 	Based on feedback and analyzing game data, we've decided on making changes to the Spear hero's [Combat Dismount] skill, as well as other balancing changes to the Poleaxe and Nodachi heroes.
[/list]


[h3]IV. BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

[list]
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the animation would joggle when changing to a melee weapon with the Shenji Grenadiers at follow. 
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the attack animation of the Iron Reapers (sword) was missing. 
[*] 	Using an unlock order for a unit challenge will automatically claim applicable rewards.
[*] The character will now check their new outfit after equipping a new attire in the Customization menu.
[*] 	Improved upon camps on the World Map, making them clearer and more real.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where hitting a wall with artilleries would sometimes restore its health instead of dealing damages.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where fall damage didn't properly register in some cases.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where the [Serfs] unit couldn't equip Sword & Shield Charge doctrines.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where weapon attires couldn't be unequipped from the Customization menu if it is not your current weapon type.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where some parts of the Black Feather Dance attire didn't display as intended.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where Death Info would sometimes be displayed incorrectly.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where kits couldn't be forged in Blackwater Castle and Liangshan Castle.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where one sometimes couldn't check rally info in other regions.
[*] 	Resolved an issue Ostaria didn't show up as a choice when selecting a region filter when trading materials.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where calvary units could scale the walls in the unit-training map.
[*] 	Added visual guidance to the weapon-training map.
[*] 	Added a sound effect for the gate's destruction to the Frontier Camp map.
[*] 	After unlocking any of season 8's units, their story quests can be accepted from any capital. Completing these will grant a unit-exclusive doctrine.
[*] 	Added an extra spawn point for the attackers on the [Valley Fortress] siege map to give more offensive options.
[/list]


[h3]V. UNIT BALANCE CHANGES[/h3]

	Kheshigs Changes:

[b]	1. Improved the [Heroic Charge] skill.[/b]

	This is now a two-part Charge, where the first part is [Heroic Charge] and the second is [Returning Charge].
	The active attack works identically to the previous [Heroic Charge].
	Revised the description of [Heroic Charge] skill
The first part of [Heroic Charge] will reduce the taken damage by 20%
The second part of [Heroic Charge] will increase the slashing damage by 20%
The first part of [Heroic Charge] will last for 10 seconds.

[b]	2. A new skill [Returning Charge]:[/b]

	Active: Perform a [Returning Charge] towards the hero's location. Slashing damage dealt is increased by 20% during [Returning Charge]'s duration.
	Only useable after [Heroic Charge].

[b]	3. A new skill [Frenzied Onslaught]:[/b]

	Passive: The Kheshigs launch a series of attacks, wounding and lacerating enemies hit.
	Active: The Kheshigs attack fiercely for 5 seconds, while also taking reduced ranged damage as they lower their bodies. They will attack with reduced speed for 10 seconds after their frenzied assault.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade October 21 Update Log
notes.notes:
Hello there, Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on October 21st, which will last for 2.5 hours and run between 12:30-15:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins, 300 Honour, and 12 Unit Medals as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure to arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

[h3]I. Event Notice[/h3]

[list]
[*] 	The [Golden Wind] Ancient Knife Coin exchange event will be ending. Be sure to redeem the rewards you want while you can.
[*] 	The [Golden Wind] login event is ending.
[/list]

[h3]II. Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3]

[list]
[*] 	Resolved an issue where Veterancy Points increasing the duration of Deadly Resolve for the Axe Raiders didn't take effect.
[*] 	Resolved an issue where our anti-cheat system incorrectly affected the rate of fire of inner growth and doctrines for ranged units.

notes.title: [Season Preview]: Tyranny Season HUGE Update/Changes Notice
notes.notes:
Reporting in! I've got a secret report from afar!

We're launching a huge update with plenty of changes on September 28th when the Tyranny season launches! Be sure to read all about it for the latest information and get a head start on your coming journey!

[Hero Specializations], [Unit Tree], [Crafting & Schematics], [Season Shop] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/888c225fdb4a2cb129b1ebc9a4e56798b33179f2.png[/img]

[h3]I. [Hero Specializations][/h3]

We will be making changes to the [Hero Specialization] system with the [Tyranny] season.
[Skill Pages] will no longer be required to unlock and upgrade [Victory Skills]. Instead, you can unlock and upgrade them with [Mastery Points].
Regarding [Skill Pages]. As [Skill Pages] will no longer be needed to unlock skills, we will be returning all [Skill Pages] you have spent on unlocking victory skills during previous seasons and run a [Skill Page] exchange event. Check under [Activities (O key)] for what items you can exchange [Skill Pages] for. 

During the Skill Page Exchange Event, players can change all previously spent and all currently owned Skill Pages to following: 

[list]
[*] 	Attire Chests
[*] 	Mastery Points
[*] 	Bronze Coins
[*] 	Unit Medals 
[*] 	Honour
[/list]

Unused [Skill Pages] will be converted into [Skill Points] once the event ends. In modes where you can earn [Skill Pages], such as [Deathmatch], you will instead earn [Mastery Points]. [Skill Pages] will no longer be obtainable.

[h3]II. [Honour] & [Unit Tree] [/h3]

During previous seasons, gaining [Honour] has been one of the greatest goals for many a Warlord: accumulate [Honour] and spend it on unlocking powerful units in the [Unit Tree]. To aid you all in creating your own elite army, we will be making a range of adjustments to [Honour] and the [Unit Tree]. 
[olist]
[*]  We will be adjusting the order of [Unit Tree] nodes: by moving attribute bonus nodes further down the line, you will be able to acquire and use units earlier than before. 
[*]  We will return [Honour Reset Tokens] to you based on your character level. 
[/olist]

[h3]III. [Forging] & [Schematics] [/h3]

To reduce the difficulty of forging equipment, we will be merging [Schematic types] into new items with the start of the [Tyranny] season. All [Uncommon/Rare] weapon schematics will be merged into a single schematic, and the same goes for armours. Previous schematics in your bag will be changed to the corresponding replacements, which will be sent to your Mail. 

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14fHmghia329O6vRE58a_y2HiL8qdmM1z2-s2-rsh5OI/edit?usp=sharing


[h3]IV. [Personal History] & [Unit Training Plans] [/h3]
Starting from the [Tyranny] season, [Personal History] and [Unit Training Plans] will be merged into a new item. Resetting hero attributes and unit nodes will require the new item [Secret Training Missive]. [Personal History] and [Unit Training Plans] in your inventory will be converted into an equal number of [Secret Training Missives], with the new items being sent to your Mail. 

We hope that these changes will remove some unnecessary obstacles on your path to greatness, and bring you greater freedom in choosing weapons and units. Hopefully, you will now be able to experience a better warfare gameplay than ever in Conqueror's Blade! 

[h3]V. [Unit Changes] [/h3]

1. Unit Leadership Changes 

Currently, most 5-star units have fairly high leadership requirements, which is somewhat limiting possible strategies. And so, we will be reducing the leadership requirements of 5-star and some 4-star units in the new season to bring an all-around more diversified strategic experience. 
Most changes will be in the ballpark of 5-30 leadership. 

2. Unit Balance Changes 

Some 5-star cavalry units are having a hard time in the current meta, and we will gradually be making changes to this. We will during the season be improving the Kheshigs and Cataphract Lancers in their Charges and Follow Charges. 

[b]You can get the latest news by following [url=https://www.conquerorsblade.com]Conqueror‘s Blade[/url] on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/conquerorsbladedevs]Conqueror's Blade devs Twitch[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/ConquerorsBladeASIA]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/ConquerorsBlade]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/5rGn4Sb]Discord[/url]. 
[/b]

notes.title: Modao Battalion Changes
notes.notes:
While changing the Modao Battalion from a 4-star unit to a 5-star, we also increased their overall stats to ensure that they performed in line with other 5-star units.

[olist]
[*]  Increased anti-charge while in Battalion state. In this state, they also gain extra damage reduction to all types of damage.
[*]  Increased the damage and target cap of Modao Order, and reduced its cooldown. The Modao Battalion will now be able to use Modao Order more frequently and attack squads with higher unit density, leading their allies to advance.
[*]  Increased their ability to withstand ranged damage while using skills, giving them greater survivability in frontal confrontations.
[*] Leadership increased to 320 (up from 280; 305 during the Golden Silhouette season) to better conform to their power as a 5-star unit.
[/olist]
We trust that you will all make great use of this new 5-star unit in battle!

notes.title: [Dynasty] Modao Battalion Unit Rarity Changes
notes.notes:
Esteemed Warlord:

The Dynasty season drawing nearer with each passing day. Soon you may cross the majestic Cloudward and Jiange Forts, and explore the mysterious eastern Longting region and the thriving Haojing.
Yet, even though the time is nearing, our designers are working hard to iron out the details. We're going to make the following changes to the Modao Battalion unit:

[b]1. We envisioned the Modao Battalion as a 4-star unit, but are now upgrading it to a 5-star one.[/b]

After a series of tests, we have realized that its power far surpasses that of a 4-star unit. Instead of making larger changes, we're upgrading it to a 5-star unit. We trust that you all may make great use of this new unit in battle!

[b]2. Following this change, will the Modao Battalion become more difficult to unlock?[/b]

In short, no. We have seen just how great your expectations are for this new unit, and we will not be adjusting the difficulty of acquiring it. The Modao Battalion will have the same unlock condition as that of a 4-star unit.

[b]3. Then, will there be other changes to the Modao Battalion?[/b]

The Modao Battalion will require a bit less leadership when compared to other 5-star units. We are hoping to try bringing about a manner of change to Conqueror's Blade's warfare ecology with this change. This trial will also serve as a point of reference for how we decide to implement changes in the future. We will be exploring a variety of venues for change, including leadership, complexity, power, skills, and more. Feel free to share with us any feedback you may have on the topic!

[b]4. Unit Challenge Quest Tuning[/b]

We aim to create a more diverse gameplay experience where a greater variety of units are used. To this end, we will be lowering the completion requirements of all seasonal unit quests by 2 for each phase. This means that you will need to complete 6 quests per phase for 3-star units (down from 8), 8 for 4-stars (down from 10), and 10 for 5-stars (down from 12). This should increase the speed at which you can unlock the units of previous seasons, and enable you to use a greater variety of units.
We will continue to fine-tune the gameplay experience units bring to the table, and improve upon them in any way we can.

Once again, thank you Warlords for staying with us these past two years. We are forever grateful for your continued support!
May you trample your foes beneath your army's hooves in the Dynasty season!

[b]Info:[/b]

Runes are mysterious signs containing the wisdom of the gods which Viking shamans use to empower their warriors. Yet, merchants and traveling scholars soon discovered that as the people of the far east studied heaven and earth, they gained knowledge of the laws of the universe from which they garnered arcane understanding. The underlying principle of their newfound knowledge was very similar to that of the seemingly unorganized Viking runes.
They discovered the Heavenly Stems used to record the cycle of life and death, and the Earthly Branches used to record the passing of time. These they summarized into 'laws' that governed all things of heaven and earth and recorded in the forms of texts and images. Using these they could discern the reality of that which had come to pass, and of that which yet had to. They used this divination knowledge to avoid disaster and seek fortune and riches.

Today, Warlords may use this arcane knowledge to gain greater power during battle.

[h3]Mercenary Improvements[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0a4656ec08135b5e1c867bf991a2b16fcc957709.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4b1db45c09f194402680faa531355afd64854e2f.png[/img]

During previous versions, auxiliary units were a weekly bonus that provided some manner of strength in battle. Naturally, as you gained more and more power, their relative value and use decreased. That is why we will be upgrading this feature in the new season. Our goal is to make them relevant for Warlords of all levels.

[h3]New Mercenary Mechanics:[/h3]

1. Auxiliary units will have fixed levels depending on the unit's star level. 3-star units will be of level 8, 4-star of level 12, and 5-star of level 15. Once recruited, auxiliary units cannot be leveled up and all experience they gained will be added to your Shared XP Pool.

2. Auxiliary units will have pre-set doctrines and these cannot be socketed, removed, or upgraded.

3. Auxiliary units will also have pre-set veteran points and these cannot be altered.

4. All Warlords will have 600 initial auxiliary points (this is increased by 100 for premium accounts). 3-star units cost 200 points, 4-star units cost 300, and 5-star units cost 400.

8. The requirements of hero levels for recruiting different star-rated Auxiliary units have been significantly reduced.

[h3]Sealed Auxiliary Units:[/h3]

[h3]System Settings Changes[/h3]

1. Added an option to shrink tooltips. You may now adjust the size of the tooltip window.
2. Added a Volumetric cloud setting under Graphics Settings.

notes.title: Dynasty Season Changes
notes.notes:
The newest season, Dynasty, is soon upon us. To bring you all the best experience possible, we will be rolling out a round of optimizations and changes to various game features and units with the new season. Read on for a preview of some of these changes.

[h3]1.	Changes to Earning Doctrines[/h3]

We have changed the drop rates for some doctrines to aid you all in being able to bring more powerful units into battle. With the season update, the Epic Leadership, and Epic Mobility Doctrines can now be gained from Treatises (drop chance is equal to other doctrines of the same quality).

[h3]2.	Seasonal Store:[/h3]

(1) To make the following items easier to acquire, we've moved them from the Seasonal Store to Conqueror's Path (they are now obtained for free).

Choice of Weapon Schematics, Battle Relics, Gold Dust, Honour Reset Tokens, Personal History, and Unit Medals.

Starting from the Dynasty season you will now be able to obtain the aforementioned items by simply ranking up your Battle Pass. That way you will be able to spend your Badges of Heroism on seasonal attires instead.

（2）Badges of Heroism are permanent but have an upper cap of 10,000.

（3）Returning Attires

With the start of the Dynasty season, the Shaman's Ceremonial Attire Set (Sealed), Ortoq Guard's Attire (Sealed), Snow Tigers Unit Attire (Sealed), and Khanate Guard Unit Attire (Sealed) will no longer be available within the Seasonal Store.

Attires from the Blood of the Empire era will be returning to the Seasonal Store, where they will be available at a 20% [Badges of Heroism] discount. The Soldiers of Fortune season weapon attires will be taken off the shelves, while the hero and unit attires will be returned to their original prices.

[h3]3.	Equipment Crafting Changes[/h3]

Attribute Changes

To improve the overall gameplay experience, we're changing attributes for crafted equipment (helmets, breastplates, gloves, and boots) in the Dynasty season in the following way:

Increased the chance of gaining multiple attributes when crafting. It will now be easier to craft equipment with crit rate, anti-crit rate, and leadership.

[h3]4.	Unit Changes[/h3]

During the last few seasons, we've been rolling out a variety of unit changes, and the first two on the list during the Dynasty season are Prefecture Pikemen and Ironcap Bowriders. The Prefecture Pikemen's charge will receive a buff, while the Ironcap Bowriders will have their mobility and ability to harass buffed, along with more burst damage.

Warlords, may your battles be plenty and triumphant during the Dynasty season!
Godspeed!

notes.title: Thoughts about the Fire Lance Cavalry changes
notes.notes:
The Fire Lance Cavalry have performed better than expected following their changes. What's more, after the update on April 29th where a few issues with the Valour skill were fixed, they gained an unexpected power spike. Their unit and hero kill statistics have increased by 20+%, performing better than all other units. We attach great importance to this and after having observed them, we have realized that their main issue lies in the following:

Their Valour skill is bar none the most powerful damaging skill at the moment, dealing huge damage to enemies in a small area in a very short amount of time. Enemies caught in the skill are hard pressed even to survive. What's more, as the burst window is very short, it is incredibly difficult to react to and counter this sudden strike. And a more or less instakill ability such as this detracts from the overall gameplay experience.

And so we have decided to make a few changes mainly aimed at restricting their burst damage potential, and their ability to wreak absolute havoc in a small area. However, we still wish for the unit to retain its high burst potential and continuous damage while the skill is active to tightly gathered units. Owing to balance and variety of combat, we made a hasty decision with the May 20th update and rolled out these changes.

However, there are still issues with the unit's current iteration and it doesn't meet our expectations of it. There's been a huge drop in its usage, and it is more or less useless on some map. Looking at statistics it fares more or less like any general 5-star unit without any specific characteristics or merits.

We understand your frustration, and we honestly also deeply regret this careless change. Therefore, we've urgently worked out a plan for how to restore and change the Fire Lance Cavalry unit. We have received feedback that Warlords find it difficult to keep at the enemy, that the unit's damage is too delayed, and too inaccurate. While they won't possess as high burst damage as they previously did, however, following the May 27th update they will once again be a force to be reckoned with.

We will learn from the mistakes we did during these balance changes, and continue to pay attention to how our changes actually affect things. We will also carefully listen to all feedback, and work hard to create a better game together with our playerbase.

notes.title: Unit Changes Preview
notes.notes:
The Palace Guards are veterans when it comes to war, and serve as an elite unit. When the land is wrought by turmoil they can always be seen upon the field of battle.

These mighty warriors are clad in heavy armor and carry iron shields. While they may be slow, they possess great defensive capabilities and favor less mobile battle tactics.

With this update we'll be bolstering the Palace Guards. Their creed is "Weapons in hand, we shall stem the raging tide; we are a force to be reckoned with!" and to reflect this we are granting them a new skill and trait. This gives them a clearer role in combat, and enables them to fit better into how battles are currently played.

Following the changes, the Palace Guards will have the following skills:

[b]1. Charge has had its cooldown reduced to 45 seconds (down from 60).

2. A new skill: Hold Position.
They squat down and assume defensive position, becoming temporarily immune to crowd control, and they increase the damage enemies take from their other skills.

3. While Hold Position is active, they gain access to the Shield Advance skill: Move toward the enemy with temporarily increased movement speed and Shield Bash them, knocking them back.
[/b]

notes.notes:
Hello there Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on May 20th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly.
The update will contain the following:

[h2]I.	Three Giants Come Bearing Gifts [/h2]
The three squads Crusaders, HypaHypa, and Legion made history in the Snowstorm CBL, where they won their respective divisions: Asia, South America, and MENA. It is our honor to have invited them to the CBL: Wolves of Ragnarök as well. May they fight many a glorious battle!
In light of this, we will be hosting a support event for these three champions running from 5/20, 14:00 to 5/22, 14:00 (UTC+8), during which Siege and Field Battles won't consume any kits. 

[h2]II.	Profession Set Description Changes[/h2]
1.	Changed the 4-set description of the Short Bow [Desert Hawk] set:
Increases duration of damage bonus after rolling by 67% -> [Roll] grants a stack of [Armour Piercing], and each stack grants 5% (up from 3%).

[h2]III.	Stage Adjustments & Improvements[/h2]
1.	Adjusted the respawn point for the attackers on the [Wall Fort] siege map. After taking control of C, the attackers may now select between multiple spawn points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ffa22b5b0eeceefac60b13d6aa21d5bc115ffad8.png[/img] 

[h2]IV. Previous Season Token Reclaiming[/h2]
1.	Tokens of previous seasons (Blood of the Empire Coin Of Conqueror, Legacy of Fire Coin Of Conqueror, and Snowstorm Coin Of Conqueror) will be converted into Bronze Coins, the resulting currency being sent by mail.


[h2]V. Unit Balance Changes[/h2]

The Fire Lance Cavalry were too strong in their current iteration, especially their high burst damage with Valour. This burst damage made it incredibly difficult for most units to face them. To remedy this we've slightly reduced the burst damage capabilities of their skills, and to offset this change, we've increased the damage somewhat.
We've reduced the target cap of the Northern Lance Cavalry's Landslide and Valour skills, and increased the blunt armour penetration of Landslide by 15% and blunt damage by 10%.
As we make adjustments to units we will also be issuing doctrine removal items so that you may easily adjust your units accordingly. 

[h2]VI. Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
1. Resolved an issue where the Block wouldn't be counted first when the Condottieri Guards were attacked after having used Charge.

2. Resolved an issue where Fenrir's Pack moved oddly having been summoned at a supply point.

3. Resolved an issue where the skill positioning of Ironcap Swordsmen would change after interacting with a supply point.

4. Improved upon the logic of the Ironcap Swordsmen's Iron Recall, making them quickly respond to orders under certain situations.

5. Ironcap Swordsmen's Iron Recall will grant them increased movement speed until they return to the hero.

6.	Resolved an issue where Market orders (or resource piles from cancelled sales) had a chance to not belong to a city.

7.	Resolved an issue where the exchange menu accessed by right-clicking some items would be blank.

8.	Resolved an issue where when a player leaving a group from the World Map, they were still shown as being in the group in the Group Search menu.

9.	Resolved an issue where Field Camps built by Legions didn't have a Legion emblem.

10.	 Resolved an issue where a map search would sometimes display two cities with the same name.

11.	Resolved an issue where, after completing unit challenges of previous seasons, unclaimed rewards could sometimes not be claimed once a new season had begun as the difficulty had increased.

12.	Resolved an issue where opening the Message Board of a city would sometimes lead to actions not being registered by the game.

13.	Improved upon the usage logic of the Shared Unit XP Pool.

14.	Resolved an issue with the number of fiefs the Imperial Restorationists declared war against.

15.	We have noticed that the attackers have a difficult time in Siege Battles to push siege towers to the defenders' walls. To time and again push your towers toward the walls detract from the overall gameplay experience, and makes it less fun to act as the attackers. As such, we have increased the health of all Siege Towers to 111,500 (up from 82,500).

16.	We resolved the issue with Sigrun's Shieldmaidens increasing defence while in basic formation in a fix on April 29th.

17.	Resolved an issue where negative digits would sometimes appear in the countdown for [Hold the Line] in Expedition.

The Border Fort's western front is of great strategic importance and a frontier to the north of Maoyang. Sand-filled winds batter its walls year around and its defenders have withstood the nomadic tribes for many a year.
Its enclosed city gate is its most unique feature, making it possible to strike back against attackers from several sides at once. The battlements atop the walls are set up in such a way that archers may fire volleys from atop with ease.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade March 25th Update Log
notes.notes:
Hello there Warlords!

We will update the game during our maintenance on March 25th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following:

[h1]1)	New Ready For War Reward Event[/h1]
1.	Full Upgrade to Sign Ins: Better Daily Rewards
To welcome the new season, you may claim more free rewards for daily sign-ins between March 26th, 0:00 to April 21st, 0:00 (Accessed via "O" -> "Rewards"). Rewards include a variety of Artillery Chests, High-level Honour Medals, Bronze Coin Chests, and Training Summaries.
2.	[Pre-New Season] Free 4-Star Unit!
The epic quest: New Journey - Proof of Bravery unlocks at March 29th, 12:00, which upon completion grants a 4-Star unit Signaculum to bolster your unit roster.
3.	Free Military Supplies: Limited-time Store Purchases
New limited-time discount packs hit the shelves at March 29th, 12:00.
Mercenary Supplies. Contains Large Chest of Bronze x3, Heroic Era Signaculum Box , Unit Medal x60, Expansion Permit x1, 10-Battle Unit XP Card x3.
Enemy Strategy Tome. Purchase grants Unit Medal x60 and Training Summary x8, as well as Unit Medal x10 and Advanced Unit XP Card x5 each day logged in for 7 days.
4.	Limited-time Purchase Packs Reset
The three limited-time packs, Warband Pack, Warden's Training Manual, Warden's Expansion Permit, will have their purchase limit reset. Warlords that buy the current ones before the update may buy them once again after the update.

[h1]2)	Better Snowstorm Ranked Battle Rewards[/h1]
