Piercing Damage 1294 → 1437

musket units
Reduce the reloading time of all musket units by 8% (excluding the use of skills)

Ironcap Arquebusiers
Piercing Damage 2231 → 2347
Demesne Arquebusiers
Piercing Damage 2581 → 2670
Janissaries Hackbuteers
Piercing Damage 2520→2580
Kriegsrat Fusiliers
Piercing Damage 2638→2698
Imperial Arquebusiers.
Piercing Damage 2712→2748
Tercio Arquebusiers.
Piercing Damage 1903→2184

[h1]3) Polearm Infantry[/h1]
Polearm infantry units are currently too weak against cavalry in their current iteration, which has led to a series of issues. And so we hope to emphasize the advantage these units have against cavalry units.
Change the [Anti-Cavalry] tag to [Impeding Force]:
[Anti-Cavalry]: Deal 10% increased damage against cavalry (original effect)
Adjust to:
[Impeding Force]: Deal 16% increased damage to cavalry. Damaging a cavalry unit also slows them by 60% for 2 seconds.
All polearm units will have the [Impeding Force] characteristic.

[h1]4) Special Units[/h1]

Loyal Guards:
Based on player feedback and gameplay data, the Loyal Guard far exceed our intention, and so we are making the following adjustments.
. Movement Speed 5.2→4.7
. Resolved an issue where their shields would provide defence on the sides as well. The shield will now only provide defense from the front.

Khevtuul:
The Khevtuuls should be a unit to harass, provide support damage, and be capable of breaking the enemy's ranks. And so we are making the following changes.	
. [Locust Swarm]: Piercing damage increased by 100. Attacks weaken defence by 3% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

[h1]5) Other Units[/h1]
With new updates changing the game, units that were previously powerful have a hard time retaining their strength, and so we are going to roll out a series of changes to Leadership costs to better reflect their strength.
Changes this time:
Kheshigs:
Leadership Cost 350 → 325

Rattan Rangers:
Leadership Cost 330 → 320

notes.title: Update Announcement – Northmen Season
notes.notes:
[h2]Season Map[/h2]
Heilung Fjord
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/76d70b123295e7f2c4d1cf547c471d688ee6199a.jpg[/img]
	
Guthorm found a perfect harbor on Vajk's Lake in Ungverija. There he erected walls and created for his warriors a castle upon the water. A place for them to rest and train. The Yatti royals send their armies upward along the Sadi River as the snows began to melt. They launched a counter attack against the foreign invaders who had ensconced themselves upon the land.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/5499430983891771280

[h2]Map Balance Changes[/h2]

[h3]Augolia Siege[/h3]
	The attackers currently have a difficult time on Augolia as it is difficult to maintain offense, leading to them having a rather low win rate. Thus, we have added a supply point for the defenders which can be occupied, enabling the attackers to spawn nearby and increase their reinforcements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/310e375faab3283dd7379548d71718c034df1203.jpg[/img]

[h3]Sun City Siege[/h3]

	The terrain of Sun City is incredibly open and the two sides spawn quite far away from each other. This has led to the attackers having much ground to play with, making it easy to use mobility as an advantage. This has made it difficult for the defenders to attain victory, and the attackers' win rate has remained consistently high. Thus, we have adjusted the reward times for capturing A and B for the attacker down to 2 minutes (was 3). High mobility is still encouraged, but with this change the tolerance for error is smaller.

[h2]Level Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Siege Battle Levels[/h3]

To improve the gameplay experience of the attacking side during matchmaking siege battles, we have added a safe spawn point near the attackers' base during each stage. Players may opt to spawn here, however, we have not made any changes to the default spawn points at the front lines.
Tutorial Levels
Resolved some known bugs of the tutorial map to improve the overall experience. Changes mainly involve the following:
1. Added voice over to the NPC Rupert in the weapon tutorial.
2. A weapons guide will now be displayed for the weapon you are using when battling against the NPC Rupert in the weapon tutorial.
3. Reduced the number of Dummies during the cavalry tutorial and adjusted their placements. This should make it easier for the various weapons.
4. Improved the UI info display of the weapon tutorial. Overhead NPC info will no longer be shown through walls, and the minimap menu has been closed.
5. Resolved an issue where the player could interact with the Weapon Rack while mounted.
6. Resolved an issue where the Sprint button would sometimes be displayed incorrectly.
7. Resolved an issue where mounting the walls on the Augolia tutorial map from a Siege Tower would sometimes make it impossible to destroy the walls.
8. Improved the supply point inside the walls on the Augolia tutorial map.
9. Added a new [Practice Makes Perfect] quest to the tutorial which asks you to complete Training Camp matches.

[h2]Stage Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
1. Resolved an issue where it was possible to mount near some of the walls in the tavern of [Turul Város].
2. Resolved an issue where no sound was played when pushing Battering Rams on the [Lesser Greenpeak] and [The Storehouse] maps.
3. The loading screens of all maps have been replaced with a non-snow filled version related to the season.
 
[h2]Season Units[/h2]
3 new units will be available this season and they can be unlocked by completing their corresponding [Challenges]. Seasonal bonuses are in effect for these units but they are only allowed to don specially customized attires.
[h3]Seasonal Bonuses: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Requires 10 less Leadership
[/list]
[list]
[*] Resupply cost is reduced by 50%
[/list]

[h2]Fenrir's Pack[/h2]

Star Level: 3
The Fenrir's Pack are highly nimble and mobile, enabling them to quickly traverse the field of battle to launch deadly attacks against the enemy's ranged troops. Though, they have fairly low armor and should when possible avoid lengthy contact with enemy forces.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3016821427445194490

[h2]Odin's Berserkers[/h2]

Star Level: 4
Odin's Berserkers may wield their bear-like strength to crush the enemy's defensive lines. They gain rage by killing enemies, and as it peaks, they become fearless in the face of death. They also tap into that rage to crush all in their path. 
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3015694891905957640

[h2]Sigrun's Shieldmaidens[/h2]
 
Star Level: 5
Sigrun's Shieldmaidens carry spears, longswords, and round shields and undergo harsh training day in and day out. This has enabled them to quickly switch between offense and defense in the heat of battle. With their solid shield formation they defend against the enemy's attacks.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3015694891902611367

[h2]Seasonal Epic Quests[/h2]

We have added four new main quests in this season, and these are: Rune Mysteries (unlocks at level 15), Fenrir's Pack [Wolf Trail] (unlocks at level 30 and after having completed Rune Mysteries II), Odin's Berserkers [Norse Grizzly] (unlocks at March 29th, 12:00, and after having completed Wolf Trail II), and Sigrun's Shieldmaidens [God's Emissary] (unlocks at April 5th, 12:00, and after having completing Wolf Trail II).

[h2]Rune System[/h2]

[h3]Description:[/h3]

After seeing the Viking warriors do fierce battle, people have noticed the power of the runes that they worship. It appears as if these mysterious words bestow them with endless power.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/5499430983888404583
[h3]Unlocking Runes[/h3]
After reaching level 15, head to the [War Scholar] and complete the "Rune Mysteries" quest to unlock runes.
[h3]Socketing Runes[/h3]
Tap the [Runes] button within the Character menu and [left click] on equipment with rune slots to access the socketing menu:

[h3]Socketing Menu:[/h3]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fa6a1ab33c9666a0606fe9b4dd0758527f63f130.png[/img]

[h3]Seasonal Runes[/h3]

Seasonal runes are unlocked in each season in the [Seasonal Runes] menu. These will become invalid at season end.

[h3]Seasonal Runes Menu:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2af2b2b6520949be510e6ee4ffacbb06099ab9c0.png[/img]

[h2]Hero Balance Changes & Improvements:[/h2]

[h3]Shortsword & Shield[/h3]
Ideas for Changes:
Based on player feedback and gameplay data, the Shortsword & Shield skill [Ironsides] is currently performing better than expected. As such we are adjusting it, giving it a better balance of risk and profit.
	
Changes:	
. [Ironsides]: Once its defense buff runs out, you will be weakened for 4 seconds, reducing the hero's defence by 15%.
. Increase the block break of basic attacks.

[h3]Longsword & Shield[/h3]
Ideas for Changes:
The Longsword & Shield currently has too low damage output and so we are raising the damage its skills deal.
Changes:
. [With Valour]: Increase each attacks' base damage by 10%.
. [Paladin]: Replaced its slow effect. Enemies hit instead have their defence reduced by 15% for 6 seconds.
. [Shield Bash]: Increase each attacks' block break by 150.
. [Sally Forth]: The final attack knocks enemies back in a small range.
. Increase the block break of basic attacks.

[h3]Glaive[/h3]
Ideas for Changes:
Glaive is currently a fairly well-rounded profession and is highly versatile. However, its damage against units is slightly worse than what we would like, and so we are doing the following changes.
	
Changes:	
. Increase the block break of basic attacks.
. Increase the area of its attack and the number of units it may hit. This serves to increase its overall AoE damage.

[h3]Poleaxe[/h3]
Ideas for Changes:
Increase damage against units to better reflect the power that comes with wielding a 2-handed weapon.
	
Changes:	
. Greatly increase the block break of basic attacks and skills.
. [The Old Billhook]: Slow raised to 40% (up from 20%).
. Added a new dismount skill [Power Cleave]: Roll of your mount and launch a Power Cleave, dealing 200% of your base slashing damage, while also knocking enemies down.

[h3]Maul[/h3]
Ideas for Changes:
The Maul is currently too strong when it comes to breaking the enemy's formation. But it also requires the player to master the usage of Stamina. And so we are making adjustments to this.
Changes:	
. [Fast Forward]: Increase the stamina cost when running. Can no longer run once stamina has been depleted.
. [Combat Grapple]: Increase the stamina cost of running after having grappled an enemy.

. Reduce the block break of some basic attacks and skills:
. Reduce the block break of the first and second hits of [Maelstrom I/II/III].
. Reduce the block break of the first and second hits of [Up from Hel I/II/III].
. Increase stamina recovery speed by 10%.

[h3]Spear[/h3]
Ideas for Changes:
Based on player feedback and gameplay data, we have learned that the Spear's burst damage exceeds our expectations, and so we are making the following adjustments.	
Changes:	
. [Full Tilt Charge]: Can no longer maintain charge once the mount's endurance has been depleted.
. [Dismounting Strike]: The skill's hit box has been changed to better conform to the visual effect, as seen from the images below:
Hit box before change:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/41abc0de4cc9a9a677b5249d57b97ef4a6a12423.jpg[/img]

Hit box after change:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/06d5e0b44bcd864b2b3ea5580df3ae4bfaa884b7.jpg[/img]

. [Procris's Gift]: Block break reduced to 500 (down from 1,000).
. [Dragon's Roar I]: Reduce the base damage bonus to 350% (down from 367%), and its set damage to 4,183 (down from 4,783).
. [Dragon's Roar II]: Reduce the base damage bonus to 350% (down from 367%), and its set damage to 5,119 (down from 5,719).
. [Dragon's Roar III]: Reduce the base damage bonus to 350% (down from 367%), and its set damage to 6,055 (down from 6,655).
. Increase the block break of basic attacks.

[h3]Nodachi[/h3]

Ideas for Changes:
Our goal is for Nodachi heroes to attempt to chain mechanics together, a profession of both high gain and high risk. And so we're thinking of making adjustments along the lines of Health Drain, Bloodcraze, and survivability.	
Changes:	
. Increase the block break of basic attacks.
. [Bloodcraze]: Grants 20% health steal, reduces damage taken by 15%, and increases movement speed by 10% during its duration.
. [Monstrous Blade I]: Each hit on an enemy transfer 5% of the damage taken by your enemy to your health for 12 seconds. [Health Drain] and [Bloodcraze] effects are also consumed. Each stack of [Health Drain] grants an extra 5% health steal, and [Bloodcraze] grants an extra 30% health steal. Bloodcraze caps out at 45% health steal.
Extra Effect: Consumes [Health Drain]/[Bloodcraze] effects and converts them into health. Recover 200 health per second for each stack of [Health Drain] and 1200 health per second for [Bloodcraze]. The healing lasts for 4 seconds, and caps out at 1800 health per second.
. [Monstrous Blade II]: Each hit on an enemy transfer 10% of the damage taken by your enemy to your health for 12 seconds. [Health Drain] and [Bloodcraze] effects are also consumed. Each stack of [Health Drain] grants an extra 5% health steal, and [Bloodcraze] grants an extra 30% health steal. Bloodcraze caps out at 45% health steal.
Extra Effect: Consumes [Health Drain]/[Bloodcraze] effects and converts them into health. Recover 200 health per second for each stack of [Health Drain] and 1200 health per second for [Bloodcraze]. The healing lasts for 4 seconds, and caps out at 1800 health per second.
. [Monstrous Blade III]: Each hit on an enemy transfer 15% of the damage taken by your enemy to your health for 12 seconds. [Health Drain] and [Bloodcraze] effects are also consumed. Each stack of [Health Drain] grants an extra 5% health steal, and [Bloodcraze] grants an extra 30% health steal. Bloodcraze caps out at 45% health steal.
Extra Effect: Consumes [Health Drain]/[Bloodcraze] effects and converts them into health. Recover 200 health per second for each stack of [Health Drain] and 1200 health per second for [Bloodcraze]. The healing lasts for 4 seconds, and caps out at 1800 health per second.
. [Dragon's Leap]'s damage is dealt faster, and its range has been adjusted as below:
Hit box before change:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ed37c75d9135af7bb491aee25836904f7b80cd50.png[/img]

Hit box after change:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5a1791d931364bc76ac4c6a0aed04166ba460f90.png[/img]

[h3]Dual Blades[/h3]

Ideas for Changes:
Dual Blades are currently performing well. [Ambush] used from stealth does however have a bit too high armour penetration, and so we are adjusting that.	
Changes:	
. [Ambush]: Reduce the armour penetration by 30%. 

[h2]Unification Changes[/h2]

[h3]Ideas for Changes:[/h3]

According to game data and player feedback, the current iteration of skills that [reduce enemy's defence] are overtuned across the board, which has led to [defence] having a fairly low value. With more and more seasonal units being available, Warlord survivability has taken a hit, and so we are making the following changes.
Changes:	
Spear
. The [This attack punctures the target's armour, reducing their defense] of [Overhead Strike] and [Dragon's Roar] has been replaced with: 'Each hit increases your armour penetration by 2% and reduces your damage taken by 2%, stacking up to 10 times'.
. [Gungnir's Greeting] no longer reduces the defence of enemies hit, and the extra effect of [Gungnir's Greeting I] has been changed to: 'Each hit increases your armour penetration by 2% and reduces your damage taken by 2%, stacking up to 10 times'.
Bow
. Enemies hit by [Bodkin-Tipped I] have their defence reduced by 10% (down from 30%). 
. Enemies hit by [Bodkin-Tipped II] have their defence reduced by 20% (down from 40%). 
. Enemies hit by [Bodkin-Tipped III] have their defence reduced by 30% (down from 50%). 
Short Bow
. Enemies hit by [Steel-tipped Arrow II] have their defence reduced by 20% (down from 30%).
. Enemies hit by [Steel-tipped Arrow III] have their defence reduced by 20% (down from 30%).
All Professions
. Base health increased by 2,500.

[h2]Avatar System[/h2]

[h3]Introduction[/h3]

We have added Avatars in this season. Change your avatar by heading into the Character menu [P]. You will now be able to unlock a variety of avatars and frames.
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3016821427452733087

[h3]Unlocking Avatars[/h3]

Avatars may be unlocked by completing achievements. Frames are more rare and are issued by Conqueror's Blade or granted as end-of-season rewards.
Having completed an achievement, navigate to P -> Career -> Achievements to claim and unlock your new avatar.

[h3]Display Effect[/h3]

1、Group Menu
2、When Checking Player Info
3、Battle Kill Prompts
4、Battle Loading Screen

[h2]Seasonal Promotion Challenges[/h2]

[h3]Northmen Promotion Challenges[/h3]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/93fc3eef8c5e2544c528c4be68ade370dbaadbb5.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fenrir's Pack (Complete 6 out of 8 quests of each stage):
[/list]
The first stage unlocks a 3-days trial.
The second stage unlocks the unit itself.
The third stage unlocks a unit-exclusive rare doctrine.
The fourth stage unlocks a chibi avatar.
[list]
[*] Odin's Berserkers (Complete 8 of the 10 quests of each stage):
[/list]
The first stage unlocks a 3-days trial.
The second stage rewards Unit Medal x100.
The third stage unlocks the unit itself.
The fourth stage unlocks a unit-exclusive epic doctrine.
The fifth stage unlocks a chibi avatar.
[list]
[*] Sigrun's Shieldmaidens (Complete 10 of the 12 quests of each stage):
[/list]
The first stage unlocks a 3-days trial.
The second stage rewards a rare general doctrine.
The third stage rewards Unit Medal x100.
The fourth stage unlocks the unit itself.
The fifth stage rewards Unit Medal x200.
The sixth stage unlocks a unit-exclusive epic doctrine.
The seventh stage unlocks a chibi avatar.

[h3]Promotion Challenge Adjustments[/h3]

We have added an extra stage to each promotion challenge that unlocks an exclusive avatar.
While unlocking the units themselves may be difficult, unlocking their chibi avatars will be fairly simple.
Increased the Unit Medal rewards for Sigurn’s Shieldmaidens promotion challenges.
The second stage reward of Sigurn’s Shieldmaidens promotion challenges have been changed to a general doctrine (was an exclusive doctrine).

[h2]Season Challenges[/h2]

Another twelve weeks' worth of challenges will become available in the new season. Complete these to learn more about the season's heroes, and to gain Glory.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5150f88fd828457d23fb5304e0d4b87b6dc598a2.png[/img]

[h2]Guthorm Fame System[/h2]

Gain the Vikings' recognition and earn standing with Guthorm by displaying your bravery in battle. Follow and support Guthorm's resistance and attain great rewards from the Vikings.
Fame Treasury
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c3cfa47b70fefec589d441ebfa4a33407c77ca93.png[/img]

Gain fame with Guthorm during the season, then talk with the [Norse Scout] NPC in a capital to access the Treasury. There you may trade for Viking treasure. (You must meet each item's fame requirement to buy it.)

[h3]Acquiring Fame
[/h3]
You may earn fame with Guthorm via the following:
1、	Talk to the [Norse Scout] NPC in a capital and contribute resources. You may do so 6 times per week.
2、	Complete Guthorm's daily quests.
3、	Complete seasonal story quests.
4、	By plundering cities (accessed via J -> Plunder City).
5、	Taking part in Heilung Fjord.
Golden/Silver/Bronze Bracelets
Matchmaking events and PvE battles have a chance of rewarding Golden/Silver/Bronze Bracelets] during the season. These can be contributed for rewards. 

[h2]Battle Pass System[/h2]

[h3]Competition Season Token[/h3]

	Your Competition Season Token will have their quantity displayed within the Seasonal Store menu, as opposed being items in your Inventory. 
Starting from the [Northmen] season, Competition Season Token will be kept permanently. The [Sealed Flame Emblem] earned during the [Snowstorm] season will be automatically converted into [Badges of Heroism] at a ratio of 1:1, and the tokens will be retained forever. However, there is a storage limit of 10,000, beyond which players will not be able to continue to receive [Badges of Heroism].

[h3]Attire Preview[/h3]

	Warlords will be able to better check the new season's attire models in the new Attire Preview screen. Seasonal attires will also come with unique actions.

[h3]Returning Attires[/h3]

	Attires from the Soldiers of Fortune era will be return to the Seasonal Store, where they will be available at a 20% Badges of Heroism discount. The Wrath of the Nomads season weapon attires will be taken off the shelves, while the hero and unit attires will be returned to their original prices.

[h2]Premium Account Improvements[/h2]

Adjustments to the amount of War Points required for extra Vault Keys.
	
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]War Points[/th]
        [th]Reward[/th][/tr][tr]
        [td]5[/td]
        [td]Vault Key x2[/td][/tr][tr]
        [td]35[/td]
        [td]Vault Key x2[/td][/tr][tr]
        [td]75[/td]
        [td]Vault Key x2[/td][/tr][tr]
        [td]125[/td]
        [td]Vault Key x2[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h3]UI Improvements to Weekly Quest Rewards[/h3]

1.	Added a Premium Account time remaining prompt.
2.	Better emphasized additional rewards granted by having a Premium Account.

[h3]Battle Results UI Improvements[/h3]

1.	Added a separate line for XP, Bronze Coin, and Honour gained by having a Premium Account.
2.	Added a display of the additional XP gained from having a Premium Account above the XP bar in the battle results menu.

[h2]Campaign[/h2]

This season's Campaign will be made up of 5 phases. Ungverija is the core region of the season, meaning that Ungverijan fiefs grant increased influence. At season end, if an alliance has ownership of Turul Város, their ruling house's liege have the chance to be bestowed the Hegemon title, and all of their members will receive extra rewards.
You can find Border Post and Territory War information on each phase below:

[h3]The Barons' War[/h3]

Border Posts between Ostaria and Ungverija, and between Bartholia and Ungverija will become available at March 29th, 12:00 (server time).
Territory War is flaring out in Bartholia and Ostaria during this time. Territory War in Ungverija begins once the Border Posts become available.

[h3]Heart of the World[/h3]

Border Posts between Ostaria and The Borderlands, between Bartholia and The Borderlands, and between Ungverija and The Borderlands will become available at April 12th, 12:00 (server time).
Territory War is flaring out in Bartholia, Ungverija, and Ostaria during this time. Territory War in The Borderlands begins once the Border Posts become available.

[h3]Massive Outburst[/h3]

Territory War is flaring out in Bartholia, Ungverija, Ostaria, and The Borderlands during this phase.

[h3]Rise of the King[/h3]

Territory War is flaring out in Bartholia, Ungverija, Ostaria, and The Borderlands during this phase.
Region Capitals: Augolia and Continopolis may be occupied.

[h3]Imperial Dawn[/h3]

Territory War is flaring out in Bartholia, Ungverija, Ostaria, and The Borderlands during this phase.
Region Capitals: Augolia, Continopolis, and Turul Város may be occupied.

[h2]Map & World Map Tooltip Improvements[/h2]

	We have made improvements to the tooltip on the Map and World Map in this season. The new tooltip has a more aesthetic design and is easier to read.

[h2]Development Pace & Some Value Changes[/h2]

To improve the new player experience, and to avoid features becoming available too rapidly, we will be adjusting the levels at which some features become available. This should make it easier to ease into the game at a good pace.
[list]
[*] Seasons: Available at level 15 (was 7)
[/list]
[list]
[*] Market: Available at level 18 (was 10)
[/list]
[list]
[*] Technology: Available at level 25 (was 18)
[/list]
[list]
[*] Events: Available at level 15 (was 7)
[/list]
[list]
[*] Mercenaries: Available at level 10 (was 11)
[/list]
[list]
[*] We have also adjusted Hero XP gained from Hero's Path—Path of Bravery:
[/list]
1st stage quests have had their XP reduced to 1,000 (was 3,000)
2nd stage quests have had their XP reduced to 2,000 (was 4,000)
3rd stage quests have had their XP reduced to 5,000 (was 7,000)

[list]
[*] Adjustments to Unit XP required to level up:
[/list]
Level 1 to 2: 10,000 (was 2,000)
Level 2 to 3: 12,000 (was 6,000)
Level 3 to 4: 15,000 (was 14,000)

As the new season begins on March 18th (Thursday), the first weekly challenges will run from March 18 through March 28, 24:00. This ensures that you have enough time to complete all quests. After the first weekly challenges, later ones will run from Monday through Sunday as per usual.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade March 11th Update Log
notes.notes:
Hello there Warlords!
    We will update the game during our maintenance on March 11th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following:

[h2]1) Season Preorder Event[/h2]

Preorders for the new season's Battle Pass begin after the maintenance. During the event, you may purchase the new season's Battle Pass from the Store's main page or from within the event menu. Doing so grants you immediate access to many bonus rewards.
Preorders are available between 3.11.2021 until 3.18.2021, 0:00.
     
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/26ff2789977d6c7d331b86f7b09bc6b5de089634.png[/img]

[h2]2) Server Transfers:[/h2]

Registration for server transfers is available from March 10th, Wednesday, 0:00 (UTC+8) until March 15th, Monday, 12:00 (UTC+8). Servers will then be taken down for maintenance on March 16th, Tuesday, 1:00-12:00 (UTC+8) during which server transfers will be done.
For more information on server transfers, check the server transfer notice:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/3015694891902926092

[h2]3) General Improvements[/h2]

Consistency improvements to title qualities: We have adjusted the quality of the CBL tournament title 'King of the Hill' and they should now be of epic quality. Previously attained King of the Hill titles will receive the same change following this update. This improvement is aimed at avoiding having one title appear in different qualities.

[h2]4) Bug Fixes[/h2]

Resolved an issue where the [Northern Lance Cavalry] unit would remain in Landslide state under some circumstances. (The issue was resolved in a hotfix on March 8th).

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade March 4th Update Log
notes.notes:
Hello there Warlords!
    We will update the game during our maintenance on March 4th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following:

[h2]1) Snowstorm Season Rewards[/h2]

We will be tallying the Snowstorm season's Territory War results on March 4th, after which you may claim your season reward by accessing Campaign (F5). Among the rewards, the following ones will be issued by mail within three working days. So keep an eye out if you meet the requirements!
1.	Exclusive attire reward for proprietors of the Hegemon and Monarch titles.
2.	Imperial Restorationist title rewards for defending Augolia, Turul Város, and Continopolis.

Now that is has been available for a time, we have received feedback from the community regarding the donation of resources. And it is our goal to further improve upon this feature in future versions.
And so, in this week's update we have done the following changes: 
1. Added additional information to the Collect Resources info. You can now see the 6 weekly donation requirements: 500, 1,000, 1,600, 2,100, 2,800, and 3,600.
2. We've also adjusted the amount of Ostarian Royalty fame you get upon completing a donation. It is no longer subject to any randomization, and for each of the 6 donations you will get the following Ostarian Royalty fame: 55, 110, 175, 240, 310, and 440, for a total of 1,330 fame.
For future versions:
- In coming versions, we will be adjusting the donation requirements depending on the situation in Ostaria, so be sure to check the donation requirements each week.
What's more, you needn't worry that it will be too difficult to acquire [Ostarian Royalty Fame]. Once available later on, fame can also be gained from the following game modes: [Clearing Ruins], [Suppressing Bandits], and [Rebuilding Ruins].

[h2]2) Quest Improvements[/h2]

1. Adjusted the completion requirements of the quest [Multi-faceted Alliance]. Warlords with a donation value exceeding 0 will now be able to complete it directly upon accepting it.
2. Adjusted the completion requirements of the quest [Forward Grain]. Previously you had to collect 10,000 Food on the World Map, this has now been changed to acquire 10,000 Food (viable sources: World Map collection, buying from the Market or defeating bandits).
3. Adjusted the completion requirements of the weekly quest [Fields of Glory]. You may now complete it by playing a certain number of Field Battles whereas you previously had to attain a certain number of wins.
4. Reduced the difficulty of the weekly quest [Heroic Exploits]. The number of units to be killed has been reduced to 300 down from 500.
5. Reduced the difficulty of the weekly quest [Valour]. The number of heroes to be killed has been reduced to 2 down from 4.
6. Reduced the difficulty of the weekly quest [Bombardier]. The number of units to kill with artilleries has been reduced to 80 down from 120.

[h2]3) Market Suggested Price Changes[/h2]

1. Equipment without attributes will have their suggested price limited on the Market. Such a restriction is not in place for equipment rare equipment or better with attributes.
2. As [luxury goods] have a rather high donation value, we have increased their suggested price cap in the Market to 10,000 Silver Coins.

[h2]4) Improvements[/h2]

1. Map improvements:
- Added icons to show exhausted resource sites, as well as a timer.
- Added a view mode enabling you to hide all city icons.
2. Added a button to switch between near and far views on the World Map, and a Browse mode.
3. Improved the cutscene, as well as the sounds, music, and NPC speech when first entering Turul Város and Ostaria.
4. Made the circle around flags when capturing them clearer so as to be more easily discernable in snowy weather.
5. Resolved an issue where the water flowed too quickly in rivers of the Trade Colonies.
6. Added snowy season effects to the F5 and P menus.
7. Added a sound effect when using Unit Medals (including General Unit Medals).
8. Added a Battle Pass image to the O menu. Clicking the image will take you to the Season menu.

[h2]5) Graphic Bug Fixes[/h2]

1. Resolved an issue where the tavern NPC [Drunkard Dario]'s cup model would clash.
2. Resolved an issue where the shoulder guards' spikes on the male Frost Steel Armour attire wouldn't be attached to the shoulder guards.
3. Resolved an issue where Influence would only display with 4 digits on the Imperial Restorationists map.
4. Resolved an issue where the 'Follow Leader' icons would overlap.
5. Resolved an issue where Influence for Augolia was not displayed on the map.
6. Resolved an issue where the Knight-Errant mask and icon didn't match.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/faee2f948f26cf329a48636b57c0642235bbf965.jpg[/img]

[h2]6) Sound Bug Fixes[/h2]

1. Resolved an issue where the hero action animations and 3d sound effects did not match.
2. Resolved an issue where there would be no sound when collecting from resource sites on the World Map.
3. Resolved an issue with reverberation sounds when hearing sounds outside the tavern while being inside it.
4. Resolved an issue where tavern sounds where unaffected by sound settings.
5. Resolved an issue where the sound of some actions wouldn't be played when adding markers to the World Map.
6. Resolved an issue where the enter and exit icons on the World Map didn't have any sound effects.
7. Resolved an issue where, in the English version, players couldn't set the video when entering Ungverija to English.
8. Resolved an issue where there would be no sound when interacting with certain maps.

[h2]7) Stage Bug Fixes[/h2]

1. Resolved an issue where Demesne Arbalists had a rather high chance of not launching any ranged attack in PvE stages.
2. Resolved an issue where the clothing style of AI heroes didn't match in the Augolia tutorial stage.
3. Resolved an issue where, in the weapon tutorial, players that selected the same weapon in phase 2 as they had in phase 1 couldn't continue to the next phase.
4. Resolved an issue where, when attacks from some artilleries hit enemies and applied debuffs (such as burn), such kills would not count toward weekly challenges progress for units killed with artilleries.
5. Resolved an issue with the smoke effects outside of the city on the [Augolia (Siege Battle)] map.

[h2]8) General Bug Fixes[/h2]

1. Resolved an issue where players could access the season menu via Promotion before the feature was available.
2. Resolved an issue with the counter of the weekly quest [Heroic Exploits].
3. Resolved an issue with the counter of the weekly quest [Field Officer].
4. Resolved an issue with the counter of the weekly quest [Booming Delight].
5. Resolved an issue where some parts of the weekly challenge quests would appear blank.
6. Resolved an issue where the bonus Ostaria Influence from Ungverija and Continopolis were incorrect. It has now been changed to 1,000.
7. Resolved an issue where players that completed the Barcyan Wildflame season challenge's fourth phase couldn't claim the final reward.
8. Resolved an issue where after the Military Exercise, the World Map did not switch to Territory War so ongoing battles did not show.
9. Resolved an issue where the prompt showing fiefs under attack disappeared after starting an assault against a fief in Territory War.

notes.title: Snowstorm: Scourge of Winter Update Log
notes.notes:
[h2]Winter in Ostaria[/h2]

Following the Eternal City's fall, the land was wrought with snowstorms and blizzards, a period which would later become known as the Little Ice Age. Ostaria had seen peace for several years and no one was prepared for the land being covered entirely in snow.
Terrible weather not seen in a thousand years and rumors of the Scourge are on everyone's minds. The people of Ostaria flood to Ungverija, spreading news of the disasters that plague their land. The Ungverijan royals are preparing to act. And while they are faced with the powerful Terrakoz Empire to the south, their eyes are set on Ostaria.
Ostaria is wrought by internal strife as well as ravaged by invaders. But what will the final fate of Ostaria be?

[h2]Dynamic Weather System[/h2]

Snow on the World Map is no longer only for decoration, but Warlords that traverse snowy regions will have their movement speed reduced. And areas with snow will no longer be able to supply itself with food rations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5c576a3fc8f3828ad1fe0c7d678398cac6bcfd3f.png[/img]

   We have improved upon how weather works in the Scourge of Winter season, with weather playing a greater role than ever before. We have given each region a climate befitting of its geographic location. Different weather effects will have a greater or smaller chance to appear depending on the climate and whether or not it is spring, summer, fall, or winter. For example, winters in Ostaria tend to be white, whereas those in Bartholia are likely to be quite pleasant with much rainfall.
What's more, weather will affect fiefs (including in Territory War), and so different strategies will have to be adopted depending on the weather conditions.
Fiefs' weather can be checked via the World Map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/94b187a85422a502f2c03da14df2f01c1a1008a6.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Ostaria: Hot and humid during the summer; cold and arid during the winter. Affected by the Little Ice Age, the entire land of Ostaria is overcome with snow.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Ungverija: The northern parts are affected by the Little Ice Age, and is wrought with snow. Summers in the south are hot and arid, winters temperate and rainy.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Bartholia: The northern parts are hot and arid in the summer, and temperate and rainy in the winter. The southern part, the desert, is arid all year round.
[/list]
[list]
[*] The Borderlands: The northern parts border on Ostaria and are also affected by the Little Ice Age. Much of the south lie on a higher altitude and have complex weather.
[/list]

[h2]Winter in Ungverija[/h2]

Ungverija is also suffering from a harsh winter, but the effects are comparatively small seeing as it is far south. What's more, Ungverija is defending their border posts tooth and nail, and have not been assaulted by the Scourge.
While the people of Ungverija gather in the warm cozy taverns, the people of Ostaria shiver in the winter winds. Ungverija was defeated in their previous war against Ostaria and was forced to give up land and sign a peace treaty. But now the Ungverijans have a chance to exact revenge. Ungverija's monarch is sizing up the different nations and wish to use this chance to their advantage, and claim as much of Ostaria's land as possible for himself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c86de28bb6621da91ac46174bbee8d4c28c88cff.png[/img]

[h2]Tavern Talk[/h2]

Warlord, winter has come. How about a mug of wine to warm yourself? An all-new tavern in Turul Város is now open for business! A tavern you can enter and peruse to your liking. Bachan the Tavernkeep is ready to welcome Warlords from near and far to sit by his warm hearth. Oh? Seeking information? How about a mug first?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b81403f3ca78e5a3ef22c994718980db5e18ab8c.png[/img]

[h2]Expedition Information[/h2]

Dark forces surge from the north. And so, our Warlords join in on the expedition to quell them. We have added a new challenge quest series which when completed grants handsome rewards, and each challenge unveils more information about the Scourge of Winter.

[h2]Reclaiming Ostaria[/h2]

[h3]Campaign[/h3]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a253ef428cd4c5e1aeaf3b74bd5ac0695a19e88c.png[/img]

	The harsh weather does not stem the warriors' fighting spirit and the flames of war still burn high in Ungverija.
	Territory War is flaring out in Ungverija during this phase.
	More Campaign content will become available as more and more of the Scourge's secrets are unveiled.
At the very beginning of this season, warlords can only choose Ungverija as the expedition target. As the season processes, the rest of regions will be opened gradually.

[h2]Clearing Ruins[/h2]

Ostaria having frozen over, many fiefs were assaulted by the Scourge becoming nothing but ruins.
And so, the Ostarian Royalty requests the aid of the Auctioneers and the rulers of each region. Mercenary warlords naturally also join this epic-scale counterattack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/31a9de9ffd84bb1c92fa3841d86d47e8623e2cb0.png[/img]

During the beginning of the season many of the ruins will be taken by bandits. Head to Ostaria via the available border posts and organize groups to take out bandits in such ruins. (Recommend to form groups)
Clearing a ruins of the bandits camped within grant handsome rewards and Ostarian Royalty fame. Gaining fame unlocks more rewards in the Fame Shop. (Up to 3 rewards can be gained per week)
As the road is long and arduous, the Auctioneers have prepared quick travel routes there from the various capitals. Once a Warlord reaches 1,000 fame, he can talk to [Quartermaster] in Turul Város for a quick travel to [Kiefernburg].

[h2]Aiding the Royalty[/h2]

The Ostarian Royalty will continue to organize assaults against these bandits, which may be joined via the Matchmaking interface [J] – [Field Battle] - [Join Battle] to take part in. Upon joining you will be pitted against bandits of a random difficulty. Clearing them out grants Ostarian Royalty fame and random item rewards. Up to 5 rewards can be gained per week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d9f02269038e545ac1f9ab93be394503a2303c52.png[/img]

[h2]Rebuild Ruins[/h2]

After much hard work from the various factions and our Warlords, peace has gradually returned to Ostaria come week three of the season. And so, the time has come to rebuild the land. Head to Ostaria and donate resources to ruins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/121ae589ae4e8827c841a8f4626a0ef9f3cdbbea.png[/img]

Completing construction quests grant Ostarian Royalty fame, as well as Contribution for your house (cohort). Once a fief has been rebuilt, its ownership will fall to the house that tops the ranking for that fief (or the NPC faction if the rank one is a cohort).
What's more, the top five houses in contribution will receive permanent Area Influence lasting throughout the season.

[h2]Donating in Capitals[/h2]

[Quartermaster] can be found in each capital, and they are collecting resources to help support and rebuild Ostaria.
Talk to a Quartermaster and donate the required weapons, schematics, kits, or luxury goods to gain Ostarian Royalty fame as well as random rewards. Each Warlord may donate up to 6 batches of resources per week.

[h2]Fame Shop[/h2]

The Ostarian Royalty provides handsome rewards to Warlords who help them quell the bandits. Items in the Fame Shop require a certain amount of fame to be purchased.
Ostarian Royalty fame can be gained via the aforementioned game modes (Clear Ruins, Suppress Bandits, Rebuild Ruins and Donate Resources).
A plethora of items from previous seasons will be on sale in the shop, including hero actions, epic attire sets, epic mounts, epic attire set schematics, different colours for this season's attires, and more!

[h2]Regional Capital Contention Information (Starts on week 7)[/h2]

We launched regional capitals in the Legacy of Fire season, as well as the contention for Daicheng (Liangyun), Turul Város (Ungverija), and Continopolis (Bartholia).
Unless otherwise stated by an announcement, regional capitals will be present in Territory War for future seasons. The contention of which will decide the season's Hegemon and Monarch.

[list]
[*] Region Capitals
[/list]
A region's capital is that region's most important city.
The various region capitals will be available on different times depending on a season's Campaign progress.

[list]
[*] Core Region
[/list]
The game's core region will change depending on each season's theme.
Core regions will be contended for according to the same rules as other regions.
Fiefs in core regions grant 1.3 times the Influence of a similar fief of another region.
The Hegemon title is gained by claiming the core region's capital.

[list]
[*] Region Influence
[/list]
Region Influence is equal to the total influence of all land the alliance or house owns within that region. Influence is a display of an alliance's power in said region.
Capitals of non-core region capitals will grant an extra 1000 Influence in the core region.

[list]
[*] Declaring War Region Capitals
[/list]
An alliance must have a region influence of at least 3000 in order for its houses to declare war against that region's capital.
To declare war against the core region's capital, an alliance's ruling house must have a region influence of at least 4000.
Should an attacking or defending alliance lose their qualification to declare war, their members will no longer be able to take part in battles of that region capital. Warlords that have already started a battle may complete said battle.

[list]
[*] Attack Order
[/list]
The order in which alliances may assault a region capital follows a strict order. Houses will be ordered depending on Region Influence.
	Once the Territory War preparation concludes, alliances that declare war against the city will be ordered from high to low depending on their Region Influence. Following this order alliances may contend for the region's capital.
	The ruling house of the alliance with the highest Region Influence will be placed first in the attack order.
	Should two or more alliances have equal Influence, they will be ordered depending on the time when they declared war.
Once the preparation has ended and the order has been set, the order in which the alliances my contend for a city will remain unchanged. This holds true even if there are further fluctuations in Influence while Territory War is in progress.
Should an alliance fail to launch an attack for 3 minutes after gaining the ability to do so, they will instead be placed at the end of the attack order.
Should an alliance fail to successfully occupy the city, they will be placed at the bottom of the attack order.
If a house that meet the requirements declare war against the city while Territory War is in progress, they will be placed at the bottom of the attack order.
Should a house for some reason be removed from the attack order, they will be placed at the bottom should they rejoin.

[list]
[*] Defense & Assault of Elite Imperial Restorationists
[/list]
Imperial Restorationists with a position of at least Decanos or Second Lieutenant may protect region capitals.
Kits are not consumed for Imperial Restorationists when defending a region capital.
Should the Imperial Restorationists lose a region capital, they will not be able to reclaim that city during this season.

[list]
[*] Region Capital Permissions & Rewards
[/list]
The owner of a region capital may not upgrade fiefs or adjust fief permissions in such a way that it would affect the normal gameplay of other Warlords.
	Region capitals will not be degraded when assaulted.
The owner of a region capital will receive tribute from fiefs.
The liege of the ruling house of an alliance that occupies a region capital has a chance at attaining the title of Hegemon or Monarch.
	Attaining the title of Hegemon
	 Be part of the alliance that successfully occupies the core region's capital.
	 Be the liege of the alliance's ruling house.
	 The alliance must have a Total Influence of at least 8,000 (Total Influence refers to Influence from all fiefs, and extra Influence gained from occupying other region capitals does not count toward this).
A Warlord that attains the title of Hegemon will receive an exclusive attire when the season concludes.
If the liege of the alliance's ruling house receives the title of Hegemon, the lieges of that alliance's other houses will receive the title of Chamberlain.
A player that receives the title of Hegemon will not also be granted the title of Monarch.

[list]
[*] Attaining the title of Monarch
[/list]

Be part of an alliance that successfully occupies a region capital.
	Should an alliance occupy the core region's capital but not have a Total influence exceeding 8000, i.e., not meeting the requirements for the Hegemon title, they will instead gain the title of Monarch should they meet the requirements.
	Be the liege of the alliance's ruling house.
	The alliance must have a Region Influence of at least 5,000 in that region.
]A player that attains the title of Monarch will receive an exclusive attire depending on the region when the season concludes.
If the liege of the alliance's ruling house receives the title of Monarch, the lieges of that alliance's other houses will receive the title of Chief Justiciar.

[h2]Promotion Units[/h2]

[h3]Alp Halberdiers[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/287bb65686c2567762ea87e0cda52cf8d7c3a9d5.png[/img]

Times of darkness calls for heroes to arise.
And here they are.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1f9d9c0b84c588eeceb65165372a75b289addb7f.png[/img]

[Season 2: Wrath of the Nomads] Promotion Challenges
The howling blizzards devour more of Ostaria by the day. But, the eastern parts of The Borderlands are suffering as well. Under the Khan's leadership men of the north ride south, the eagle of the steppe flying once again. In this season, the difficulty for the [Season 2: Wrath of the Nomads] season challenges will be reduced for a limited time. To reach the next stage you now only need to complete 6 challenges.

[h2]Conqueror's Path Optimizations[/h2]

We have this season improved Season Pass purchases. The item granting 5000 Glory will no longer be sold, and levels can instead be purchased. You will now instead be able to choose how many levels you wish to purchase, with 1000 XP costing 10 Sovereigns.
For the Snowstorm season we have improved upon returning attires, and starting from the Scourge of Winter Season, such will now be available in the Store for 3 seasons. notes.title: Conqueror's Blade December 17th Update Log
notes.notes:
Hello there Warlords!
We will update the game during our maintenance on December 17th, which will last for 3 hours and run between 12:00-15:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 7,500 Bronze Coins and 300 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

[h2]1) Limited-time Doctrine Changes[/h2]

We have adjusted the acquisition of limited-time doctrines so as to improve upon the experience. End of season results will no longer affect the acquisition or validity length of limited-time doctrines.

[h2]2) Event Changes[/h2]

As the Conqueror's Blade League's finals will be held on December 19th (Saturday), Territory War will be canceled for the day. A Deathmatch event stage will be available in its place.

[h2]3) Bug Fixes[/h2]

1. Resolved an issue where the mailbox icon would appear as if there were new mails when there weren't.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade December 10th Update Log
notes.notes:
Hello there Warlords!
    We will update the game during our maintenance on December 10th, which will last for 4 hours and run between 12:00-16:00 (UTC +8). After the maintenance we will give all players 10,000 Bronze Coins and 400 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

[h2]1）Season Rewards[/h2]

The Legacy of Fire season is near its conclusion, and you will be able to claim your rewards for this season via the following means:
1、	Territory War: Claim by pressing F5 -> Expedition.
2、	Ranked Battle: Claim by pressing J -> Ranked Battle
3、	Seasonal Store: Press O and access the exchange menu, and from there you can trade in Empire Coins for the items you want.

[h2]2) [Snowstorm: Scourge of Winter] Battle Pass Pack Preorder[/h2]

Preorders for the [Snowstorm: Scourge of Winter] Battle Pass Pack become available after the maintenance on December 10th, and you may preorder it in the store, accessed via the C key. Sold for 680 Sovereigns. Contains Basic [Snowstorm: Scourge of Winter] Season Pass x1, Treatise x1, Season XP Items, Unit Medal x10, and Bronze Coin x50,000.
Season Pass Preorder Time: From December 10th (after maintenance) to December 20th, 24:00.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1d458de0c8d47a9156aaa37cc8098eccf98b06d6.png[/img]

[h2]3) Character Transfers[/h2]

The Legacy of Fire season is about to end and a new season begin. And so, we will be making character transfers available for Warlords on Lotus Ash Sea and Dragonrise Island.
Server Transfer Info: 
1. We estimate that server transfers will be possible from December 10th until December 16th, 22:00.
2. Players may transfer between the Lotus Ash Sea, and Dragonrise Island servers.
3. It will cost 600 Sovereigns to transfer between servers.
4. There will be a limit on the number of characters that can be transferred from and to the various servers, after which server transfers will no longer be available:
The Lotus Ash Sea and Dragonrise Island servers both have a character transfer cap at 300, this goes for both ingoing and outgoing transfers.
5. Characters that were created after April 6th are eligible for server transfer.

How to Transfer:
Select the character you wish to transfer and start the game. While logged in, press ESC and select Account Services -> Character Transfer. Simply click it to access the menu: Then select the server you wish to transfer to, and confirm your choice. Doing so will deduct the Sovereign fee from your account and your character will be tagged as 'Pending Transfer'. After the maintenance on December 17th, we will be transferring your character to the target server.

Important:
1. After having submitted an application to transfer servers, you may cancel this at any time before December 16th, 22:00. Upon cancelling a transfer your Sovereigns will be returned to you (only applicable to this server transfer event). Though, upon cancelling a transfer you will not be able to apply for a new one for a period of 24 hours.
2. Characters pending transfer cannot be deleted. Should the character transfer not succeed, the cost will be returned to you.
3. You can still play on your character as per usual even though it is pending transfer.
4. Upon successful server transfer, the character's friend and blacklists will be cleared. Your character will be removed from your House, Alliance/Imperial Restorationists. Upon logging in to the new server, you will once again have to choose a region.
5. The following items and resources may be brought during the transfer:
1) Only items and resources in your Inventory, Supply Dump, and Wagon will be brought.
2) Items and resources already listed with the Auctioneers cannot be brought, neither can resources in Resource Piles. Be sure to retrieve all of these before transferring servers so as to not lose anything.
Mail and their attachments will be transferred to the new server.
6. Duplicate Names: 
Should a character with the same name as yours exist on the server you transfer to, a string of digits will be added to your name.
On the day of the server transfer we will then issue you a New Identity Document x1.

[h2]4) Daicheng (Siege Battle) Balance Changes[/h2]

- The battle has had its initial length extended to 13 minutes, and capturing A will extend the time by 4 minutes.
- Added 2 Supply Points to the attacking side. They have been placed on the left and right sides near the front line.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1481af3f6eccbff3560708dc49355e058684de32.jpg[/img]

[h2]5) Bug Fixes[/h2]

- Resolved an issue where the description text 'Our swords mark our journey.' of Expedition Knight's Piety node was displayed in green.

4. Resolved an issue where the description text of Expedition Knight's Piety node had the wrong color.

[h2]3) General Improvements[/h2]

1. While viewing as observer, the victory and defeat animation has been changed to Blue Team Victorious/Red Team Victorious.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade November 26th Update Log
notes.notes:
Hello there Warlords!
We will update the game during our maintenance on November 26th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

[h2]1) Season Results[/h2]

The season will be concluding after the maintenance on December 10th.
You will not be able to gain Glory from Battles, Expedition, Free Battles, Territory War or by leveling up starting from December 10th until the next season begins.
Glory can still be earned via Weekly Challenges, Solis Certificates, and Legacy of Fire Deeds.
The Seasonal Store will also be available until the new season begins.

Campaigns Results
We will begin tallying the results of this season's Campaigns on December 7th, 12:00.
And the final results will be available after the maintenance on December 10th.

Ranked Battle Results
This season's Ranked Battle after the maintenance on December 10th. We will then be issuing the rewards according to each players' Ranked Battle score.

[h2]2) Thanksgiving & Black Friday Events[/h2]

Thanksgiving and Black Friday is nearing, and so the Auctioneers will be selling goods at discounted prices following the maintenance on November 26th. Please stay tuned!
New Customer Gift
Thanksgiving is on the horizon and to welcome friends from near and far, the Auctioneers will, after the maintenance on November 26th, make available a new event type: Top-Ups. All to help everyone grow in power as quickly as possible.
Any character who tops up 300 Sovereigns with the Auctioneers will receive a New Warlord's Supply Pack worth 1,500 Sovereigns. Each character may only claim one pack. The pack contains: New Unit Selection Box x1 (choose between a Silver Era Signaculum Selection Box or Unit Medal x50), 14-Day Premium Account x1, 10-Battle Advanced Unit XP Card x1, 10-Battle Advanced Hero XP Card x1, and Bronze Coin x80,000.
Any character who has previously topped up 300 Sovereigns with the Auctioneers can directly claim a New Warlord's Supply Pack.
Run time: Available after the maintenance on November 26th.

[Mercenary Guild's Attire Treasure] Hits the Shelves
A secret agent of the Auctioneers has divulged that the Mercenary Guild's Attire Treasure is about to reappear. Warlord, during the Black Friday event you will have a chance to get your hands on the Onibi and the Samurai of Fury attire sets! Surplus attire scraps can be exchanged for select Hero Attires and Attire Treasures at the Artisan.
The Onibi Attire Set is comprised of 4 parts: Onibi Jingasa, Onibi Armour, Onibi Gloves, and Onibi Boots.
Run time: From November 26th (after maintenance) to December 10th, 12:00.

New Thanksgiving Products
To thank all Warlords for their continued support, the Auctioneers are now pushing forth a new batch of limited-time goods.
1. Premium Account Discount Pack: Sold for 450 Sovereigns. May only be purchased once.
A discounted Black Friday pack sold by the Auctioneers. Contains: 30-Day Premium Account, Random Rare Artillery Chest x5, Silver Coin Chest (10k) x5, Powdered Silver x15, Military Supply Chest x5.
2. Permanent Hair Dyes: Sold for 140 Sovereigns. Each dye may only be purchased once.
Available colours: Green, Gold, Pink, Red, Blue, Purple, and Silver.
3. Legacy of Fire Deed Pack I: Sold for 400 Sovereigns. May only be purchased once.
Contains: Legacy of Fire Deed x10.
4. Legacy of Fire Deed Pack II: Sold for 1,050 Sovereigns. May only be purchased once.
Contains: Legacy of Fire Deed x30.
5. Black Friday Cannon: Sold for 500 Sovereigns. May only be purchased once.
The empire has dispatched legions of men to gather materials for the coming Black Friday, materials to create Rare Cannons. Contains: Rare Black Friday Cannon x5.
6. Battle Relic Pack: Sold for 300 Sovereigns. A total of 40 may be purchased.
Contains: Battle Relic x5.
Date Available: From November 26th (after maintenance) to December 10th, 12:00.

Thanksgiving Shop Returns
Black Friday is a time for giving back to customers, and to thank everyone for your patronage, the Auctioneers have decided to prepare gifts for everyone.
The gifts contain: 
Purchase items for 500 Sovereigns to get: Mercenary Guild's Attire Treasure x1 and Bronze Coin x10,000.
Purchase items for 1,000 Sovereigns to get: Mercenary Guild's Attire Treasure x1 and Random Legendary Artillery Chest (Bound) x1.
Purchase items for 2,000 Sovereigns to get: Mercenary Guild's Attire Treasure x2 and Bitter Smile Unit Attire Mask x1.
Purchase items for 3,000 Sovereigns to get: Mercenary Guild's Attire Treasure x2 and Legacy of Fire Deed x4.
Purchase items for 6,000 Sovereigns to get: Mercenary Guild's Attire Treasure x7 and Action: Backflip x1.
Run time: From November 26th (after maintenance) to December 10th, 12:00.

Limited Discount Products
1. Personal Storage Expansion: Sold for 600 Sovereigns (40% Off), with a purchase limit of 1 per person.
2. Horse Trough: Sold for 180 Sovereigns (40% Off), with a purchase limit of 1 per person.
3. Honour Reset Token: Sold for 4 Sovereigns (20% Off), with a purchase limit of 500 per person.
4. Expansion Permit: Sold for 30 Sovereigns (40% Off), with a purchase limit of 2 per person.
Date Available: From November 26th (after maintenance) to December 10th, 12:00.

[h2]3) Bug Fixes[/h2]

1. Resolved an issue where the defenders could destroy Scorpios atop the gate during [Continopolis (Siege)] battles.
2. Resolved an issue where there was an additional selectable spawn point for the attacker on the Territory War map [Turul Város] (when selected, one would still spawn in the base).
3. Resolved an issue where players could still see messages from those they had blacklisted.
4. Fixed the issue where players cannot craft Grapeshot Cannon and Well-Made Grapeshot Cannon in Constinopolis.
5. Fixed the issue where players cannot take part in Territory War in regional capitals.
6. Fixed the issue where Barcyan Narfan Guard can deal damage to enemies through gates.


[h2]4) Improvements[/h2]

1. Added a yellow exclamation mark for players below level 30 when they are able to create a unit.
2. So as to enable everyone to prepare for the Conqueror's Blade League, we have now added Dasuo Fort to the Siege Battle map pool.
3. As the Battle of Continopolis is at fever pitch, the Random Legendary Artillery Chest (Bound) which was previously granted upon purchasing items for a total of 1,000 Sovereigns in the Black Friday 'Thanksgiving Shop Returns' promotional event, has now been replaced with Unit Medal x30.
4. Changed the suggested price for Hero Materials, Rivets, Powdered Silver, Artillery Components, and Uncommon Schematics in the Market.

notes.title: Conqueror's Blade November 19th Update Log
notes.notes:
Hello there Warlords!
    We will update the game during our maintenance on November 19th, which will last for 2 hours and run between 12:00-14:00 (UTC+8). After the maintenance we will give all players 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour as compensation for any inconvenience caused. Be sure arrange your time accordingly. The update will contain the following: 

[h2]Stage Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]

1. Adjusted the location of a Supply Point for the attackers within the [Augolia (Siege Battle)] map so that it no longer obstructs cannon fire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5022c3d50fb6634dbaeb59aeb030b2c5b7924b04.png[/img]

2. Resolved an issue, where when attackers used the cannon outside B on the [Sun City (Siege Battle)] map, they would often drop beneath the platform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/29fc8bcfb736da44097bfd6fb9a91efac8649061.png[/img]

3. Resolved an issue where the position of the Watchman of the two Bartholian Border Posts [Imre Kastély] and [Segnia] where reversed.
4. Resolved an issue where the battering ram's position deviated on [Turul Város] (Territory War).
5. Resolved an issue where interacting with a Supply Point would make some unit's skill icons disappear.
6. Resolved an issue where pathfinding would get interrupted on [Daicheng] (Territory War).
7. Resolved an issue where the searoute from [Verathia] to [Mazeri] were too close to land.
8. Resolved an issue where, after fast travelling from the Border Posts Segnia and Imre Kastély, players would end up in the wrong location.
9. Resolved an issue with pathfinding near the walls of the defender's camp in Daicheng.
10. Resolved an issue where ladders sometimes couldn't be interacted with in Bartholian fort fiefs.
11. Resolved an issue with the colours of the attackers' flag in Bartholian fort fiefs.
12. Resolved an issue where defenders could interact with the attackers' artillery foundations in Bartholian city fiefs.
13. Resolved an issue where the attackers wouldn't see any ladder icons on the map in Bartholian city fiefs.
14. Balance changes for Bartholian city and fort fiefs:
- Added more possible spawn points for attackers. Attackers joining a battle may now choose to join the battle at a point closer to the front lines.
- If the attackers have occupied the most central flag, players joining the battle may instead choose to join the battle near the city gates.

[h2]General Bug Fixes[/h2]

1. Resolved an issue where input methods to use Korean didn't work unless the initial input method already was Korean.
2. Resolved an issue an issue where when double-clicking Gather, two attempts would be deducted while only generating resources for one gathering.


[h2]Improvements[/h2]

1. Increased the chance of a [Secret Vault] appearing upon completing a matchmaking battle.
2. Added quality-displays for hero actions to the Character menu.
3. Specialisation adjustments: Added a 'Skip' button. Upon starting the tutorial for Maul heroes, it is now possible to directly switch over to the current Season and begin the challenges.
4. Added a restriction for players who has their camp set up within a region capital. When attacking the region capital where their camp is located, they may only select units that are not within the city itself.
