notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/dc32989e3689ba2dd79b785d7a2592b0e56b5960.png[/img]

After proclaiming himself Khan, Arule launched the invasions that conquered most of Eurasia and founding the majestic empire. The world was plunged into war and everyone bowed before him.

Warriors from the Great Grass Sea knew nothing about running a big empire but riding and killing. They even dreamed of bulldozing all cities, villages and farms, turning them into a wide grassland where they could herd livestocks.

Ruled by the nomads, the world became a total mass. People and regions all over the world never stopped fighting for freedom and independence.

When the Great Khan was alive, the empire could still manage to suppress nonstop rivalries.
The highlight of the empire ended abruptly when the great Khan died at the prime of life. Up to now, his death remains one of the great mysteries in history. He left a big empire and many children behind. None of his children was able to take the throne, having the entire empire under control.

Many cities started to gain power while the empire was troubled by intrigues and rivalries.
Nomads abandoned old laws but couldn't come up with new methods to rule. The world had no order after the war, but that also meant complete freedom. Many southern cities, represented by Hawkhal's hometown, took the chance to develop trade, starting to rebuild the civilized world.

One after another, those cities started to make fortune, building their own commercial culture. With the rise of trade, the demand for mercenaries increased.

Without a central government to keep order, merchants chose to build private armies to keep their goods safe.

That's when the hero, Hawkhal, ascended on the history stage. The strong hero from a southern city took war hammers as a weapon.

His past before he became famous was a secret. People only know he had many collections and treasures. Hawkhal's hometown was one of the richest commercial cities. Starting with a pot of gold earned by selling some of his collection, he gradually became as powerful as a warlord by trading.

In the name of protecting his trade caravan, he built a private legion that even some warlord cannot afford. After the death of the Great Khan, Hawkhal started the campaign against the empire that later joined by many factions.

The empire, losing its great leader, could hardly quell such a large scale rivalry. The great pressure led to the split of the empire.

The most capable sons of the Great Khan split his empire into khanates. Some khanates were overthrown by rebels. Some embraced local culture and became a part of history.

The once glorious united empire ended up with the disruption.

In the world of chaos, battles were fought everyday and everywhere, lowering trade barriers to the ground. That's the days when merchants started to play an important role.

Big merchants from the Southwest cities controlled both water and land routes by which caravans sold goods to every corner of the world. They even united together to build chambers of commerce.

Where there was gold, there were violence and dispute. That's why almost every chamber of commerce had its own private forces or long-time mercenaries.

Turning a new page of history came with blood and gold. The emerging class, represented by merchants, were changing the world.

People called this prosperous yet cruel time as Gilded Era!

[h1]1. Season Hero[/h1]
New Weapon: This update features a new weapon: War Hammer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/190227db30c23df56f3f2c1c09e473b8f3ccbe3b.png[/img]
Huge and heavy, a war hammer could deliver the blow so strong that even the thickest armors and shields cannot hold. War hammers are meant to big guys. People managed to survive always had nightmares of these heavily armored monsters.

War hammer heroes may be unlocked via season challenge this season. Climb to Lv.25 on the Military Rank in S2 to unlock this class! At the same time, the growth challenge for war hammer heroes will be available in S2. Check Season Challenge - War Hammer Heroes for more details.

[h2]Hero Features[/h2]
Heavy Strike:
The sheer amount of crowd control and damage that the war hammer hero was able to dish out is overwhelming. That comes at a cost: some attacks drain Stamina quickly.

Charged Strike:
Some skills can be charged by long-pressing, during which Stamina is spent. The longer the charging, the more deadly the skills are.

Combo Strike:
Some skills can set up combo when their buttons are pressed again. Combo costs stamina. The more the combo count, the better the effects and power.

Steady:
Using heavy war hammers as a weapon, War Hammer can only use quick steps for mobility instead of rolling.
UI Features:
Unique stamina UI of War Hammer allows you to tell the remaining Stamina anytime.
The weapon icon of War Hammer changes when skills are charged, making it possible for you to tell charging status immediately.
The weapon icon of War Hammer changes as combo counts build up to its cap, making it possible for you to tell combo status immediately.
Tips can be found at the bottom of the screen when charging and combo skills are being used.

https://steamcommunity.com/ogg/835570/announcements/detail/2069908530528885324

[h1]2. Seasonal Units[/h1]
In the new seasons, there are a total of 4 seasonal units and 1 mercenary legion for you to unlock:
You may unlock the 4 seasonal units via [Legion Challenge], including [Veteran Crossbowmen] that can be unlocked at the cost of Honour.
You may spend Sovereigns or Silver Coins on Martellalori.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/736ce4449006afa251a86e3bb6c2fdc934cd8263.png[/img]
Seasonal Units - Season Boost (Season 2):
Requires 10 less Leadership
Reduces resupply price by 50%

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9c1dbb0ed4a390a604d0528a229b4132fa5f508f.jpg[/img]
[h3]martellalori[/h3]
Star Level: 0.5-Star
Unit Description: When the flames of wars burned on this peaceful town, tinkerers of the city stood up and gathered all possible forces to protect the weak from invaders. They protect themselves with wooden shields and attacks with hammers. They are excellent at repairing and maintaining siege engines. Since they are not professional soldiers, melee combats are tricky to them.

Unit Feature:
Any siege engine (Siege Tower, Battering Ram) being used by this unit takes less damage.

[h3]Condottieri Guardsman[/h3]
Star Level: 3-Star
Unit Description:
People were forced to leave Sicily when the whole land was scorched by blazing flames of war. To take back their homeland one day, secret societies and gangs united together to build the corps. They do everything when the price is just.

It's hard to imagine most of these outstanding sword masters came from the bottom of the society. Wielding long iron swords and kiteshields, they can beat almost all infantries in close combat, including lancers in phalanxes. Heavily armored cavalry is their only nightmare. Due to the lack of formal training, they use tricks they learned from street fights sometimes.

Unit Feature:
Excellent at melee fights, able to attack and defend at the same time. Good at repelling enemies by rushing.

[h3]Fortebraccio Pikeman[/h3]
Star Level: 4-Star
Unit Description: Merchants from Venice knew how unreliable mercenaries are. That's why they decided to build their own army. They spent a fortune to recruit soldiers from nearby cities and villages and made them a part of a powerful phalanx through training. You can tell the Venice style from the complex pattern of their armor.

These phalangites were able to hold charges of cavalries with pointed long pikes in a phalanx. Such large weapons were of little use at close range and low mobility.

Unit Feature:
A phalanx consisted of long pikes, its brace weapons can slightly repel infantries. 

[h3]Pavise Crossbowman[/h3]
Star Level: 5-Star
Unit Description: A strong and united kingdom reigned on the south part of the Apennine peninsula. To defend against enemies from the sea, it spent a lot to build an army consisted of crossbowmen carrying stow shields. In the later war time, many crossbowmen left the army to work for mercenaries or private troops of merchant groups. They fought with big shields, heavy armours and foot-drawn crossbows that boasted long range and high lethality.

Unit Feature:
When they turned around to bend strings, the heavy shield on their back protected them from enemies. Bolts shot from the foot-drawn crossbows can easily pierce heavy armour.
They can shots while holding up the shield at the expense of some attack capability.
With the heavy armour protecting them well, they pose a threat in close combat.

[h3]Martellatore[/h3]
Star Level: 5-Star
Unit Description: Martellatore consists of 12 soldiers regularly. When the squad engages in battles, they set up the 4-feet cannon to fight. The expensive cannon is powerful enough to pierce almost anything. That power comes with a price - the squad has low mobility and can barely fight before the cannon is ready.

Unit Feature:
It needs time to set up the cannon before it can fight. It deals AoE damage to targets and has a surprisingly long range.

[h1]3. Seasonal Doctrine[/h1]
The upcoming Doctrine system features a lot of new Doctrines unique to this season. Compared to common ones, these Doctrines are easier to come by and with many more new abilities, however, they also have a relatively short validity and will disappear when the season ends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2668f93489aa0d721cf30fafb34463cdca4c3cb3.png[/img]
-Seasonal Doctrines will be sealed after being equipped on units for a while and can be unsealed with the same Doctrines.
-You can also spend the same Doctrines to extend the validity for Seasonal Doctrines.
-Sealed or not, Seasonal Doctrines are recycled when the season ends.
-Seasonal Doctrines work only in the World War mode. It is a great challenge to select the one that suits your units best from all those similar ones.
-Seasonal Doctrines cannot be salvaged, cultivated and they are mutually exclusive like common Doctrines.

[h1]4. Overall Unit Adjustment[/h1]
[h2]1.Adjusted Cavalry[/h2]
We believe most players have noticed that the cavalry has played the main role in almost every battlefield in S1. Being dominating in the wild and cities alike, cavalries are everyone's first choice the whole season. We admit that cavalry was very central to winning battles in ancient times as they had the advantages of improved mobility and inertial mass over opponents on foot. But it is not right for them to have the same advantages when fighting in narrow alleys:

We found that cavalry was able to run around at will in most terrains no matter it's in daily play, ranked mode or matches. Cavalry could repeatedly crush most troops, except those using spears, in some narrow places. We all know that's impossible in the real world and we believe that's not what you want from this game. After all, we are Conqueror's Blade not "Conqueror's Cavalry."

We addressed the problem after reading your feedback and parsing through the data we got from the game. Cavalry had high initial speed and course changing ability that they could hardly be stopped by obstacles and were able to reach top speed and inertial mass within a short distance in narrow areas where they had a small field of view. That was not true for cavalry in the real world. That's why we made these changes:

-When cavalry crashes into walls and big collisions (like shelters) at a high speed, they will take some damage, stop charging and get frightened.
-When charge is interrupted by brace weapons, muskets and bolts, cavalry cannot enter the charge status again.
-Reduced initial speed and acceleration for Coutiliers, Dagger-Axe Lancers, Yeomen, Winged Hussars and Cataphract Lancers. Now these units need a longer time to reach the max speed.
-Reduced initial speed acceleration for cavalry of Ironcap Scout Cavalry, Prefecture Heavy Cavalry
-Smoothed out the turning animation and slightly reduced turning rate for all cavalry.
We understand those changes will affect your game experience and we've prepared these as compensation:
-Items to reset cavaliers will be offered so you may rebuild your cavalries according to the changes. Honour will be refunded in the form of items.
-An item will be offered for you to remove Doctrines from all cavalry. EXP of removed Doctrines will be refunded in the form of items.

[h2]2.Khevtuul Cavalry[/h2]
Charge and Hunting time of Khevtuul Cavalry can be launched at the same time.

[h2]3 Adjusted Unit Formations[/h2]
In the previous version, we found that density and shape of many formations were inconsistent when there were too many or fewer soldiers. There were also cases where 1 soldier was added or removed from formations due to unreasonable distribution. We made these changes to fix that:
-Dispersed of Winged Hussars could get more intense when there were not enough soldiers. Some players exploited it for unfair advantages. We've increased intensity level for Dispersed so its scale remains when the number of soldiers decrease.
-Fixed the bug that caused formation points to disappear when there were less than 3 Prefecture Guards around the general.
-Deleted Bull Horns from the game as it was almost identical to V-formation
-Deleted Dispersed from the game as it was almost identical to Three Ranks
-Fixed the cases where Column of Shortsword & Shield got loose when there were too few soldiers.
-Fixed the bug that caused Turtle of Ironcap Spearmen to have 1 extra soldier.

[h2]4. Changed unit control logic when heroes died:[/h2]
In the previous version, operations were a total mass when your hero died. It was not clear which units could be controlled and which could not. And the view was killing when you tried to control units in the situation. That's why we made these changes to fix the problem:
-When your hero dies, his units can attack freely or follow the hero you are spectating.
-When your hero dies, units cannot line up or use unit skills.
-When your hero dies, you will be able to control your view instead of being forced to follow another hero.
-Units in the retreat status won't take orders like free attack.

Thus, we adjusted the cooldown mechanism of those skills for a better experience: Reduced cooldown duration for all skills that apply multiple attacks. The cooldown starts every time a step of the skills is cast. Now you don't have to wait for a long time when the skills are interrupted. Affected Skills:

2. Fixed a bug that when heroes stand on narrow steps and slope, the use of offensive skills (especially those with great shift of position) are mistakenly treated as falling and interrupt the skills. Please be noted that heroes will still be flagged as falling when they use offensive skills on high platforms and cliffs (Stockade for example), and the skills will be interrupted.

3. We detected many cases that can avoid taking falling damage, like sliding down walls, summoning horses after rolling and using rolling skills. That prevented walls from doing their jobs and made it hard for defenders to win. We decided to do something about it. In this update, we fixed the bug that allowed generals to avoid fall damage by casting skills or taking damage.
4. Added damage taking animation for horses when they fall from a high place.
No matter how high horses fall from, they only took damage and didn't fall down like heroes. We thought that was not natural and made some changes. Now horses will fall down when they drop from high places.
5. We upgrade the physical simulation system and now soldiers will be knocked back or up when they are killed by heroes.

[h1]6. Adjusted Battle Balance and Fixed Bugs:[/h1]
[h2]1. Adjust set effects:[/h2]

[h3]Fearless Paladin Set:[/h3]
Changed the effect of the 4-piece set from "Increases Bec de Corbin's final step of damage by 40%" to "Increases attack steps for Bec de Corbin from 3 to 4"

[h2]2. Optimized cases that skills got interrupted by base attacks due to network [/h2]synchronization. Fixed the bug that prevented escape skills (Like "Light-Footed" of Long Bow and "Rolling Escape" of Short Bow) and melee skills (Like "Shield Bash" of Shortsword & Shield and "Push Back" of Poleaxe) from being properly cast and ignoring stunned status caused by base attacks.

3. We noticed that some skills of short bow units were more powerful and deadly than we felt they should be. That's why we made these changes:

[h1]7. S2 Units Bans[/h1]
To let players have more fun in the 3-Star unit combat, we are going to use the Ban system again at the start of S2 to bring everyone to the same starting point.

-4/6-4/19 Bans units of [Heroic Era] and [Golden Era] so they can only be used in Free Battle and Wild Hunt.
-4/19-5/3 Bans units of [Golden Era] in all modes except Free Battle and Wild Hunt.
-4/6-4/19 Bans stats bonus and set effects of hero equipment in all modes
-4/19-5/3 Bans set effects of all hero equipment in all modes

[h1]8. S2 Season Challenge[/h1]
[h2]1、S2 Seasonal Unit Challenge[/h2]
Three brand new units march into the battlefield in this season. Finish quests and challenges, they will be yours.

[h3]Unit Type[/h3]
Condottieri Guardsman (T3)
Fortebraccio Pikeman (T4)
Martellatore (T5)

[h3]Rules[/h3]
Challenge
【Condottieri Guardsman】: Complete the 1st phase of challenge to win a 3-day trial.
【Fortebraccio Pikeman】: Complete the 1st phase of challenge to win a 3-day trial.
【Martellatore】: Complete the 1st phase of challenge to win a 3-day trial.

Order to Unlock: Condottieri Guardsman ——Fortebraccio Pikeman —— Martellatore
Difficulty:
The challenge of 【Condottieri Guardsman】has 2 phases, each consisting of 8 quests. Finish 6 quests each phase and the unit will be unlocked.

[h3]Growth Challenge[/h3]
Growth Challenge Difficulty:
The challenge of 【Condottieri Guardsman】has 1 growth rank that consists of 8 quests. Finish 6 quests each rank and you will get purple [Doctrine of the Unit]
The challenge of 【Fortebraccio Pikeman】has 1 growth rank that consists of 10 quests. Finish 8 quests each rank and you will get purple [Doctrine of the Unit]
The challenge of 【Martellatore】has 2 growth ranks, each consisting of 12 quests. Finish 10 quests each rank and you will get purple [Doctrine of the Unit]

[h3]Optimized the Pay Off Function[/h3]
Pay Off fee is offered based on progress made in the Pay Off challenge. High progress means less Pay Off fee.
 
[h2]2、S2 Regular Unit Challenge[/h2]
In the S2 season, [Veteran Crossbowmen] on the unit tree will be unlocked. You may unlock it with Honour or through Unit Challenges.

[h3]Rules[/h3]
Challenge
【Pavise Crossbowman】: Complete the 1st phase of challenge to win a 3-day trial.
Unlock Challenge
Difficulty: The unit unlocking quests have 4 phases. Each phase finished grants certain tags.
Growth Challenge
Growth Challenge Difficulty:
The challenge of 【Pavise Crossbowman】has 2 growth ranks, each consisting of 12 quests. Finish 10 quests each rank and you will get purple [Doctrine of the Stow Shields]

[h2]3、History Seasonal Unit Challenge[/h2]
In the S2 season, you can still challenge units of the previous season, but the rewards and difficulty will change.
Change of Challenge Rules
To finish a rank, you must finish 8 quests.
There will not be extra rewards for finishing a quest.
Switch Challenge
During the S2 season, you may switch to units of S1 to challenge via the option on the unit challenge screen.
Switching between seasons charges Silver Coins and has a cooldown.
You may only do unit challenges of one season each time.

[h2]4、Season War Hammer Hero Challenge[/h2]
A brand new class is introduced this season: War Hammer! You can now choose this class once you unlock it via the seasonal challenge.
Rules:
There are 3 types of challenges for the new class: [Rising Talent], [Ground Slam] and [Deadly Tackle]

[Rising Talent]:
It has 4 phases. The 1st phase has 1 quest. Climb to Lv.25 Military Rank in S2 to unlock the class - War Hammer along with 4 base skills.
Phase 2~4 have a total of 18 quests. Complete them to gain new skills and boosts.
Ground Slam:
It has 4 phases and a total of 18 quests. Complete them all to get the skill [Ground Slam] and some skill boosts.
[Deadly Tackle] Module:
It has 4 phases and a total of 18 quests. Complete them all to get the skill [Deadly Tackle] and some skill boosts.
Pay Off Rules:
Pay Off fee is offered based on progress made in the Pay Off challenge. High progress means less Pay Off fee.

[h2]5、Season Weekly Challenge[/h2]
There will be 10 weekly challenge throughout the whole S2 season. Finish quests on time to get extra rewards.

[h1]9. Wild Hunt is Live[/h1]
S2 introduces the 1st season of a brand new mode - Wild Hunt. Come to show what you are capable of here! We will try our best to make it a platform where you can improve your power.

[h2]1、Rank Preview[/h2]
Bronze Guard	0-199
Bronze Pioneer	200-399
Bronze Captain	400-599
Silver Pioneer	600-799
Silver Captain	800-999
Gold Guard	1000-1199
Platinum Captain	1200-1399
Diamond General	1400-1699
Military Master	1700-2099
Military Guru	2100+
Rank Score: Obtained by playing in the Wild Hunt mode

[h2]2、Rules[/h2]
(1) Criteria
According to Mountain Business Alliance, the sponsor of Wild Hunt, generals must reach Lv.100 or above to join this event.
(2) Group Composition:
A group must contain 3 or fewer Competitors. Players of "Gold Guard" or above tiers can only team up with other players of the same tier.
(3) Enjoy Battles:
In the Wild Hunt, all supplies are provided by the generous Mountain Business Alliance. All you need to do is select the best weapons and enjoy battles!
(4) Pure Battlefield
To bring the most of your strength, no currency related things (including Bronze Coins, Honour, Silver Coins and Dropped Items) will be dropped. It is all about fights!
(5)Battlefield Balance:
You will be matched with all types of battlefield maps in the mode.
(6) Engine Restriction
For a good gaming experience and power balance, there is a restriction on the number of artillery both sides may use.
Available Engines for Attackers: 2
Available Engines for Defenders: 1

[h2]3、Maps Overview;[/h2]
Hidden City	Multistage Battle	15 vs 15
Border Fort	Multistage Battle	15 vs 15
Harbour City	Multistage Battle	15 vs 15
Wall Fort	Multistage Battle	15 vs 15
Training Field	Field & Conquest	8 vs 8
Westwood	Field & Conquest	8 vs 8
Desert Fortress	Field & Conquest	8 vs 8
Grassland	Field & Conquest	8 vs 8
Augolia	Conquest	15 vs 15
Grassland	Conquest	15 vs 15

[h1]10. Improved Territory War Experience[/h1]
[h2]1、Empire Guardian Urgent Support[/h2]
To increase the maneuver of Empire Guardians, branches of the business alliance will provide strong support for Empire Guardians. When there are battles on the land of the empire, Empire Guardians can respond even quicker.
You may join the land defending battles immediately under the "Urgent Support" system and take back lost territories instantly by the instruction of the Empire Guardian commander.

[h3]Function Entrance:[/h3]
When territory war starts, a button can be found on the qualified battle line list in the M screen at the right bottom corner. Tap the button to enter the line.

[h3]How to Support Lines in Urgent Support:[/h3]
1 Generals must be in a fief to respond to "Urgent Support".
2 In attacks against a fief, generals need an Empire Guardian commander to fight via "Urgent Support".
3. Empire Guardian of the local region may reinforce any attacked fief within the territory.

[h3]Attention:[/h3]
1. Empire Guardian cannot respond to "Urgent Support" across regions.
2 In "Urgent Support", generals can carry artillery only.
3 "Urgent Support" consumes no item nor currency.

[h2]2、Added Military Rank System for Empire Guardians[/h2]
Since Empire Guardian have had their fiefs and territories, we think it's about time for them to have ranks. Lands of different civilizations have their own ranks.
Rank Type
[h3](1) Pathway to Grand Marshal[/h3]
Grand Marshal, Marshal, Deputy Marshal, General, Lieutenant General, Major General, Colonel, Lieutenant Colonel, Major, Captain, Lieutenant, Second Lieutenant, Master Sergeant, Sergeant Major, Sergeant, Sergeant, Corporal
Applicable: Ostaria and Ungverija

[h3](2) Pathway to Grand Chief Commander[/h3]
Grand Chief Commander, Left Commander in Chief, Right Commander in Chief, Regional Military Commission, Regional Military Administrator, Regional Military Associate Director, Commander, Commander Assistance, Associate Director
Applicable: Liangyun and Maoyang

[h3]Criteria[/h3]
(1) Required Contribution Pts
Merits of Empire Guardians were changed into Contribution Pts that may be gained by fighting Territory War and achieving combat objectives.
Each rank requires a certain number of Contribution Pts (The two pathways share the same requirement).

(2) Ranking by Contribution Points on a Land (including all Empire Guardian)
Empire Guardian of a land are ranked by Contribution Points from high to low. It requires high rankings to get high rank.

(3) Faction Points
Faction points of a land are decided by that owned by all units on it. Each rank requires certain faction points while high ranks always have a high demand.

[h3]Military Title Settlement[/h3]
You may get a military title based on individual contribution points, land contribution ranking and land faction points at 10:00 Sunday. When contribution points and faction points meet criteria, you will get the military title that suits your contribution ranking. Those who fail to meet the contribution points and faction points criteria will get demoted.

[h3]Military Title Reward[/h3]
(1) Military Salary
You will receive a salary every week based on your current military title at 0:00 each Monday.
(2) Reward of Deeds
Completing weekly combat quests grants base rewards while advanced quests grant extra rewards.

[h2]3、S2 Season Schedule[/h2]
"Season 2" starts on April 6.
April 10: You may fight freely on the early stage of the war.
May 4: Factions may emergence as the iron gate is ruined. Time to fight for fame and fortune.
May 17: New warlords rise to build their own forces. The empire is as good as dead.
June 14: The capital will belong to the most capable one.
July 5: With a new emperor ascending the throne, rewards of course will be offered

[h2]4、Optimized Criteria for Declaring and Joining War[/h2]
Add the function where commanding houses may set battle participants on the Declare War screen.
In the Join Battle screen, commanding houses are able to set participants for their lines.
Adjusted required family levels to attack fiefs, forts and villages

notes.title: 12/03/2020　Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear Warlords,

We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 8 am to 10 am, 12th Mar (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Warlords will receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour after the server maintenance. Here are the patch note:

[b]1.Level Balance Adjustments：City of Heroes (Siege) Adjustments[/b]

Based on the data analysis, we know that the attacker win rates of Royal Ramparts shows that this level is too hard for the attackers. The structure of the city make that trebuchets have less impacts and harder to strike at the weakness point of defenders. And, numberless defender artilleries rule the battlefield, and they are harder to be countered because of the structure. So we decide to do more adjustment on the artilleries to reduce the frustration for attackers.
-We adjust the distribution of defenders artilleries, removed couples of unbeatable artilleries, and level down parts of artileries

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6e5e5ff0254fd9934098d96533563cb72d6eea2a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ea46ae49147e835183748f386b15e58229ab0dae.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f66c26e25950a38d2f3d24804c60f3b05a9508d3.jpg[/img]

-We adjust the position of some supply points and respawn points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/685e593bbfe2a39feb0facd24fbbe0c2755dfd3f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bc9ec2147a3e69d1d908647d16875b4fa902de20.jpg[/img]

[b]2.Level Mechanic Improvement [/b]

Siege Level Balance : Equal Numbers of Players on Both Side
According to our data analysis, the Riverlands Castle will be the next level that we are going to apply this change. We are going to add 1 more players into the defender side to see will that help defender to resist from the attackers. 

Additional, considering the combat situation at final area will be changed, we decide to do adjust to the map itself:
-Move the final supply point to the side area, make that area valuable to be fight around. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/16415ca598c4730b9b402c6b7c3c474155504d41.png[/img]

After this patch, there will be 4 different siege maps that are 15 vs. 15 combat: Royal Ramparts, City of Heroes, Sun City, Riverlands Castle.
Again, we are going watch the data change and players’ feedbacks of this new change. And we are definitely going to do more improvement and iteration based on that.

[b]3.System Optimization[/b]

【Knighthood】Optimize the knighthood icon displayed in emails with titles.
Influence of the Conqueror's City will separate calculation
【City of Heroes】When the Conqueror's City be occupied the Influence will separate calculation. If the Conqueror's City lost control the Influence of the Conqueror's City will be cleared all.
【City of Heroes】The front will more conspicuous.Friendly forces is blue enemy forces is red.
【City of Heroes】Expanded the silver bonus pool in the Conqueror's City and the gate of rules,the gate of glory,the gate of earth,the gate of heaven.At the same time bouns items have added fine instrument fragments,legend instrument fragments, epic instrument fragments.
【Level】In all 8 VS 8 field battle , we add supply points in the camp area for both side.

[b]4.Bug fixed[/b]

【Knighthood】Fixed the problem that the title of the English version is not displayed.
【Level】Fix the opening camera problem of The Storehouse (Siege) and Lesser Greenpeak Camp(Siege)
【Level】Fix the problem of there are one spawn points that are hard to click in the City of Heroes(Siege) Level. 
【Level】Fix the problem of there are one ladder that can’t  be climbed in the City of Heroes(Siege) Level.

notes.title: 05/03/2020 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear Warlords, 
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 8am to 11am, 5th March (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Warlords will receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour after server maintenance completed. Here are the patch note:

[b]1.Activity Maps: City of Heroes[/b]

Center of the Borderlands, heart of the kingdom, symbol of the kingship, conquer it to make you lores be eulogized. The city of Heroes, will lift the mysterious veil as a time-exclusive activity map in the following weeks. 

“City of Heroes”Available time schedule
8th, March to 15th, March, every day from 12:00 to 14:00 and 18:00 to 20:00 (UTC+8). Limited activity.

City of Heroes（Time-Exclusive Preview）
Main Feature
The greatest city among the borderlands, the city of Heroes are composed of two separate parts: the Residential Area and the Inner Castle, connected by a narrow stone bridge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e4dc143c7980be5202c2c72a86adf408935d6091.png[/img]

Tactics Preview
City of Heroes is a 15 vs. 15 siege map that provide variety of structure diff advantage and tactics moves. 
As the opening, battle take place at the Residential Area, which is the lowland part of the city.  Attackers and Defenders may have an extremely close combat trying to control stronghold A. Attackers have variety of roads to invade. The defenders may also choose to spawn at the high ground of Inner Castle to prepare for the next phase combat. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1f57092b64c5359f0df06d675540010a2e9842a4.jpg[/img]

After the stronghold A, that’s time for the Siege Bridge to be on the stage. That is a chains catapulted siege machine that can help army to cross the gap. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d11b18d6db0714f68afdcb62760185505efd9af5.png[/img]

After the set up the siege bridge, attackers can arrange multiline assaults to attack stronghold B. Pay attention to the combat on the bridge, be careful not to fall off the bridge.  
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4cb155ddebf81153b040aad648a5b62f21a7a422.jpg[/img]

Attackers can also attacker from the front side, use battering ram to break out the main gate. There are also options to use ladders to climb onto the wall. Multiple options here.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7dbd551260e60dd42b3d40e34ca3ad437f6ae51d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6e636c7a9f57dc3f5cd07a1fcfc4a23c27ff7619.jpg[/img]

The combat of Area B is all about the central statue. All strategy should be focus on the main target here.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cc86abd3b7bcbe190e4fa8791aa5492d1af20e07.jpg[/img]

After the combat of stronghold B, both side may to be passionate about the final combat in the City of Heroes. The attack to the stronghold C will be a multiple answer question. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/33bf7a22bdd27946312cc4b6acbb340cfe2d9e3c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/56b3d7c10806109b1b705d0f5e508394c6dde508.jpg[/img]

The attackers can choose to climb over the city wall in the front side, or choose to sneak attack the side supply area from the side part. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/332afb713353db1aec0cde6a9c5209d358975048.jpg[/img]
 
As the defender, minimalize the structure advantage of the city wall, hold your defend land, hold the city to the last second! 

[b]2. Optimization of “wild hunt” mode[/b]

1)	Reward optimization
We have decided to improve the experience reward in this mode to normal match making including unit and hero experiences. And we will pay close attention after the change, and keep optimizing and polishing this mode.

2)	Team optimization
Release team restrictions, all the players below Silver rank can team up freely.
While for higher ranks, the restriction is your team member need to 1 rank near yours.

3)	MVP optimization
To encourage players who well played and get MVP but still lose the game, we decided to improve the rewards in this situation.

4)	Siege weapon limitation change
Increase the number of using siege weapon in the battlefield from one to two.

5)Other optimization 
Optimized a few descriptions and icons in wild hunt mode.

In this week, we will keep testing the “wild hunt”mode from : 7th, March（12:00-20:00） to 8th, March（12:00-20:00）.

[b]3. Advance notice about incoming balance changes of season units[/b]

Since all the seasonal units released, we keep close attention to their performances on the battlefield which quite not meet our expectation. We will do some balance changes of them very soon. Stay tuned.

[b]4．Level Balance Adjustments: Royal Ramparts Adjustment:[/b]

Based on the data analysis, we know that the attacker win rates of Royal Ramparts shows that this level is too hard for the attackers. The structure at stronghold A make there to be an extreme tough spot to be conquered.
So we decide to reinforce the attackers in the front line, we add couples of new siege machine to help the attacker to get over with this shield of the city. 

Catapult Siege Machine
We added 3 Catapults into the attackers side. In order to break through the defense in the stronghold A. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cd3552b12470ec389c8260e0390d9917ce8e8c7c.png[/img]

More Ladders
For the same reason, we added more ladders in the front side. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/67b62ccb7e2c1ed3a843ad50384daffb66ea7c1e.png[/img]

Game time increased from 13 mins to 14 mins
Slightly adjust the other siege machine and spawn point for both side. 

[b]5.Level Mechanic Improvement [/b]

Siege Level Balance : Equal Numbers of Players on Both Side
While we are considering the level balance, the number of players is always an important factor in our mind. With the development of Tournaments and Rank mode, we are hoping that all players can enjoy and be prepared for the equal numbers players competitions in all mode.
Considering the balance of each level will be slightly different, we are going to apply this change to all level in a longer development cycles, level by level, not change all level at one time. And we are going to keep an eye on the results of these changes in different maps while developing. 
According to our data analysis, the Sun City will be the first level that we are going to apply this change. We are going to add 1 more players into the defender side to see will that help defender to resist from the attackers.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d2108cbe029186176b23f2d9f724680826911827.jpg[/img]

Again, we are going watch the data change and players’ feedbacks of this new change. And we are definitely going to do more improvement and iteration based on that.

[b]6.System Optimization[/b]

1)City of heroes battle optimization
The city of heroes has a new ability to withdraw out of town. Player can exit the city by clicking on the outer gate of the city of heroes. It has a 5 mins cool down.
2)Optimized the icon arrangement order and style display when entering an abnormal state when marching in the open world.
3)Optimized the icon style display in the barracks interface after marching outside the corps.

[b]7.BUG Fix[/b]

1)Fixed a bug that players cannot complete the quest of joining in the siege of gate or city of heroes.
2)Fixed the problem that there is no yellow exclamation mark on the season button after the challenge is completed in the 11th week of the season challenge.
3)Fixed the challenge of “Knowing and Making Friends” cannot be complete if your friend request was approved while you are offline.
4)Fixed the problem of that Wall of Rangifer(Siege) don’t have opening scene.
5)Fixed the problem at Royal Ramparts, which attackers can accidently stop defenders controlling main gates.
6)Fixed the problem of wrong display name of battering ram base in 4 Gates level around the city of heroes on open world. 
7)Fixed a camera bug: camera shifts at certain situation.

notes.title: 27/02/2020 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear Warlords, 
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 8am to 10am, 27th February (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Warlords will receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour after server maintenance completed. Here are the patch note:

[b]1. Important Updates: Arena Test - The Wild Hunt[/b]

Arena test activity is now available! A best platform for Warlords to show your strength and polish your battle skills. All Warlords are welcome to test the Wild Hunt level and share your suggestions with us. Arena mode will be officially released after We making further improvements and optimization according to your feedback.

1）Stage Score Introduction
Warlords can get stage score by taking part in the Arena battles and upgrade your stage accordingly. More detailed info are as follows:
Tenacity Iron：0-199
Staunch Iron：200-399
Tenacity Bronze：400-599
Staunch Bronze：600-799
Struggling Silver：800-999
Glory Silver：1000-1199
Struggling Gold：1200-1399
Glory Gold：1400-1699
Blazing Platinum ：1700-2099
Noble Platinum ：2100+
The Arena Ranking list of your server are available in [Hall of Fame - Arena Ranking ] interface.

2) Participation Rules
A. Only Warlords over level 100 can take part in this test activity. During this mode, each Warlord can only deploy artillery once in every single battle
B. Warlords no longer need to worry about the unit kit losses.Just join in the battle and fight Hard till the end!
C. This mode will not produce any currency-related items, including Bronze Coins, Silver Coins,loot items, etc.Strength always comes first in this mode.
D. Several relatively balanced siege and field maps were added into the map pool of this mode.Battle map will be randomly chosen from the following maps:
Hidden City (Multistage Siege Battle)
Border Fort (Multistage Siege Battle)
Harbour City (Multistage Siege Battle)
Wall Fort (Multistage Siege Battle)
Arena (Field Conquest) 
Westwood (Field Conquest) 
Desert Fortress (Field Conquest) 
Marauder Settlement (Field Conquest) 
Augolia (Field Progression) 
Conquest (Field Progression) 

3) Rewards
In order to make every active Warlords get rewarded, the Auction House has prepared specific rewards for Warlords in different tiers.
When this test activity is over, Warlords ranking Top 10% will be rewarded with a permanent title“Champion of Battlefield”, Flag Selection Box and 30,000 Bronze Coins. Warlords participating this test activity will get 10,000 Bronze Coins, 300 Honour and “Field Pioneer”title (30 days).

4) Test Time
February 29: 12:00-20:00
March 1: 12:00-22:00
March 7: 12:00-20:00
March 8: 12:00-22:00

[b]2. New Map: Royal Ramparts[/b]

A time-limited new map - Royal Ramparts will be available after this update, allowing Warlords to get familiar with the internal layout before conquering the City of Heroes.

As a military drill, Royal Ramparts siege battle enjoy no unit kit losses, and will not produce Bronze Coins. 

The opening time: 
12:00-14:00, 18:00-20:00 from February 27 to March 7. 

Main Features
As the last line of defense, the Royal Ramparts is like a iron shield guarding the city for long. The city of heroes have no threats before the ramparts fall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3edfd5fdac6f94c2b107728c4b2d6af0def4462a.png[/img]

Tactic Introduction
Royal Ramparts is a 15V15 siege map. Both Attackers and Defenders can cooperate closely with their teammates to gain certain battlefield advantages by taking full use of the terrain and various artillery pieces.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2bb921c52c4494482e93c15bac55274e87394594.jpg[/img]

After the battle starts, Attackers can use Battering Ram, Siege Tower and ladders to attack the front city wall. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4010fec4c1591b68b38e4743d63bf81e713b7603.jpg[/img]

Point A is located inside the second-floor platform of the front tower. Attackers can climb up to the city wall from both sides to conduct a flanking attack.  
Attackers also can make a detour to attack the tower after breaking the main gate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b55a25563fd8e77beef2dd98719d5a255a55697a.jpg[/img]

After taking over Point A, Attackers can choose the front or side path to attack the base camp.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2fa655f0b21d5f54bc2977ee793ab08c685bac94.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/45dde067c4fdde9b52352cf1a7e36aea3191a0d3.jpg[/img]
 
While defending the base camp, Defenders should pay attention to enemy’s trebuchets since the base camp is located in a relatively empty area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/27334112473e247d860f1139615b3ae9076677b2.jpg[/img]

[b]3. Level Mechanism Optimization: Ladder Interaction Logic Optimization[/b]

As we all know, one of the most exciting moment of the siege battle is the contest of city wall. To breakthrough this defend line, Attackers always use lots of siege ladders to help their soldiers climb up to the city wall quickly.
In order to provide Warlords with a battlefield with more flexibility and various gameplay, we have made lots of improvements by adjusting the interaction logic of siege ladders. Now both Attackers and Defenders can interact to build or kick siege ladders, which means Defenders can quickly get back to the city wall for defending their position, and Attackers also can kick out the ladders after climbing up to the city wall to stop the pursuit forces.

[b]4. Open World Location Optimization [/b]

-Freedom Union
Location of all members inside your house will be displayed on open world map and refreshed every 10 seconds.
-Empire Guardian
Location of all Empire Guardian members will be displayed on open world map and refreshed every 10 seconds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/19c2114a28ab68e6e324d67f49e91537f576d299.png[/img]

[b]5. Punishment to the intentional disconnection in Open World[/b]

Warlords who intentionally disconnect their cables to avoid being chased in the open world will be punished. Half of the items in their wagon will be dropped automatically and can be picked up by other Warlords within 10 minutes.

[b]6. Newly added Seasonal Challenges[/b]

Challenges of Week 11 and Week 12 will be added for this season, allowing Warlords to earn more Seasonal XP. Challenges regarding Arena-The Wild Hunt will be added accordingly. 

[b]7. Guidance Price Adjustment[/b]
After reviewing the transaction data, Auction House has made some adjustments to the guidance price of some items, unit kit, schematics, weapons and equipment set. You can check the adjusted price in Auction House.

[b]8. System Optimization[/b]

1) Optimization to Empire Guardian: Added a exclamation mark for notification in the Season button in the homepage banner and the campaigns interface when the Empire Guardian completed some Seasonal stage quests.

2) Battle Line Amount Adjustment
Decreased the battle line amount from 3 to 2 for the City of Heroes, Gate of Order, Gate of Earth, Gate of Heaven and Gate of Glory.

3) Artillery Optimization
Artillery running out of ammo would not only block allies’ artillery projectile but also their movements, so we optimized this issue accordingly.
-Deployed Artillery will be destroyed automatically 30 seconds after they running out of ammo.

-Optimized the quality filter in Artillery Workshop, artillery will be divided into four main qualities: “Normal”, “Well-made”, “Optimal”, “Legend”. Warlords no longer need to scroll the item list.
-Optimized the newbie artillery tutorial quest, “build a certain kind of Grapeshot Cannon” was adjusted to “build any artillery”

[b]9. Bug Fixes[/b]

1) Winged Hussars’ Formation Bug Fixes
We have noticed that in our previous version, the Dispersed formation of Winged Hussars with 18 soldiers were in line with our design, however this formation becoming more intensive with 16 soldiers. This bug may be deliberately used by some players to effect the battlefield balance. So we made some optimization accordingly: Unified the density of Winged Hussars’ Dispersed Formation. The density would remain unchanged regardless of soldiers amount.
Dispersed Formation with 16 soldiers (Before):
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/92bffb96d7db1804f37ad74e346ac412313e461e.png[/img]

Dispersed Formation with 16 soldiers (After):
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6d11c2473328dfe70eb800b4631a06ca2dfe7fec.png[/img]

2) Miscellaneous Fixes

notes.title: 13/02/2020 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear Warlords, 
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 8am to 11am, 13th February (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Warlords will receive 8,000 Bronze Coins and 300 Honour after server maintenance completed. Here are the patch note:

[b]1.Virus：The Cure  [/b]
Villages have suffered huge losses due to the virus. Commander Adler step forward to recruit  righteous Warlords from different regions and protect local residents away from the epidemic. Please join Commander Adler to fight against the virus and rescue the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/246b6a12fdc14497b3e95717319c034a8e6c9199.png[/img]

This PVE level will be available 12:00-24:00 from February 13 to February 27.

[b]2.Map shifting for this month[/b]
“Attack on Wall of Rangifer” and “Valley Fortress” will be added to the map pool of February while “Border Fort” will be removed.

1)Attack on Wall of Rangifer

The Great Wall was built between the Rangifer mountains, creating a natural barrier to prevent the invasion of Northern tribes. The front slope of the Great Wall is narrow and long. The structure rises along with the S-shape terrain. Defenders can use several watchtowers and city walls to hold their position, while attackers can put forward after capturing those watchtowers one by one or conduct an ambush after climbing up to the city wall with the ladders.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b1180b308f9ae74437aecd36756b401df91af129.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fdd8dd8d1e560be8a9ad12075b3f5601a780e8ae.png[/img]

Tactic Introduction
The outside slope of the Great Wall is narrow and long, with a multi-level towel located in the middle. Attackers can use the Battering Ram to attack from the front tower or use ladders to climb up to the city wall before an attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0beade4b99d57d9886c66a3ada38fa0d56b06ed6.png[/img]

The large-scale tower on the front is an important defensive building, which was built into a three-story structure and equipped with several firearms inside.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/37153aa33bdabc7353fde978c2b370631c3c0108.png[/img]

Defenders can use the firearms inside the tower or attack the flaming pitch nearby the front gate to defend their position. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/29cb5a81dfe396aa6917383a155a75caa7ea1a99.png[/img]

Point A is located behind the tower. Attackers can break the front tower or attack from city wall on both sides to capture it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b6f3f3650b2246da71e4e669c7f83af06f581785.png[/img]

Point B and C will be available to be captured after Attackers taking over Point A. Attackers can push forward along with the city wall or use ladders to climb up the city wall under Point B. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/69f6a4cbc123200a874d0868e3f06a5f7976a3f6.png[/img]

Point B is located inside a large-scale beacon, connecting to the city wall on both sides. However some parts of the beacon can be easily broken by Trebuchets or Artillery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4c66ec93890655c2251e31aa3fd59f1582fdffa6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/91911c4412719002e2df3bca1b8c3126e310707c.png[/img]

Point C is on the left of Point B and located inside a small tower. Attackers can push forward along the city wall or directly attack from the ground to capture Point C.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/cfa9a864645349cee2ef9b6f0f3756231e29a4f1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c2757ae7616cad3caa3135d34ba4357660b1bc98.png[/img]

The base camp is available to be captured after Attackers capturing Pint B or Point C. There is a flat ground between base camp and Point C.Attackers can use the flat ground or push forward along the city wall over Point C to the tower nearby base camp then conduct an attack to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/25d92602792c4f33461dde8009ac03adf5be9ca1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/c899cd00bb864539475eeb848736c34f738328f6.png[/img]

Warlords can deploy some units nearby the gate of base camp or put some ranged units above the gate to wipe invading enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/645e7e4b0c96783a72be7942c2b34efa5218e84b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5e66d57b170a910d6ec9d528505e78cb840acba1.png[/img]

The city wall on the front of base camp can be easily broken by Trebuchets or artillery. Attackers can take advantage of this point to capture the base camp more easily. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/8bf2d36063bdd106b900f3f59c44a36ae01b3c6d.png[/img]

2)Valley Fortress (readjusted)

The terrain of Valley Fortress is gradually increasing along with the mountains.The internal layout is compact with crisscrossed paths .There is a small castle located on the highest point inside the fortress,which can be used by defenders to protect the base camp after external castle being captured by attackers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7ed583d28d2def81086db649868d02a33ce8de8a.png[/img]

Tactic Introduction
Battering Ram, Siege Tower and ladders are available to be used to attack Point A and Point B.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a6d7c7c5156de1de81e6f3e67d0a52a0cf228e6b.png[/img]

Point C will be available to be captured after Attackers capturing Point A or Point B. Point C was located at the flat ground outside the inner castle. Attackers can push forward through two gates under Point C or climb up to the city wall through ladders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3c7abb14f2c6f44a9bd962c20f239b4c38626226.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/da97de69218172ff6aad5acc03043518030fbfde.png[/img]

Base camp will be available to be captured after Attackers taking over Point C. Attackers can advance to the base camp through gates on both sides or conduct an ambush after climbing up to the city wall of inner castle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/420fd93d0d82cd12ed97ed71a79e2a86e1403583.png[/img]

Defenders can deploy some ranged units at the city wall of inner castle and take advantage of the terrain to fight against enemies under the city wall. Besides that,Defenders should pay attention to gates on both sides in case of a surprise attack. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1e9278d798e65f244dfe38aadb0f86896129ec05.png[/img]

[b]3.Exclusive Achievements and Badges [/b]
1)Exclusive Achievements of Valley Fortress (Siege) and Attack on Wall of Rangifer (Siege) 
[Battle of Valley Fortress]: win 1 PVP battle in Valley Fortress  (siege)
[Conqueror of  Rangifer]: win 1 PVP battle in Wall of Rangifer  (siege)
[Backwater battle]: earn 1 "Combo Breaker" badge in Valley Fortress  (siege)
[Megatron Octagon]: earn 1 "Headhunter" badge in Wall of Rangifer  (siege)

2)Exclusive Badges of Attack on Wall of Rangifer (Siege)
[Mighty Warriors]: Earn the highest number of hero kills on your team in Wall of Rangifer.
[Brave and fierce]: In Wall of Rangifer Battle, deal 800,000 damage.

[b]4.“The Return of Veteran” Activity is back ![/b]
We are now relaunching “The Return of Veteran” activity to provide better game experience during the epidemic. Warlords returning to the battlefield of Conqueror’s Blade: Frontier will enjoy various benefits including extra Auxiliary Units, Specific buff and certain Return Gifts. Warlords completing invitation quests will also be rewarded. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/0fe0332007661046814314e2aa4c86646d6cfdbf.png[/img]

Available: February 13 to February 27

Requirement of Returning Veterans: Warlords who haven’t login from February 1 to February 9

Activity and rewards:
1)Login Activity
Returning Veterans can login the game everyday to get various rewards including Treatises, Honour, Seasonal XP and so on.
2)Specific Buff for Veterans

Battle Buff: Returning Veterans will get 7-day premium account as reward
3)Return Challenges for Veterans
Returning Veterans will get one Chivalric Era unit signaculum once they advance to next seasonal level. Each Warlord can get 20 Signaculum at most. (20 Signaculums can be used to unlock one Chivalric Era unit) 
Please note：
-Signaculum reward will be distributed by in-game mail within 3days after activity ended
-This activity is only available for 15 days, and only applicable to returning Warlords over level 60
-The challenge process of different characters under one returning account will be calculated separately.
4)Exclusive Discount Pack
Returning Veterans can buy the exclusive discount pack. Use this item to get login rewards for 7 days in a row, including Bronze coins, Honour, Skill point and Unit Medal and so on.

Invitation Rewards:
-Warlords inviting 1 warlord will get [Battle-ready - Comradeship], including one Treatise
-Warlords inviting 3 Warlords will get[Battle-ready - Devotion], including Treatise *2 and Blue Artillery Box *1

-Warlords inviting 15 Warlords will get [Battle-ready - Uprising], including Treatise*4, Indomitable Lion( permanent) and legendary Artillery Box*1
Above-mentioned rewards will be distributed by in-game mail within 3 days after activity ended.

[b]5.Relevant Adjustments [/b]
we made the following adjustments since the conquering process of all Warlords have been effected due to the ongoing epidemic outbreak. Hope you will understand. 
1）Time Adjustments
-[Heart of the World] will be extended for 11 days and officially ended on February 29
-[Conqueror’s Crown] will be launched on March 1 and ended on March 18

2）Battle schedule adjustments to the City of Heroes
-The first Territory War of the City of Heroes on March 3 has been changed to military exercise
-Territory War will be available after March 7 then there will be no more military exercises

3）The release of [City of Heroes]
City of Heroes will be available to all Warlords after server maintenance on February 27

[b]6.Special Login Activity for this Month[/b]
Available: from 11:00, February 13 to 24:00, February 29
Join in this activity (O interface) and get various rewards, including Bronze Coins, Unit Medal and Treatise.

[b]7.Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed a bug where the Rebels and Bandit camps in the Borderland did not refresh.
Fixed a bug where some rebels camp in the open world did not take effect correctly. 
Fixed a bug where the privilege fief did not fully displayed in M interface.
Fixed a bug where solo Warlords couldn’t quit their Alliance or take part in other Houses.
Fixed a bug where Warlords could operate items inside their supply dump when they leaving other fiefs without weapons.
Optimized the information synchronization speed of TAB key inside the battlefield.

notes.title: 09/01/2020 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear Warlords,
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 8 am to 10 am, 9th, Jan (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Warlords will receive 5,000 Bronze Coins and 200 Honour after the server maintenance. Here are the patch note:

1.Important Updates: Freedom Union VS Empire Guardian 
Civilization, conflict, war, the world is never tranquil with the invasion of Khan in the North and the turmoil in the East and West, and the city of hero is in danger…Will the Empire fall into chaos? Perhaps it’s the beginning of a brand new evolution.
Throughout various regions of the open world, the imperial land were separated by Houses and Alliances. Under such circumstance, Warlords have to define their own fate. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f518de20ea19ecd9b89148e97376cf21e1cebd97.png[/img]

1) Freedom Union
-Follow the destiny? Take part in other Houses or build your own Houses? 
Crown yourself with the honor and glory while conquering the open world and creating your own destiny. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/08dbcb5a6e4d1677d38dac7abbe05b6ee07574b4.png[/img]

-Warlords who have already took part in Houses and Alliances will join [Freedom Union] by default. 
-Solo Warlords can choose to join [Freedom Union], existing Houses or create new houses in N interface

2) Empire Guardian 
-Defend the Empire? Vow to guard the dignity of the Imperial Legion and find peace for the open world?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6dc175e9986dfc3b8f4f776e26fe7ab57e270b57.png[/img]

-If Solo Warlords choose to take part in [Empire Guardian] of current region in N interface, they will be distributed in one battalion randomly.  
-Warlords who took part in [Empire Guardian] cannot quit within 7 days. 

2.Optimizations to the Nobility Titles of Freedom Union

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/de4018c0d4dc59bd38f082348588339b19ccbab2.png[/img]

-optimized the distribution of Nobility Titles reward. The reward will be distributed at midnight every Monday.
-Optimized the distribution rule of Nobility Titles, now the Liege can dub or remove other members’ nobility titles at any time. Each Warlord can only receive nobility titles from Liege once within 24 hours
-The Influence of each House will be calculated at 22:30 pm at every Saturday. Nobility titles of other house members will be removed along with the change of Liege’s nobility titles. 
-New House Liege will directly get the nobility titles of old Liege
-Warlords will be notified by in-game mail when receiving nobility titles

3.Map Balance Adjustments
1)Riverlands Castle (Siege)
Based on the collected feedbacks and battlefield stats, currently the winning ratio of Attackers is much higher than we expected. Defenders are hard to conduct effective defense. Accordingly, we decided to make the following adjustments to rebalance the battlefield:

-Decreased the game duration from 13 minutes to 11 minutes
-Adjusted the location of Siege Tower by moving it backward by 10 meters
-Removed 2 Culverins and 2 Catapults of Attackers. Swapped 1 Ballista on defenders’ city wall with 1 Culverin
-Decreased the total number of siege ladders at left city wall from 10 to 9
-Adjusted the location of defenders’ left supply point by moving it backward and closer to attackers’ ground
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/99171aa963092bb108452e0b157f067b6a09cbc7.jpg[/img]

-Added another respawn point for defenders behind point A and point B. This respawn points is binding to Point B, which means it will remain active until defenders lost Points B. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/39a64df5b33a544c721b109df684d3c5346ce196.jpg[/img]

-Adjusted the location of defenders’ supply point (as pictured). It is unable to be captured until the base camp being activated. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/86a89d261b64f46e9a61c6868ab7da94f361e473.png[/img]

-Adjusted the location of supply point in defenders’ base camp by moving it inside the respawn area
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f34204fb85ef72f073298ac017934141836a6c28.png[/img]

-Adjusted the location of defenders’ base camp
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9c6e020a5f8658c1202dafc780a28940d2642423.png[/img]

2)Territory War Siege Map optimizations
The inner castle structure has been adjusted to optimize the combat experience in the final area.
This adjustment covers all cities using this type of map model, including Sobek, Acheron, Vaja, Burdost.
-Rebuilt wall structure nearby final area to enable passage on top of the wall
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/be406972299fed9d17005e428a2a336f20b43f7b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1cf81c3fa1368d5f62f94b3957e65943219561b9.png[/img]
-Added a gate at one of the inner castle entrances, which can be destroyed by Warlords. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ba754436dbd0747893e01b45889ad0b5fbce4e3c.png[/img]

3)Frontier Camp (Siege) 
Based on the collected feedbacks and battlefield stats, currently the winning ratio of attackers is much lower than we expected. Accordingly, we decided to make the following adjustments to create more advantages for attackers. 
-Increased the game duration from 6 minutes to 7 minutes.
-Decreased the flag-capturing time from 60 seconds to 45 seconds.

At the same time, two new 8V8 siege map are now available---The Storehouse and Lesser Greenpark Camp

4.Unit Formation Optimizations
We made the following optimizations to improve the formation display and fix some operation issues.
1)Optimized the Line formation for the following pikemen units:
Village Watchmen, Pike Militia, Prefecture Pikemen, Imperial Pike Guards, Black Dragon Pikemen
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ba14aaac63a96c2b04935d155deeb845a93691be.png[/img]
2)	Optimized the Line formation for the following mounted bladesman and lancers units:
Ironcap Scout Cavalry, Prefecture Heavy Cavalry, Dagger-Axe Lancers, Coutiliers, Yeomen, Monastic Knights, Cataphract Lancers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d87ab32e1e3553338a08c5a768911b0bfec6ff35.png[/img]
3)Optimized the Wedge and Column formation for the following mounted bladesman and lancer units: 
Prefecture Heavy Cavalry, Yeomen, Fire Lance Cavalry, Rattan Rangers
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b705b5cd0db5ddc86306ca6fd9ef8cb79d795ee4.png[/img]
4)Optimized the Schiltron formation for the following spearman units:
Ironcap Spearmen, Imperial Spear Guard, Spear Sergeants, Black Dragon Spearmen
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/77a55006aed11aac64e8eb3ed84c7f6c1746d5cd.png[/img]
5)Optimized the Three Ranks formation for the following crossbowmen and arquebusiers units:
Repeater Crossbowmen, Demesne Arbalists, Demesne Crossbowmen, Imperial Arquebusiers, Ironcap Arquebusiers, Demesne Arquebusiers, Kriegsrat Fusiliers, Sea Stag Deathdealers
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a3a1c23463b0813a1927913c268b67af8daf919b.png[/img]
6)Optimzied the Block formation for the following crossbowmen units:
Demesne Arbalists, Demesne Crossbowmen
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b8ce8696d3aa69395d11ba88455e97fa0cad3bcc.png[/img]
7)Optimized the shield formation of Imperial Javelineers
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5553bba6398ea1ee328717743e70d4d1090fb47b.png[/img]
8)Optimized the hawk formation of Fire Lance Cavalry
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4aef564b6328f7df7cb07880eb44e43d034897e8.png[/img]
9)Optimized the schiltron formation of Imperial Pike Guards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7fd317a984bb1d82efa0f1044d94dc30a31391b6.png[/img]

5.System Optimizations
1)Battlefield score optimizations
-Warlords will get certain contribution score when they interrupt enemies capturing the flag and supply points in field battles
-When one point under contest, Warlords inside the point trying to stop opponents capturing the flag will get certain contribution score. 
2)Optimizations to Auxiliary units and Mercenary
Auxiliary units and Mercenary have been moved to [Unit] interface (previously [War Scholar] interface) 
3)Supply point interact optimization 
The interact process of supply point has been simplified, now units, weapons and mounts are displayed when Warlords pressing F to open the equipment interface.
4)Auxiliary units display logic optimization

notes.title: 02/01/2020 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear Warlords,
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 8 am to 10 am, 2 Jan (UTC +8). Here are the patch notes:

[b]1.Important Updates: Map Adjustments 
1)Riverlands Castle (siege)[/b]
After reviewing Warlords’ feedbacks and checking background stats, we found that the winning ratio of attackers is higher than we expected. When the battle coming into the final area, Defenders are easy to be restrained and they have few ways to support the battlefield. At the same time, attackers are also easy to be squeezed into the two long steps heading to the inner city if they are not well organized. So we made the following adjustments: 
 
a.Decreased the number of ladders against inner city walls. Added a new set of ladders connecting the outer city wall and inner city wall

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e45176d95cbfc2217baee17876e800fddeb856b8.jpg[/img]

b.Added flaming pitchs upon the stairs aisle of the inner city 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6d12c3a5da18e1f2ef16f73d508a338e0a7b3868.jpg[/img]

c.Decreased the number of plant in the final area

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/05d558d01206aae869e2404d82c33e8893440e8e.jpg[/img]

d.Widened the platform on each side of defenders’ tower in the final area

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7b5317a205f480bacecc0fd6d6941371ad1f005e.jpg[/img]

e.Adjusted the location of defenders’ final supply point, making it easier to defend and harder to attack

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e8cc83e944e5f21fcf19f6ea9a23e6a1cbd0ac0b.jpg[/img]

f.Decreased the number of Trebuchets from 8 to 7

[b]2)Border Fort (siege)[/b]
Based on your feedbacks and battlefield stats, we found that the winning ratio of attackers is a little bit higher than we expected. Especially when defenders trying to support their base camp, they are easy to be blocked out of the final area since there don’t have other effective defending routes. So we adjusted the lateral passage structure nearby the base camp by adding a new stair to provide one more path for Defenders to get to the final area.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b111d74cdcffa7f724921c50212d5544cf061fff.jpg[/img]

[b]3)Frontier Camp (siege)[/b]
a.Adjusted the player number from 8 (Attackers) vs 7 (Defenders) to 8 vs 8
b.Added 4 Trebuchets for Attackers to deal with the above-mentioned adjustment

[b]2.Auction House Guidance Price Adjustments[/b]
Based on the trading data, we have raised the guidance prices of the following items:
Rare Helmet Schematic
Rare Cuirass Schematic
Rare Glove Schematic
Rare Boots Schematic

Warlords can check the adjusted price in the Market.

[b]3.Bug fixes and optimizations
1)Unit bug fixes and optimizations[/b]
a.Fixed the incorrect icon and description when Khorchins equipping Mobility doctrine
b.Fixed a bug where Khorchins couldn’t track enemies correctly when using [hunt] skill after equipping “Epic Mounted Archery Doctrine” or “Legendary Mounted Archery Doctrine”
c.Fixed the model distortion when Khorchins equipping with some unit mount attires
d.Fixed a unit challenge of Selemchid Cavalry’s unit challenge, in the filed or siege battle, the trigger of cumulative count of killing generals did not take effect properly
e.Fixed a bug where the [Focused fire] skill of Ironcap Arquebusiers and Demesne Arquebusiers couldn’t response immediately in the process of formation
f.Fixed a bug where the [Unswerving] of Cataphract Lancers did not take effect correctly
g.Fixed the incorrect effect of Imperial Archers’ [Force]
h.Fixed a bug that nodes which increase units’ defence sometimes did not take effect on the battlefield
i.Adjusted the [Improved Supplies] of Khevtuul Cavalry to [Hasten] (Each level increases rate of attack by 6%)

[b]2)System bug fixes and optimizations[/b]
a.Fixed a bug where the trigger of Rebel Fighter series quests did not take effect properly after Warlords destroying medium rebel camps
b.Fixed some model collision issues of terrain and stairs in Riverlands Castle
c.Optimization the animation of Vanguard Archers’ [Move and Fire] 

The operation team of Conqueror’s Blade: Frontier
January 2, 2020
