notes.title: SEASON I PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
As previously announced, the Season II: Wrath of the Nomads update is due to be released on Thursday 23th December.

 (I) The New Season: 
Wrath of the Nomads: The Twilight of the Empire
-Through the [F5 Season] button on the main interface, you can enter the main interface of the season;
-Accumulate glory, you can level up your nobility;
-Accumulate season XP, you can upgrade the season level.
 During the season, you can get 1000 glory for each season level you increased.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/1ff24e33cd726b8556277f8f89d1b17b776983e1.png[/img]

-Nobility can be level up by upgrading the season LV, participating in PVP matching battles, completing weekly challenge, using season item "Shaman’s Scroll" or "Khan’s Edict”;
-On the [Reward] tab, you can view the progression of rewards and hero journey. According to the progression your nobility, you can get various rewards include season-themed cosmetic, special title of the season, and so on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/08219a3e85c124a16c1c06530b6b220dbf40b56d.png[/img]

-Hero journey rewards are automatically unlocked as soon as Wrath of the Nomads is online. 
- The upper reward progression can be unlocked by purchase item “Holy Mountain’s Guidance” or “Holy’ Mountain’s Will”

II, New season store:
-In the [F5 Season] interface, you can view the information through the [Season Store] tab;
-In the season store, you can exchange cool stuffs by spend Fangs, the unique tokens of this season. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/61f80fa80a0f7e1c321b7632c0e4de1984248717.png[/img]

III. Weekly Challenge Tasks in the New Season
Based on the feedback from warlords in the previous season, we have optimized the challenge types of weekly challenges, enriched more challenge types, including social networking, battlefield performance, participation in open-world games, and participation in daily activities. 
At the same time, try to make the task as engaged as possible, so that can more easily complete challenges and gain glory in the common game process

-S1 season offers a total of 10 weeks of challenges with 8 tasks per week.
-Provide 2 refresh charges per week, you can change the tasks you don't like
-Each challenge task provides a wealth of glory rewards, different difficulties, different rewards amount.
-When completing the challenge of the week, you can get additional rewards according to the progress of the progression this week.

IV. Units Challenge
1. Unlock season unit
Different from the previous units tree, the season units requires players to complete a series of challenge tasks. Once you complete all stage of a specific unit challenge, that unit is yours forever.
Players can open the season [F5] interface and select the [Unit Challenge] tab to view the season Units challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e6567497311be7785c9129df2189c4822cdd4c5c.png[/img]

2. Rules of season units challenge:
Units challenge opening timeline:
-Tier 3 Units: as soon as S1 season is online
- Tier 4 Units: 7 days after S1 season online
- Tier 5 Units: 21 days after S1 season online

3. Preconditions of different units challenge tier:
-Tier 3 Units: No preconditions, challenges are turned on by default
-Tier 4 Units: After completing the challenges of any 2 of T3 units, start this challenge
-Tier 5 Units: After completing any challenge of any T4 units, start the challenge

The T3 units Challenge has 2 stages, the T4 units challenge has 4 stages, and the T5 units Challenge has 9 stages.  
After completing all the stages in a single Units Challenge, players can unlock this season unit permanently

There are 8 challenge tasks in each stage.  If you complete any 6 challenge tasks, the challenge in this stage is completed.
In each stage, whenever a task is completed, you will get certain reward, including Fangs, units flags, units cosmetic, units kits and so on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bfdd097662a16586ed99113040d81beed8611a48.png[/img]

4. The Units challenges Quick Done
After we the units challenge system for a period of time, the function of Quick Done will be released.
You can quick-complete the units challenge task with sovereigns by using Quick Done function.

Opening time-line:
-2 days after the Tier 3 Season units challenge opens
-3 days after the Tier 4 Season units challenge opens. 
-5 days after the Tier 5 Season units challenge opens.- 

V. Season Seal
In order to let players have the same starting point at the beginning of the season, and relive the fun of the battle, we have added a season seal system (exception: Free Battles Mode): 
The units in [Heroic] and [Golden] era are sealed
The attributes and sets effect of hero equipment are sealed.
All data of sealed units and hero equipment stay unchanged during the sealed time period.
The timeline below show when those sealed will be removed:

2 weeks after season launch, unseal all [Heroic era] units and all attributes on hero equipment
4 weeks after season launch, unseal all [Golden era] units and all sets effect on hero equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/4291551e026d35688d0477f1b4e65b3891ba7a03.png[/img]

VI. Open-World new content

NEW TERRITORY WAR CONTENT
CONQUEROR’S CITY
Conqueror’s City is located on a mountain in the middle of The Borderlands, waiting for real heroes to come and conquer.

It is composed of the inner city and four major gates.

Once the Conqueror’s City opens, when attacking, Houses must occupy any one of the gates first before they can attack the inner city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/17f51230d8993ae31a64a2d4b08b19269dca87fd.png[/img]

CAMPAIGNS:
Take part in new Territory War content by completing objectives for each Stage of the Campaign. You will be rewarded when completing specific tasks for your House.

Stage 1: The Baron’s War:

Conquer the fiefs in your region for the glory of your House.

Stage 2: Crossing Frontiers

Conquer a Border post to open the road into the Borderlands.

Stage 3: Heart of the World

Invade the Borderlands and conquer a fief for the glory of your House.

Stage 4: Conqueror’s Crown

To become world-conqueror, you must overcome the ultimate challenge and take over Conqueror’s City.

Stage 5: Imperial Dawn

Please note, if a Stage in the Campaign has ended, you cannot go back to that Stage to complete tasks and earn rewards. Stages duration is based on Season-Opening times.

LEGION ALLIANCE - NPC HOUSES:
Solo Warlords rejoice, you will now be able to take part in Territory War content by joining up with 1 of the 4 allied NPC Houses in our new Legion Alliance system. 

This feature will be available shortly after Season II’s launch. We will have a more indepth guide explaining this feature in the near future.

NOBILITY TITLE SYSTEM:
Receive new player titles when you fight and capture fiefs on behalf of your House: your titles will even earn you weekly rewards!
Rule of gaining nobility titles
-When your House captures fiefs in any of the four regions, it earns a corresponding amount of Influence. According to your influence，members of the house can dub different nobility title
-When your House captures fiefs in any of the four regions, it earns a corresponding amount of Influence.
Conquering fiefs of the same type in the Borderlands can earn you double the amount of Influence.
The higher the level of the fief, the greater its Influence.
The influence gain will resolved as soon as a territory war period end.
-After resolve，the nobility title of House Liege, at the same time，more nobility title for all house member.
-Influence will be calculated every Saturday evening at 22:30, at which time rewards will be given out the following Monday before 21:59
-Your house will earn influence for occupying fiefs during territory wars. 
-Fiefs in the borderlands provide double influence.  
-The higher Lv that fief has, the more influence it will provide.
-If house lose fiefs, that house will lose influence at the same time, that may cause decrease of the nobility title from both quantity and quality.
-Who ever occupy the city of heroes , center of borderlands, that house will get the royal title of "Hegemon".
-All nobility title will be reset once the season is over.

Quality of Nobility Title
Hegemon
Monarch（not open yet）
Regent
Royal Councillor
Lord Chamberlain
Chancellor
High Almoner
Captain of Guards
Grand Admiral
Protomystikos
Elector
Justiciar
Lord Lieutenant
High Sheriff
Burgess
Herald
Castellan
Councillor
Mayor
Reeve

Dubbing Nobility Title
All member of the house can press [N] to open [House] interface. Choose [Title] tab to view the details of nobility title information for your house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f535d3377b186f0e89979b0f43286507db55ade6.png[/img]

Nobility title weekly reward
Liege of the house can dub nobility title until the resolve on each Saturday night 22:30. As soon as nobility title is dubbed, the new knight will get nobility reward directly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/a4956e16d92b8aa87f51d25a73c3a787a8ba8372.png[/img]

VIII. Major adjustments in the open-world
The Borderlands adjustment
Nysa: Nysa has been transformed into a village and, in turn, nearby resources have been painstakingly cultivated by the villagers, so that the road to the west of the plateau is now free of passes
Karlsbach: the defenders of the city of heroes have converted Karlsbach on the eastern side of the great rift valley into a pass and built a corresponding wall
Sobek: Sobek has been transformed into a city and the surrounding walls have been torn down. Travel from Chenau will now be unimpeded
Acheron: Acheron has been transformed into a city where people who pass through the desert to the chaos will be able to go straight north to the heritage plain

 Jastor and Tulapan: during the fierce war, Jastor and Tulapan were completely destroyed, leaving only the ruins left by the war. Fortunately, the archaeology team immediately set out and kept many precious records in the midst of the war. In the near future, the archaeology team will reproduce these destroyed cities in the form of historical records

Unaaagverija adjustment
Bourdourst and tigner: the people of Unaaagverija converted Ratot Var and Vaja into cities and removed the surrounding walls.

The rubble north of Keleti Csarda has now been cleared .

IX. TERRITORY WAR ADJUSTMENTS
1.BATTLE LINES:
The number of battle lines for Cities has been adjusted from 2 to 1.
The number of battle lines for Forts has been adjusted from 3 to 1.
2. WAR RULES:
After Territory War, you no longer need to declare war to enter the battle, but you still need to be in a House to open the battlefield.

XI. Level Balancing 
1.Level adjustment
We improve the play experience and level arranging of the intro-part of the game, for players who are new to Conqueror’s Blade, now you should have more fun in the early part.
a.Weapon Training
-We added the mounting training part into this training quest.
b.Units Control Training：
-We changed the units that you are using in this level, now you will use Iconcap Swordsmen and Demense Spearmen to train.
c.Unit Train Squad (Main city)：
-we added range attack training with Ironcap Archers，and anti-cavalry training with Pike Militia

2、Battlefield improvement：Battering Ram Mechanic Improvement
-Whenever the battering ram reach the gate position, the switcher of the gate cannot be interact until the battering ram is destroyed. 
-Whenever the battering ram reach the gate position, if the gate is open, the gate is destroyed immediately, after that, the battering ram fall back and destroy itself. 

3、Level BUG Fix
-Fix the problem of ladders in Riverlands Castle
–Fix the problem of some pre-deployed artilleries in the level didn’t have bullets limit.

VIII novice guidance adjustment

In order to allow new generals to experience the charm of the battlefield more quickly, we made a major adjustment to the novice guidance:
- greatly streamlined novice quest, now faster to experience the fun of the battlefield.
- optimized experience and related guidance for novice levels.
- after the player completes the weapon teaching level, we will automatically equip the player with the corresponding armor according to the weapon selected by the player.
- greatly increased initial Leadership. Player level 1 now has 400 Leadership and level 30 now has 700 Leadership (originally level 60).
- several units can be obtained upon completion of the novice phase: Ironcap Swordsmen, Demesne Spearmen ,Elite Pike Militia, Ironcap Archers (replacing - the original Denesne Pikemen, Levy Bowman).
- added battlefield guidance during the first game of training camp(AI), Field Battle and Siege Battle.
- due to the adjustment of quest lines, we will reset all quest lines for players below level 15.

XII. System improvement 
-The elevation and depression angle of the open world character camera has been enlarged, and you can see more scene content by operating the camera;
-Add a weekly 20 times challenge limitation of the Rebel Camps.

notes.title: 05/12/2019 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear Warlords,
Dear Warlords, we figured a serious problem currently in live causing abnormal attack speed of range unit and it hurts the fairness of game significantly. We decided to conduct a server maintenance urgently which will be starting at 24:00 pm tonight and lasting to 8:00 am tomorrow. After the maintenance, we will send the compensation by mail with 10000 bronze and 600 honors. 

[b]1、Important feature： Doctrines Bag[/b]
We knew that too many doctrines in your inventory would inevitably occupy your rooms and become a pain in the ass. So we make this new Doctrines Bag system to free your inventory.
All doctrines will be stored in the Doctrines Bag, instead of your inventory or personal storage.

All doctrines that you currently have, will be moved into your Doctrines Bag, you can view all unequipped doctrine inside of this interface.

When you enter the game and open your inventory, all of your unequipped doctrines will be moved into your doctrines bag.

From now on, doctrines can not be salvaged at Smith, you can only salvage doctrines at [Salvaging] window from [War Scholar] Interface

Added two tag to The [Salvaging] interface, to show unequipped doctrines and signacula separately.  

[b]2、Unit Balance Adjustment:[/b]
[b]Viper Bowmen[/b]
With the analysis of data from last improvement of Viper Bowmen, we have to admit they are performing well as our design purpose. Low Piercing Armour Penetration and low attack speed restrict its performence，so we made these improvement：
Viper Bowmen : Attack Speed improved 15%
Viper Bowmen: Piercing Armour Penetration improved 20%

[b]Repeater Crossbowmen[/b]
Repeater Crossbowmen are not performing well without veterancy bonuses，so we made this improvement:
Repeater Crossbowmen can shoot poison arrows at 25% without veterancy bonuse. 

[b]Vassal Longbowmen[/b]
Though they have long attack range, but poor firing accuracy limit their performance, so we made this improvement:
Vassal Longbowmen : Firing Accuracy improved 20%

[b]Fire Lance Cavalry[/b]
Their melee attack are superior, we also want to see their range attack ability shine, so we made this improvement:
Fire Lance Cavalry will shoot bullets during their normal melee attack, with 20s colddown

[b]Javelin Sergeants[/b]
No longer ungroup after throw javelins.

[b]Tercio Arquebusiers[/b]
Improve their AI, no longer tend to melee attack enemies with their graceful sword even though enemies are still quite far from them.

[b]3、System Improvement[/b]
Improve the Unit Traits display of Imperial Pike Guards，now only show one [Relentless] trait instead of two separate traits. (The actual mechanic and value unchanged ) 
Deploy map UI improvement, now can view all artilleries easily. 
Dasuo Fort adjustment: Cleanup the props around B Flag.  
New High Level Military Rank display：After Lv.2360, Military Rank display will change once for each 100 Level.

notes.title: 28/11/2019 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear Warlords,
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, Nov 28th (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Here is the patch note.

[b]1.Map Adjustments[/b]
1)Dasuo Fort
After reviewing your feedbacks and having internal tests, we found that Dasuo Fort was still imbalanced with relatively low win ratio of attackers. It was hard for them to capture Point B and C after taking control of Point A. We’re guessing that it is caused by the following reasons:

a)Complex internal layout of Dasuo Fort
b)After attackers capturing Point A, there was only one route for them to get to the nearest supply point. They will suffer a huge loss attacking this supply point even with the help of several ranged units.
c)It was hard for them to continuously attack Point B and C without taking over the supply point. 

So we made the following adjustments:
Added a stairs at the starting point of city wall, making it easier for Warlords to get to the supply point. Warlords who capture the city wall in advance may have a better chance to take over the supply point then quickly support the battles between Point A and Point B. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fa8a07ca8a9079f6298ca4155c235cec03be651c.png[/img]

2)Allenburg 
After reviewing your feedbacks and having internal tests, we found that there were two main issues when attackers trying to capture Point B:
a)Stairs were too narrow for attacking
b)Attackers have few attacking routes when attacking Point B

We made the following adjustments accordingly:
a)Widened the stairs from city wall to Point B
b)Added a new attacking route connecting the city wall. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/d22c8bb8bea616df3f262fc99338d5b65fba0ae8.png[/img]

c)Added a stair and a set of ladders on the northeastern side of internal castle’s city wall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/6fff51a1a8240e578d93e4b8115921f70f511f1c.png[/img]

d)Widened the stairs from city wall to Point A

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f13c287fe1e37cf3404335e7e8f3324c4620014b.png[/img]

[b]2.Unit Balance Adjustment: Imperial Pike Guards[/b]
Imperial Pike Guards were underperforming on the battlefield due to the fact that they couldn’t effectively restrain high-tier cavalry units with relatively low damage. So we made the following adjustments:

1)The advancing of Imperial Pike Guards have damage bonus. They will cause more damage when advancing into relatively low move speed units. Greater speed difference will bring higher damage. 
2)The advancing of Imperial Pike Guards now have extra damage to charging units. 
3)Health growth for each level was increased by 42 points.

[b]3.Artillery Balance Adjustments[/b]
Currently, large artillery (Trebuchet, Battering ram and Siege tower) would receive too high damage from Culverin (higher than eastern Cannon), resulting in attackers couldn’t take advantage of these large artillery in some western maps. So we made the following adjustments:

Decreased the Culverin’s damage dealt to large artillery (Trebuchet, Battering ram and Siege tower), city gate and city wall, similar to the damage of Cannon with same-quality. 
(The damage dealt to heroes, units and small artillery will remain unchanged.)

Besides that, added a notification when the artillery being pushing forward. If Warlords click on an artillery that has already been used, there will be a notification icon showing that it is unavailable now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/5874650340feda9f5decc596a44d5e47c84a2517.png[/img]

[b]4.Important Updates: Auction House Activity (For one week only)[/b]
1)Black Friday Promotion
All Hero Attires are discounted by 25%
All Weapon Attires are discounted by 25%
All Mount Attires are discounted by 25%
All Unit Attires are discounted by 25%
All Unit Flags are discounted by 25%

2)New Attires:
New Hero Attire: Varangian 
Discounted price: 1780 sovereigns, 10% off its usual price of 1980 sovereigns

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/53b8c40367d4c2c5611c9fe6363babf9f7578157.jpg[/img]

New Mount Attire: Windblown 
Discounted price: 1780 sovereigns, 10% off its usual price of 1980 sovereigns

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/46288b11f2989d003812f154e477cffbb242ed1d.jpg[/img]

New Unit Attire: Northern Wilderness 
Discounted price: 270 sovereigns, 10% off its usual price of 300 sovereigns

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9acdc50b7cceb2130f30d95ea23340e019673d04.jpg[/img]

[b]5.Newly-added Season Career Interface[/b]
Now Warlords can check your territory war stats during Season Eve by pressing P and find “Season Career” in Career interface. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/639197b4d7f3d14fd0cb8f835fe51298079c3f09.png[/img]

[b]6.Bug Fixes[/b]
1)Unit Bug Fixes
a)Fixed the incorrect charge animation of Cataphract Lancers and Dagger-Axe Lancers
b)Fixed a bug that in some circumstances, the visual effect of cavalry charge didn’t play correctly.
2)Miscellaneous Fixes
a)Fixed a bug where the weather icon didn’t display correctly in deployment interface
b)Fixed a bug where Spear heroes couldn’t use Q to dismount when using “Full Tilt Charge”
c)Fixed a bug where weekly quest retrieval could retrieve wrong weekly quest reward chest.
d)Fixed the abnormal Season Eve Homepage in Traditional Chinese version due to the lack of localization. 

[b]7.System Optimizations[/b]
1)Unit Optimizations
a)Optimized the scatter formation for all cavalry units.
b)Optimized the visual effect of cavalry charge, making it more obvious in bright scene.
c)Slightly increased the height of Iron Reapers, making it more in line with the historical prototype.
d)Optimized the dispersed formation of Iron Reapers with more regular layout. 

2)System Optimizations
a)Optimized the UI when units forming up, making it more obvious in grassland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b68240d9290e10800d44c5e9ab83c046419239c3.png[/img]

b)When Warlords expanding the stable, Horse Trough could be purchased with just one click and then take effect automatically.

notes.title: 21/11/2019 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear Warlords,
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 4 am to 8 am, 21 Nov (UTC +8). 

The maintenance with long duration was conducted because the server of Conqueror’s Blade: Frontier was migrated from Singapore to Hongkong. We have been preparing for this server migration during past few weeks and already had few rounds of tests. The average ping in Seoul and Busan has been decreased from 110ms to 67ms. Similar optimizations also can be found in other regions. 

We have been cooperating with Huawei Cloud during this server migration. New high quality internet has been added in our SEA server, which means that the game will remain fluent and stable even for cross-server matchmaking. 

Here are the patch notes:

[b]1.Important Updates: Honour Redemption System[/b]
Warlords now can use Honour Redemption Token to seal one node and get relevant Honour back.

1)How to buy

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/26e14b7c657633052af9e8676c509789163f7873.png[/img]

Honour Redemption Token is now available in Auction House. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/9eeb3e2519211e24f0e831f9006aed79e224e562.png[/img]

After launching this new system, we will offer a 40% discount on Hounor Redemption Token at first. Each Warlord can buy 10 Hounor Redemption Pack at most. Each one of them contain 100 Hounor Redemption tokens. Cost 300 sovereigns for each chest.  
This item can be found in Auction House.

2)How to use

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/00801ced4707eff6921cba35ab38c973d6dacafc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/e7d16fa2c00a1e731826f7258d319d10bbf5d17d.png[/img]

Any one of nodes can be sealed. (Except nodes in Rustic Era) The consumption of Honour Redemption Token depends on the Honour required to unlock that node. Cost One Honour Redemption Token for every 100 Honour. (Cost One Honour Redemption Token for a node that have been unlocked less than 100 Hounor)

After one node been sealed:
-The buff effect will be inoperative
-The unit couldn’t be deployed on the battlefield however existing level and doctrines will remain unchanged.

Warlords can unseal the node with same amount of Hounor.

Please noted:
-Some Era may be no longer available if Warlords couldn’t reach the era unlock requirement after too many units were sealed.

-If Warlords get ready to seal one node, the following nodes will also be sealed at the same time. The consumption of Honour Redemption Token depends on the total Hounor of these nodes. 

We also made some adjustments to the era unlock requirement at the same time;
-Chivalric Era: unlock 4 units between one star to three and half stars
-Silver Era: unlock 4 units between two stars to three and half stars
-Heroic Era: unlock 4 three stars or three and half star units
-Golden Era: unlock 4 four stars or four and half star units

[b]2.Important Updates: Camp system and open world Matchmaking[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/36363f32a0d275e51b7bfac101612a214be12a75.png[/img]

Now Warlords can press J or the camp icon below to camp in open world. After camp completed, Warlords can have matched battles in open world same as the normal matchmaking in a fort. Warlords who have already camped in open world can still team up and join in battles with other Warlords staying in a fort.

Please noted:
1)After camping, Warlords can’t move, pursue or be pursued by other Warlords. Other actions in open world would also be limited at the same time. 
2)The camp status can be cancelled by clicking “leave the camp”, however can’t be cancelled after battle countdown begins.
3)Warlords can’t camp during territory war and all camp will be cancelled by the system automatically. 

[b]3.Unit Balance Adjustments: Rattan Units[/b]
Rattan units was known as their poison weapons. However it was underperforming on the battlefield especially in high-level battles. We decided to make the following adjustments to enhance it:
-Rattan Pikemen, Viper Bowmen and Mounted Crossbow Cavalry: The damage of weapon poison now can stack 5 times (previously 3 times)
-Decreased enemy’s damage by 15% (previously 5%)
-Slowing enemy by 20% (previously 15%)

Considering Viper Bowmen was underperforming on the battlefield due to low shooting accuracy, we decided to make the following adjustments to enhance it:
-Increased the shooting accuracy by 30%
-[Battle Technique]: increased the chance of shooting poison arrows by 50% (previously 30%)
-[Underhandedness]: increased the chance of shooting poison arrows by 80% (previously 60%)

[b]4.Map Adjustments[/b]
1)Dasuo Fort
-Adjusted the supply point location between Point A and Point B

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/fe3204101babdac7cecf526f8f247e859b6a1877.png[/img]

-Adjusted the supply point location on the left side of final flag

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/2a66bb48b3c3602ae90f34af1a383f51c099b573.png[/img]

-A new supply point in the final area is available for Defenders after Attackers conquering the external supply point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/bac597335eeca80f645ed2b9f1db93ed7166c41b.png[/img]

2)Kurak Castle Fort
Adjusted the artillery setting on the left side of Point A by switching the Culverin and Ballista. Ballista behind the left city wall was swapped with Culverin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b13edf4e7fe2d01c071c8dec8b3e8ec033fcc0d1.png[/img]

3)Other maps
-Fixed the object collision in Desert City Defence PVE level which leads to abnormal behaviors of enemy soldiers
-Adjusted the Defenders’ respawn area in Border Fort, making it quicker for defenders to get to the city wall. Fixed the incorrect location of respawn area in deployment interface. 
-Fixed the physical hit box in the right city wall in Allenburg.
-Fixed a bug where Warlords got stuck after falling into the wooden fence between Point B and Point C in Dasuo Fort. 

[b]5.Bug fixes and optimization[/b]
1)Unit Bug Fixes
-Fixed a bug that the second stage of Ironcap Swordsmen [Endurance Training] did not take effect correctly.
-Fixed the model issue of Winged Hussar where sometimes soldiers and their mount behave like separating from each other. 
-Fixed a bug sometimes Winged Hussars’ charge couldn’t hit enemies.
-Fixed a bug where Prefecture Archers could shoot flaming arrows in the rain
-Fixed a bug sometimes Men-at-Arms couldn’t attack enemies while protecting Warlords. 
-Fixed a bug where Serfs couldn’t charge during Schiltron formation.

2)Miscellaneous Fixes
-Fixed the incomplete display of allies’ units of in TAB interface during battles. 
-Fixed a bug that sometimes daily quest retrieval could retrieve wrong quests.
-Fixed a bug that sometimes weekly quest retrieval could retrieve quests from other week.

[b]6.System Optimization [/b]
1)Unit Optimization
Optimized the formation of Men-at-Arms, making it can block enemies while protecting Warlords.
2)Other Optimizations
-Now Warlords can get 3 Requisition Order at most from one Secret Vault (previously 5).
-The crafting tax consumption will be displayed when reforging equipments. 
-When Warlords resupplying the unit kit, relevant items will be directly showed in market interface with just one click.

notes.title: 7/11/2019 Patch Note
notes.notes:
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, Nov 7th (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Here is the patch note.

[b]1.New Epic Mission---“Until the Blood Cold”(PVE)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/b0bacaac01f69459bc352db4ff8bc075a26fd742.png[/img]
Enemy Commander conducted a surprise ambush. The city was at risk due to insufficient troops. Please help Commander Wu to defend the city till the end in the final stage of the Prefecture Guards epic mission.

During each battle, Warlords can kill enemies to earn Warhonor and exchange for advanced artillery in Warhonor Sergent (Advanced artillery will expire after each battle). In addition, incomplete notes from the first king and other rewards are also available.

Added exclusive badges for this level:
Twice Repay：Kill 2 enemy bosses in Until the Blood Cold
Fire on Command：Use artillery to kill 40 enemy soldiers in Until the Blood Cold

Available: 12:00-24:00 Nov 7th---Nov 13rd

[b]2.Weekly Quest Rewards Adjustments[/b]
Some Warlords said the random drop rate of Treatises in Fine Campaign Reward had huge damage to their game experience. Now Warlords can get Treatises from the following weekly chests with a specific drop rate (Treatises are no longer available in fine campaign reward). Our adjustments are as follows: 
Page’s Gift: 100% 1 Treatise
Squire’s Gift: 100% 2 Treatises
Knight’s Gift: 100% 2 Treatises
Marshal’s Gift: 100% 2 Treatises

Warlords who have already got some rewards from above-mentioned chests before this update will receive Treatise compensations by mail within one week.

In addition, we also reduced the retrieval price for On Campaign quests:
On Campaign Ⅰ: 40 sovereigns (previously 50)
On Campaign Ⅱ: 80 sovereigns (previously 100)
On Campaign Ⅲ: 80 sovereigns (previously 100)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         
[b]3.Seasonal Challenges Optimizations[/b]
After checking your feedbacks, we decided to reduce the difficulty of some Seasonal challenges. Our adjustments are as follows:
1）Removed the difficulties requirement of Expedition Ⅰ,Ⅱ,Ⅲ
2）In Field Battle mode, defeat 50 shield-wielding enemy soldiers (previously eastern spearmen)

Warlords who have already completed “defeat 50 eastern spearmen” and some challenges in Expedition Ⅱ,Ⅲ before this update will receive extra seasonal XP rewards by mail within one week.

[b]4.Purchase Limit of “Letter of the First King”[/b]
In order to make it easier for Warlords to get more rewards and higher Nobility in the last week of Season Eve. We decided to remove the Purchase Limit of “Letter of the First King”.

[b]5.Personal Storage Modification Supply[/b]
Now Warlords can use 200,000 silver coins to buy “Personal Storage Modification Supply” from Smuggler

[b]6.Newbie Tutorial Optimizations[/b]
1)Optimized the tutorial after Warlords entering main city. Simplified some side quests. Newbies can upgrade more quickly than before. 
2)Optimized the [Valen’s Last Stand] level: reduced the difficulty by adding few trebuchets to help Warlords win this battle.
3)Optimized the [The Battle On the Plain] level: Enemy eastern spearmen units have been adjusted to pikemen units. 
4)Optimized the [Battle at the Storehouse] level: Added some tips for artillery and Powder Keg. Added a warning alarm when Trebuchet is approaching. Warlords can also skip this level.

[b]7.Level Balance Adjustments: White Elk[/b]
By October 30, White Elk has experienced 2,963 siege battles. The win ratio of attackers is 44.21%. Among that, the win ratio of attackers over level 100 is 46.22%, lower than we expected. After checking your feedbacks and having internal tests, we made the following adjustments:
For attackers:
1)Move middle two Trebuchets to the left. Attackers now can use Trebuchet to attack from both sides without being blocked by high buildings in the middle of battlefield. 
2)Move point A closer to the intersection. 
For defenders:
1)Move the base flag closer to the intersection.
2)Move one supply point inside the building instead of being totally exposed to enemy’s ranged attacks.
3)Add a new supply point in defenders’ respawn area. Defenders still have chance to choose new units even if they got surrounded in the base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/3a3a47cdd6494d0ee1dc3c022048494c8fcc1dd3.png[/img]

[b]8.Level Optimizations[/b]
1)Optimized the setting of some Hwacha Arrow Launcher in the city wall of Wall Fort so they couldn’t be blocked by buildings.
2)In PVE level, optimized the style and color of health bar and icon on top of AI allies, making it easier for Warlords to distinguish between allied Warlords and AI allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/529f1e91d6a2dc5e901e868b6d79ca2474a9d899.png[/img]

[b]9.Bug Fixes[/b]
1)Unit Bugs
a.Fixed a bug that the damage buff of some veterancy points did not take effect correctly in field and siege battles.
b.Fixed a bug that Mounted Crossbow Cavalry couldn’t charge in column formation
c.Fixed the incorrect attack speed of Ironcap Bowriders while Warlords spamming follow(c) orders. 
d.Unified the model of Demesne Archer in Unit Tree interface and battlefield. 

2)Miscellaneous Bugs
a.Fixed the overlapping interface when Warlords open season homepage while collecting resources. 
b.Fixed the incorrect horn sound effect while city wall being broken.
c.Fixed a bug that sometimes Warlords got stuck near the city wall in Hovd.

notes.title: 31/10/2019 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear Warlords:
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, 31th, Oct (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Here is the patch note:

[b]1.Season Eve important updates[/b]
[b]1)Season Eve Extension[/b]
In order to let Warlords have more time to complete seasonal challenges and get more seasonal rewards, we decided to extend Season Eve for two more weeks. Season Eve will officially end at Oct 18.

[b]2)New weekly challenges[/b]
We added some new weekly challenges including exploration in the open world and equipment crafting for week 6 and week 7.

[b]3)Weekly challenges refresh[/b]
Now Warlords can choose one weekly challenge and click “refresh” to get a random new challenge, however the relevant rewards remain unchanged. Warlords only have two chances per week. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/22cd2ed510c223cd78ae9582d0874d769a819c50.png[/img]

[b]4)Nobility Cap[/b]
The “Letter of the First King” will no longer be available for Warlords with Nobility over level 200. We will release an announcement soon to make compensations for those Warlords already bought this item after level 200. 

[b]5)Territory War Point [/b]
Now Warlords can check their Territory War points in the homepage of Season Eve. Join Territory War to earn more points for better rewards in Seasonal Settlement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/582306d4f1a79bc13c798a0404a0df29fae10c1a.png[/img]

[b]6)Description optimization for seasonal items[/b]
Adjusted the description for Conquest Token, the letter of the First King and the incomplete notes from the First King. These items are only effective in Season Eve.

[b]2.“Disguise Kit” and “Gender Change” item[/b]
Now Warlords can use Sovereigns to buy Disguise Kit and Gender Change item in the store. Warlords can use Disguise Kit to remake Character’s appearance. Use Gender Change to change the gender and remake the appearance. 
1)Disguise Kit: 300 sovereigns
2)Gender Change: 900 sovereigns

[b]3.Important Fixes[/b]
We had received many feedbacks that after cavalry bracing or charging, the damage would continue to be taken by other units walking through that area. We already fixed this bug in this update.

[b]4.Weekly Challenges Adjustment[/b]
After checking your feedbacks, we decided to adjust the difficulty of some weekly challenges.
In Expedition Ⅰ, inflict a total of 1,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)
In Expedition Ⅱ, inflict a total of 2,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)
In Expedition Ⅲ, inflict a total of 2,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)
In field battles, inflict a total of 2,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)
In siege battles, inflict a total of 5,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)
In field battles, absorb a total of 2,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)
In siege battles, absorb a total of 5,000,000 damage (previously 10,000,000)

Warlords who have already completed these challenges before this update will receive extra seasonal XP rewards by mail within one week.

[b]5.“White Elk (Battle Drill)” Siege Free Battle Adjustment[/b]
After checking your suggestions, we decided to put siege free battle into the weekly free battle mode.
---“White Elk (Battle Drill)” Siege Free Battle will be available at 20:00-21:30 every Monday and Friday
---Random field free battle will be available at 20:00-21:30 every Thursday

[b]6.Territory War Rules[/b]
Many Warlords said that some players are taking advantage of our adjustments in Oct 17 updates to conduct passive battles, maliciously kick other players out the battlefield and block the battle lines. So we made the following adjustments accordingly:
1)Warlords who have only engaged in the battlefield for 1 minute or less cannot be kicked. (previously 2 minutes)
2)Warlords who have engaged in the battle and ranking in the top one-third cannot be kicked. (previously two-thirds)

[b]7.Hero Balance Adjustments[/b]
1)Shortsword & shield 
We made the following optimizations for Thunderstruck:
a)Warlords can press T again to jump and smash to the ground during running
b)Warlords can move the camera to adjust the direction before jump
c)Added a defence buff and slightly decreased the move speed at the moment of using this skill
d)Increased the move distance of Thunderstruck

2)Longsword & shield
After previous adjustments, we found that the second hit of Shield Bash was unable to attack enemies accurately. 
---Removed the “Repelled” effect for the first hit of Shield Bash.

3)Bow
We have checked your feedbacks on our previous adjustments to damage loss, mainly about the issue that Lightning Bolt couldn’t kill enemy heroes surrounded and protected by many soldiers. So we made the following adjustments:
a)Lightning Bolt Ⅰ: can shoot through 5 enemies, damage will be reduced by 20% per enemy.
b)Lightning Bolt Ⅱ: can shoot through 5 enemies, damage will be reduced by 15% per enemy.
c)Lightning Bolt Ⅲ: can shoot through 5 enemies, damage will be reduced by 10% per enemy.

4)Musket
With long duration of slowing enemies and wide attack range, the Deploy Caltrops could easily restrain the charge of cavalry and some infantries. Our adjustments are as follows:
a)Decreased the attacking radius from 3.5m to 3m for level Ⅰand level Ⅱ, from 4m to 3.5m for level Ⅲ
b)Deploy Caltrops Ⅰ: decreased skill duration from 8s to 5s
c)Deploy Caltrops Ⅱ: decreased skill duration from 8s to 6s, increased the bleeding damage from 100 points/s to 130 points/s
a)Deploy Caltrops Ⅲ: decreased skill duration from 8s to 7s, increased the bleeding damage from 100 points/s to 140 points/s

[b]8.Unit Balance Adjustments[/b]
1)Mounted Crossbow Cavalry
a)Increased basic health by 10%
b)Veterancy point “Preparation”: “increases crossbow arrows fired each round by 1” was adjusted to “reduces the ranged damage taken by 20%”
c)Adjusted the F1 formation to “dispersed” formation, added a new “column” formation (F3) 

2)Tercio Arquebusiers
After checking your feedbacks and having internal tests, we found that the performance of Tercio Arquebusiers didn’t meet our expectation. We made the following optimizations to unstable reloading time and aiming time.
a)Optimized the weapon structure, greatly increased the reloading speed and aiming speed
b)Fixed the bug that sometimes Tercio Arquebusiers could repeatedly switch between ranged and melee weapons.

3)Prefecture Pikemen
Some Warlords said that the current performance of Prefecture Pikemen didn’t in line with our design.
---Increased the charge distance by 10m
---The extra piercing armour penetration for charge will be increased by 15%

4)Ironcap Spearmen
---Decreased the leadership from 190 to 175, increased the unit size from 32 to 36

5)Palace Guards
The defence ability of Palace Guards was lower than we expected, resulting in a poor performance on the battlefield. So we made the following adjustments to enhance its defence ability.
a)Veterancy point “Stand Fast”: “increases blocks by 40” was adjusted to “ reduces damage taken by 5%”
b)Veterancy point “Rearguard”: “reduces damage taken from rear attacks by 5%” was adjusted to “reduces damage taken from rear attacks by 15%”
c)Added a new trait “Staunch Defenders”: reduces damage taken from pikemen, shortsword & shield infantry, archers and crossbow infantry by 12%.

6)Imperial Archers
Due to lower shooting speed, the Bodkin Arrows was weaker than Bodkin-Tipped when fighting against heavy armour units. Besides that, there are some veterancy points having nothing to do with battlefield performances. Our adjustments are as follows:
a)Veterancy point “Garrison”: “each level increases damage during siege battles by 10%” was adjusted to “increases the shooting speed of Bodkin Arrows by 5%”
b)Veterancy point “Kit Repair”: “reduces resupply cost by 5%” was adjusted to “increases damage to cavalry by 10%”
c)Veterancy point “Tenacity”: “decreases unit’s mortality rate in the open world by 5%” was adjusted to “increases piercing armour penetration by 8%”
d)Veterancy point “Sharp Shot”: “increases the shooting accuracy by 5%” was adjusted to “increases the shooting speed of Bodkin Arrows by 5%”

7)Vanguard Archers
We made some adjustments to enhance the maneuverability and attack ability of Vanguard Archers.
a)Veterancy point “Open Ground”: “increases damage during field battles by 100 points” was adjusted to “during ‘move and fire’, the move speed will be increased by 10% each shoot ”
b)Veterancy point “Move as One”: “increases move speed by 5%” was adjusted to “during ‘move and fire’, slowing the targets by 15% for 6s.”

8)Imperial Pike Guards
Made some optimizations and fixed some bugs when advancing so that this unit can move forward more fluently after formation completed.

[b]9.Level Balance Adjustments: Hidden City Siege battle [/b]
By October 27, Hidden City has experienced 33,828 siege battles. The win ratio of attackers is 51.60%. Among that, Warlords over level 100 have engaged in 14,137 battles, the win ratio of attackers is 56.16%, higher than we expected. After checking your feedbacks, we made the following adjustments:
1)Added a new supply point nearby defender’s base camp
2)Added a new path behind defender’s base flag, making it easier for Warlords to retreat and defend the base camp.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/7781fbfc0a30b6ca059e6b6f355221eefcc86f98.png[/img]

[b]10.System Optimizations[/b]
1)PVE stats will no longer be counted into Hero Ranking and Career stats.
2)Optimized the display of getting glory. 
3)Adjusted the icon size of materials and resources in the crafting interface.
4)Optimized the button style for attributes information in Character interface

[b]11.Bug Fixes and optimizations[/b]
1)Level Bug Fixes
a)Fixed the unbalanced player number in matched battles
b)Fixed a bug that units might float in the air after right city wall in White Elk was broken
c)Fixed the wrong icon of base flag and supply point in some villages including Ziya, Futao and New Sintar.
d)Fixed a bug that sometimes the guidance marker was blocked by the buildings in PVE levels

We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, 24th, Oct (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Here is the patch note:

[b]Available: 20:00-21:30, Oct 24, Oct 25 and Oct 28[/b]

[b]a)No unit kit loss, Warlords can deploy five units without leadership limits.

[b]2.New level: White Elk (siege battle)[/b]
Now the White Elk is available for matched siege battles and will appear more frequently than other siege maps. Hope Warlords will have more fun in this new level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/ca24b2d2e35e19f29fa65d853cc4269c266cfcc3.png[/img]

[b]3.Seasonal challenges adjustments[/b]
After checking your feedbacks, we adjusted some challenges to make it easier for you to upgrade.

In 1 battle of Expedition Ⅰ, achieve A rating or better (previously A+)
In 1 battle of Expedition Ⅱ, achieve A rating or better (previously A+)
In 2 battles of Expedition Ⅱ, achieve A rating or better (previously A+)
In 3 battles of Expedition Ⅱ, achieve A rating or better (previously A+)
In 2 free battles, achieve B+ rating or better (previously A)
In 1 AI battle, earn A rating (previously S)

Warlords who have already completed these challenges before this update will receive extra seasonal XP rewards by mail within one week. 

[b]4.Limited-time Seasonal XP bonus[/b]
In order to make it easier for Warlords to upgrade with more glory, we offer 1.5 times Seasonal XP bonus for matched battles.

[b]Available: 12:00-14:00; 18:00-20:00, October 28- October 30[/b]

[b]5.Halloween decorations[/b]
We already added some Halloween decorations in the main city. Please stay tuned for Halloween activities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/18a25b8d72837a32afce0517924e4a9365f6cc19.png[/img]

[b]6.More Treatises in Fine Campaign Reward[/b]
We raised the possibility of getting Treatises in Fine Campaign Reward.

[b]7.Hero skill adjustments[/b]
In order to deal with issues that some level Ⅲ skills are weaker than level Ⅱskills equipped with mastery points, we made the following adjustments:
1)Shortsword & shield
Shield Bash Ⅲ: Increased blunt damage by 5%
Kick Ⅲ: Increased blunt damage by 3%
2)Glaive
Arc of Steel Ⅲ: Increased slashing damage by 3%
3)Bow
Flaming Arrow Ⅲ: Increased piercing armour penetration by 3%
Exploding Arrow Ⅲ: Increased piercing armour penetration by 5%
4)Dual Blades
Marked for Death Ⅲ: Increased slashing armour penetration by 5%
5)Short bow
Wrath of Artemis Ⅲ: Increased piercing armour penetration by 5%
6)Nodachi
Tiger’s Claw Ⅲ: Increased slashing damage by 5%
Avalanche Ⅲ: Increased damage by 5%
Samurai’s March Ⅲ: Increased slashing armour penetration by 5%
7)Poleaxe
Bec de Corbin Ⅲ: Increased slashing armour penetration by 5%
Rough Justice Ⅲ: Increased damage by 5%
Halberdier’s Thrust Ⅲ: Increased damage by 3%
8)Longsword & shield
With Valour Ⅲ: Increased damage by 3%
Paladin Ⅲ: Increased slashing damage by 5%
Sally Forth Ⅲ: Increased damage by 5%
9)Spear
Lugh’s March Ⅲ: Increased piercing damage by 3%
Procris’s Gift Ⅲ: Increased piercing armour penetration by 3%
Return of Jangar Ⅲ: Increased damage by 3%
Heaven’s Fury Ⅲ: Increased damage by 5%c

[b]8.Animation adjustment[/b]
Now the animation of repelled is similar to knock down. But repelled can be canceled by rolling while knock down can’t. We decided to adjust the animation and increase the displacement distance, making it easier for Warlords to distinguish these two status.

These adjustments will have effect for:
Longsword & Shield: Shield Bash Ⅲ
Poleaxe: Push Back Ⅱ
Spear: Dragon’s Roar

To be noted: the last attack of Longsword & Shield “With Valour” should be repelled rather than knock down. We already made some adjustments to make it in line with the description.

[b]9.Unit balance adjustments[/b]
1) Tercio Arquebusiers
After checking your feedbacks and having internal tests, we found that the Tercio Arquebusiers had low accuracy as well as fighting efficiency. So our adjustments are as follows:
a) Increased the accuracy of attacking surrounding/nearest units by 25%
b) Increased the accuracy of attacking designated area by 20%
c) Decreased the reload time by 30%
d) Optimized the animation when switching ranged weapons to melee weapons
e) Increased the efficiency for melee fights: Increased the attacking speed. Increased the melee attack damage by 20%.

2) Javelin units
a) Decreased the damage loss cap from 30% to 20% for all javelin units
b) Decreased the damage loss rate by 0.5% per meter for all javelin units
c) Javelin sergeants could shoot through the first enemy then attack one more target.

3) Vassal Longbowmen
Due to relatively long shooting range, the focused fire skill (can’t track enemies) have some limitations.
Added a skill with low CD and capability of tracking enemies to replace the focused fire skill.
Longbow shoot: track and attack enemies at the designated area, CD is 5s.

[b]10.Level balance adjustments: Augolia siege battle[/b]
By October 21, Augolia has experienced 17,118 siege battles. Attacker’s winning percentage is 46.17%, lower than we expected. We made the following adjustments:
We have received some feedbacks that defenders have some advantages that could keep the front gate under their control then hold down the attackers. We added one attacking path along the city wall nearby point D, providing more alternatives for attackers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/f7b3490da6a94d9cf10d30fe80de973dc07a5718.png[/img]

[b]11.Map adjustments [/b]
During territory war, some western cities with narrow gate have defending advantages, such as Ellbogen, Westberg and Rozsdaskaszat, etc. We adjusted the ladder number to 3 per set (previously 2) and added one set on the right side of attacker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35323464/55d5498ae673566ae3ea5db7e43f74ae77511e55.png[/img]

[b]12.Bug fixes[/b]
1. Hero bug fixes 
1) Spear
a) Fixed a bug that the buff effect of “Lugh’s March”, “Hurricane’s Edge” and “Heaven’s Fury” couldn’t stack up
b) Adjusted the description for spear heroes attire set

After: Doubles the armour piercing bonus received upon hitting enemy when using Lugh’s March, Hurricane’s Edge or Heaven’s Fury.

2) The damage loss of ranged heroes’ skill
After checking your feedbacks, we found that the damage loss when some ranged heroes shooting through several enemies was inoperative. Our adjustments are as follows:
Every time Warlords shooting through an enemy, the damage loss would be reduced by 30%.

These adjustments will have effect for:
Bow: Lightning Bolt
Short bow: Steel-tipped Arrow Ⅲ

3) Fixed a bug that the buff effect of Dual Blade heroes’ Skirmisher’s set of was inoperative

2. Unit bug fixes
1) Fixed a bug that the charge of Iron Pagoda was totally inoperative when the destination was too far. 
2) Fixed a bug that the “Move as One” of Winged Hussars was inoperative.
3) Fixed a bug that during forming up, the charge of Mounted crossbow cavalry was inoperative and started to cooldown.
4) Fixed a bug that sometimes the Mounted crossbow cavalry couldn’t shoot after formation completed.
5) Fixed a bug that “Elementary firearms training”, “Tactical Formations”, “Espirit de Corps” and “Volley Fire Practice” was inoperative for Tercio Arquebusiers.
6) Fixed the incorrect speed description of Fire Lance Cavalry, it should be 7.5 rather than 6.5.
7) Fixed a bug that cavalry may get stuck into the city wall when the siege tower is in positon.
8) Added a short CD for node upgrade so it couldn’t be interrupted by quick clicks.

3. Level bug fixes
1) Fixed a bug that flaming pitch may be blocked by the city wall when shooting at enemies nearby the city wall in Kurak castle and Valley Fortress.
2) Fixed a bug that few soldiers couldn’t follow the order to climb up to the city wall in Sun city.

1) Fixed a bug that if the matched battle starts during recondition, Warlords may loss the materials and equipment.
2) Fixed a bug that the house camp remain unchanged when a new liege was appointed.

notes.title: 17/10/2019 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear Warlords:
We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, 17th, Oct (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Here is the patch note:

[b]1.Unit Balances: Prefecture Archers Adjustments[/b]
We have already shared our thoughts of adjusting the Prefecture Archers unit. Our adjustments are as follows:

a)The “A Hundred Paces” (Each level increases shooting range by 6%) will be replaced by “Mustering” (Each level add 1 more soldier to the unit). 
b)Adjusted the maximum shooting range to 87m.

Reasons:
This unit has strong explosive power to attack enemies when using arrow rain, which is in line with our design. But we realized that its maximum shooting range as 96m is higher than other same level units, making it easier to find better attacking position and produce high damage beyond the shooting range of enemy ranged units. The Prefecture Archers is supposed to be a unit of archers good at quick shooting rather than a Gatling or Katyusha rocket launcher. We also don’t want this situation that other same era units totally get suppressed by the Prefecture Archers.

A “Unit Training Plan” reward will be mailed to Warlords who already unlock the Prefecture Archers, allowing them to reset veterancy points.

[b]2.Optimizations to the rights of Ruling House [/b]
The commander system was designed to neutralize the influence by malicious and passive battles. But some players use this rule to declare war on themselves and maliciously kick everyone else out of the battlefield after randomly being assigned as commander. In order to deal with malicious kicking issues, we made the following adjustments: 

a)Warlords whose participation ranking in first two-thirds couldn’t be kicked out 
b)Warlords engaging in the battlefield less than 2 minutes couldn’t be kicked out.

[b]3.Limited-time Seasonal XP Bonus[/b]
In order to make it easier for Warlords to upgrade with more glory, we offer 1.5 times Seasonal XP bonus for matched battles.
Available: 12:00-14:00; 18:00-20:00, October 21- October 23

[b]4.  Purchase Limit Adjustments[/b]
We made the following adjustments to the purchase limit of "Letter of the First King":
Adjusted the purchase limit from "5 pieces per day" to "35 pieces per week".

[b]5.Auction House Guidance Prices Adjustment[/b]
After checking the trading data, we found that the guidance price of some hero forging and schematics were lower than the market expected. So we raised the guidance prices for the following items:
Powdered Silver
Steel Shavings
Special Helmet Schematics
Special Chest Armour Schematics
Special Glove Schematics
Special Boots Schematics
You can check the adjusted guidance price in the auction house

[b]6.Bug Fixes
1.Important Fixes[/b]
a)Fixed the abnormally intensive anti-cavalry formation of Pike Militia. This unit couldn’t use brace weapons during charging. 
b)Fixed the stretched model issue of Pike Militia, Javelin Militia, Ironcap Swordsmen and Ironcap Bowriders after their appearance being changed by unit training.
c)Fixed a bug when Archer units staying close to the city wall, they could shoot through it.


[b]2.Unit Bug Fixes[/b]
a)Fixed the wrong description of Thick Armour and Razor-Sharp of Winged Hussars. The description of thick armour should be “Each level increases all defence by 2%”, razor-sharp should be “Each level increases slashing damage by 5%”.
b)Fixed a bug that the “Move as One” of Winged Hussars was inoperative.
c)Fixed a bug that the “Rudimentary Medicine” of Javelin Sergeants was inoperative.
d)Fixed a bug that the “Second Wind” of Rattan Swordsmen” couldn’t come into effect correctly. Now each level of this node can reduce CD by 10s.
e)Fixed a bug that the “Reinforced Bows” of Ironcap Archers couldn’t increase the shooting range.
f)Fixed a bug that the first two level of “Marching Drill” of Vanguard Archers were inoperative.
g)Fixed a bug that sometimes the Legendary Javelin DoctrineⅠcould invalidate the knock down and throw javelin skills.
h)Fixed a bug that the unit was unable to enter battle after their status reducing to 20 or 21.
i)Fixed a bug that the character still maintained their in-game posture after being killed.

[b]3.Miscellaneous Bugs[/b]
a)Fixed a bug that Dual Blade heroes couldn’t use the “Alchemical Vapours” and “Infiltrator” in defending status. 
b)Fixed a bug that sometimes heroes could be sent to wrong location when they staying in some Western forts. 
c)Fixed the background music loss of “Surrounded in White Elk” PVE activity.
d)Fixed a bug that sometimes random epic artillery chest for Warlords whose nobility reaching level 90 had the incorrect items. 
e)Fixed the incorrect display when clicking the border posts of current region in open world map.
f)Fixed a bug when the personal storage is full, some item may disappear when being transferred.
g)Fixed the abnormal countdown display when the resource site is about to refresh less than 1 minute.

[b]7.Description and visual effect optimizations [/b]
a)Optimized the reminder description when some Warlords leaving the territory war.
b)Optimized the description of “Strong Strikes” of Fire Lance Cavalry. Now the description should be: Level 1 can stun enemy units. Level 2 can stun enemy heroes. 
c)Optimized the explosion visual effect with better resolution for the “Liquid Fire” of Musket heroes 
d)Optimized the sound effect of mount display in market and character interface.
e)Optimized the display of attack/defend targets in the bottom right of the open world map. Added hightlight effect when hovering over the mouse and the icon showing battle status.

Dear Warlords:

We will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, 19th, Sep (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Here is the patch note：

[b]1.Mercenaries unit recruit [/b]
During past two months, Warlords from different regions in Conqueror's Blade: Frontier were super active in the market, making silver coins become the hard currency in the game. notes.title: 21/08/2019 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Dear Warlords, we will be conducting server maintenance during the period of 6 am to 8 am, 21st, Aug (UTC+8). The estimated maintenance time is approximately 2 hours. Once the server resumes service, you should receive compensation through the Mail System that consists of the following: 5000 Silver and 200 Honor.

1.	Important update: Bronze income
Many Warlords were complaining about the bronze income differences between NA/EU version and Frontier version. Firstly, we would like to clarify that we introduced a new battle point system for settlement in Frontier version.
Compared with the old settlement system, the new system is more intuitive and more comprehensive to evaluate the diverse contribution behaviors in the battlefield, such as damage, deploying siege machine, flag capturing time, type of eliminated units and etc. Also, for a single combat strategy, it has a certain upper limit. In the end, the system will add all points up to present players’ performance.
Because this is a brand-new mechanism and the bronze is a core currency in game, we are very cautious in the adjustment of the value. In addition, many Warlords also reported that some players are playing very passively but still get a decent reward compared to active players.
Based on these two points, we plan to optimize the mechanism of bronze income from battles to encourage positive combat behavior. Here are the changes.
-	It is expected that after the update on Wednesday (August 20th) to this Sunday (August 25th), a test-based “Bronze Vanguard” will be launched online.
-	During the event, bronze income of battle points and victory will be increased about 10 to 30 percentages than usual.

We would like listen to more voices about this change and if you are satisfied with this change in income and this change won’t affect the normal operation of the in-game economic system, we will retain this modification. 

2.	Important update: Matching-making mechanism update
The current matching system in the game is a level-based matching system, which is a relatively simple processing method. We believe that the ladder system that will enable the Warlords to show their skills in the future is very necessary. However, the design of ladder is very difficult, so we intend to introduce its foundation – battle ranking, to measure and express the combat capabilities of the Warlords in a more dynamic and performance-driven manner.
Therefore, over the past month or so, we are developing a new generation of dynamic “battle ranking” system, which should first be used in the matching system, which is not limited to the levels and based on the real battlefield performance. This system has just been released, and it will take a long time to adjust and stabilize with the help from all the Warlords.
Thus, we are planning to open the new match-making system as an activitiy for all the Warlords to try it out. The specific schedule is as follows:
-	August 20-August 22, 14:00-18:00; available both in field and siege mode
To be noted, at the beginning of the test, the Warlords may find that the level difference in the battlefield will be larger than normal. That’s because the system is new online, and the evaluation of the battle ranking of each player requires a period of data accumulation to be more accurate. The data gradually accumulates, and the skills and power between players in the same battlefield will become closer eventually. 

3.	Bots mode fixes
Our definition of a Bots mode is a low-pressure mode in which the Warlords can participate at any time when they need leisure, but not as the main income resources.
Before the update on last Thursday, we found that when the Warlords reached a certain level when he could only bring T2\T3 units, but the BOT had already brought the T3 or even the T4 units, which did not match the pace of the game, resulting in bad game experiences. Therefore, we adjusted the Bots’ units on last Thursday to make it more reasonable. It also speeded up the efficiency of Bronze income in the Bots mode which turns out that in the high-level Bots mode the efficiency of Bronze farming has even exceeded the normal game modes and we do think it will seriously affect the game ecology.
Therefore, we have lowered the Bronze income in the high-level Bots mode to restore normal efficiency and avoid bad effects towards other game modes.

4.	House flags
Added house flags to belonging fief’s 3D model in open world.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35323464/3ac7176c52f1b693f0ad919e183ea66e792ccbd7.jpg[/img]

5.	Auction house guidance prices adjustment
Based on the trading data, we have adjusted several guidance prices:
-	Lowered the lower and upper limits of guidance prices of most single equipment parts.
-	Raised the lower and upper limits of the guidance prices of most suit equipment.
-	Raised the guidance prices of rare (blue) blueprints.
-	Raised the upper limit of the guidance prices of some unit equipment.
-	Lowered the guidance prices of Hero Part – Rivet, Hero Part - Silver Powder, Hero Part - Gold Powder.

6.	Hero balances
1)	Nodachi: Dragon’s Leap will not stop moving after hit enemies.
2)	Shortbow: Increased the damage of normal attack by 10% and added a buff of : increasing piercing armor penetration by 3% to dodge passive.
3)	Dualblades: Increased the damage of normal attack by 20%; Increased the damage multiplier of Ambush from 2.65 to 3.; Decreased the CD of Great Thunderblot by 11s for all levels.
4)	Musket: Increased the CD of Scatter Shot by 1s for all levels; Removed the small stun from Liquid Fire.
5)	Shortsword&shield: Decreased the armor from Ironsides: lvl1 80%→75%, lvl2 120%→100%, lvl3 160→125%.
6)	Poleaxe: Increased the CD of Bec de Corbin from 24s for all levels to lvl1 30s, lvl2 28s, lvl3 26s.
7)	Poleaxe: Increased the CD of Pushback from 12s to 15s.
8)	Poleaxe: Decreased the damage multiplier of Poleaxe ultimate from 0,.850 to 0.755 and decreased the extra damage a bit for each level.
9)	Poleaxe: The stun of Grim Harvest has been replaced with reduce blocking.

7.	Unit soul balance
-	Martial - Doggedness Soul
Before:Increases all defense by 50.
After:Increases all defense by 50, increases health by 100.
-	Devotion - Welfare
Before:Increases all defense by 100.
After:Increases all defense by 100, increases health by 150.
-	Rejuvenation Soul
Before:Increases health by 200.
After:Increases health by 160.
-	Rejuvenation Aura Soul
Before:Increases health by 250.
After:Increases health by 200.

8.	UI optimizations:
-	Added the display of the honor progress in the J interface
-	Added the key customization for the button of the Hawk eye. 
-	In order to improve the convenience of the commander's supervision, commander can left mouse clicks on the teammate class icon at the top of the screen to directly switch to the teammate's perspective, so as to more accurately grasp the battlefield dynamics.
-	In order to allow the generals to experience a more realistic battlefield environment, we have enriched the types of random weather in some battlefields, including sunny, cloudy, heavy rain, dense fog, sandstorms, etc., and improved the time when the battlefield was opened, including Day, night, early morning, dusk.
-	Added VO for weapon traning officer in tutorial.
-	When entering the mercenary camp, the camera mode selection has been added. The Warlords can freely choose the “movie camera” or “regular camera” modes.

9.	Bug fixes
-	Fixed the tribute pool of Chao Feng in Borderlands.
-	Fixed a bug where you cannot start pursuit battle after leaving commander mode.
-	Fixed a camera bug in Hawk eye.
-	Fixed several hero skill bugs 
-	Fixed several unit soul bugs

[b]1.Unit supply[/b]

When we start our concept of the game, we always wish to present a real warfare experience in the game. Based on that, we developed the unit kit and supply system. We actually do wish all the Warlords could wisely use their high tier units rather than take them in battlefield without any concerns, as in real war, the commanders are supposed to have the same tactics. However, we do realize the balance between cost and gain is a bit out of our exceptions and it’s becoming a huge burden for all the Warlords. This is actually not exactly what we wish to see. After careful consideration, we did some prices changes of unit kit in this patch.
Besides that, we also optimized the ironman mode by removing unit kit loss, unit death and leadership restrict in this mode. We may open this mode more often to see how the balance goes in this mode and we wish to receive more feedback from all the Warlords.

[b]2. Important update: Player report system[/b]

In order to punish bad game behaviors, like cheating or booting, and to protect the interests of all players, we have added the Player report system in this update:

How to use：
- Outside the battlefield: right click to select the target player, right click on the report button in the pop-up menu in the top middle of the screen, select the reason for reporting and submit.
- Inside the battlefield: open the tab menu, find the target player, right click on the report button, select the reason for reporting and submit.
- You can also add some details in the text box when reporting.

Players with inappropriate behaviors, after investigation, will be warned or even banned and posted on the community announcement accordingly.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35323464/eb3f132e8188dde47592bfee333f92edb050e012.png[/img]
[b]3. Reforging system[/b]

In the former version, the loss of equipment durability is always a problem that brothers a lot of players, now we introduce the reforging system to solve it.

Rules for reforging:
- Only crafted equipment is allowed to be reforged
- Reforge needs the same amount of materials and blueprints
- Reforge will reset the upper limit of durability of the equipment 
- Reforge will give the equipment new random stats but you can always choose to keep the former one if you wish
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35323464/4ff333562ed8b36d9fb42607fdbac31545e00fd9.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35323464/12e1810ed8c94d5d610c2d9941f3df02eaac935c.png[/img]
[b]4. battle supervising system[/b]

A battle supervising system was added in the territory war to inspire the real work of house leaders, vice leaders and commanders. 
Main features：
- The house leaders, vice leaders commanders can watch and instruct the battle through this system by pressing open world map, Hotkey “M”
- The supervisor has the authority to retreat his allies from the battle anytime
- In the battlefield the supervisor can inspire the allies or provoke the enemies by sending system default short messages.
- When supervising the battle, the supervisor could communicate with team via the in-game voice chat system.
- During the battle, for both sides, at most 3 supervisors are allowed to supervise the battle at the same time.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35323464/fc716bc386fdd9a1278a719b71c7609b3657c6b9.png[/img]
[b]5 . New position is added to the House: Military commander[/b]

rights and duty of the Military commander:

- Can use prestige to build open world camps
- Can force retreat house members who are not commanders
- Can do the supervise in territory war.
Slot：4。

[b]6. Territory war with multiple battle lines.[/b]

- Battle lines adjustment of fief：
Village：Stayed as 1 battle line
City：2 battle lines
Fort：3 battle lines

- Winning/losing conditions
Rules for the cities with only one battle line do not change. City with more than one battle line is regarded as conquered if any of the battle lines is conquered.

- Judgement of the ownership:
The ownership of the city is decided on the contribution during the battle. Houses with the highest contribution own the city. When multiple fronts exist, contributions of each battle line will be added and then ranked.

[b]7. leadership now restricts the amounts of units you can carry into the open world.[/b]

[b]8.Open world visual update[/b]

- Added house flag to hero model in open world
- Added unit flag to unit model in open world
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35323464/73fd8460ab3e4e004c2f43c47e0ffd3213d78e70.png[/img] 

[b]9. Honor gain adjustment[/b]

In the last patches, we decreased honor gain after 20 games to narrow the gap between active players and casual players but it turns out not to be a good decision and actually discourages player’s behaviors like playing bots mode in the first 20 games. After carefully reconsideration, we decided to revert that change and replace it as honor cap per week. From this patch, players will not suffer any honor gain decrease after 20 games per day but capped with 20,000 honor gain per week. Our data shows, 90% players honor gain per week is lower than 20,000 honor and we think this change actually won’t affect most of our player base but at least could help us to narrow the gap between the top active players and causal players.  
At the same time, we are planning to add a new mechanism which allows new comers to chase the old players. We will give more details when this system is ready. 

[b]10.Ironman mode adjustment：[/b]

- Removed the leadership restriction but you can only carry 5 units into one game.
- Removed unit kit loss and unit death
- 100% of secret vaults
- Adjusted the honor gain in ironman mode to be the same with normal match-making.

[b]11. Battle points adjustment：[/b]

In current battle points system, a lot of behaviors that are considered actively playing the game will add battle points to give more rewards at the settlement. From the most basic behaviors like killing units/heroes to capturing a point or taking damages. These behaviors have different weights in the final calculations and they do have a cap for each. We should admit this system is still far from perfect and we do listen carefully to the community. We have noticed the weight of taking damage is not rewarded correctly as in today’s patch, we have increased the weight of taking damage with unit/heroes and decreased the weight of dealing damages.

[b]12. Resources collecting system：[/b]

You can continue to collect resources from the place where the resource points already exhausted using the extraction token but the production will be halved.

[b]13.Friend system optimization：[/b]

- After you send a friend request, the receiver can decide on whether to accept or refuse.
- Added a switch to refuse all the friend request. If you turn this switch on, no one could add you to his friend list.
(attention: if player A and B added each other to their friend list they will stay as friends after this update. If A add B to his friend list but B didn’t then B will be cancelled from A’s friend list and waiting for B to accept his friend request) 
 
[b]14.Leadership adjustment：[/b]
For more details, you can check with the link attached: https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/1615023405825270536
1. Reverted default leadership from 350 to 200.
2. Decreased leadership requirement for multiple units.

[b]15. Unit balance：[/b]

1）Prefecture Pikemen: Added 50% more armor penetration to charge skill, and 40% more armor penetration to normal charge. 
2）Sprint: Movement speed increase adjusted from 1.2m/s to 15% movement bonus.
- Vanguard archers: Decreased the Piercing armor penetration by 15 and Piercing damage by 50.
- increased the skill damage by 10% 
- increased the skill’s fire arrow rate by 10%
3）Mercenary Fire Archers: Decreased the Piercing armor penetration by 19 and Piercing damage by 114
- increased the skill penetration by 5% and Piercing damage by 10%.
- Decrease the attack speed of skill by 15% and increased the burning damage by fire arrows by 100 points per second
4） Imperial Archers: Decrease the Piercing damage by 11
5）Dagger-Axe Lancers:
- Increased the Piercing defense by 60, slashing defense by 50
- Decreased the health point by 260 and Piercing damage by 29
6）Prefecture Heavy Cavalry
Added immune to normal attack stagger and all defense increase 100 points when passive actives.
7） Demesne Crossbowmen: Default HP decreased by 324 while increased the hp growth by 32. The full health when you level this unit to maximum will actually be a bit higher than before.
8） Imperial Pike Guards: Increased the CD of push skill from 40s to 50s and decreased the lasting time from 12s to 9s.
9）Decreased the ammo of multiple range units:

[b]16.Unit soul adjustment：[/b]

Firstly, we did some description optimization to make the effects of these souls more readable and clearer for players. Secondly, to balance the system, we disabled the equip of same type of souls on one unit. Last but not the least, we did some rebalance of existing unit souls. For more detailed thoughts for this change, you can check here:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/835570/announcements/detail/1615023405814404022

Disabled the equip of same type of souls on one unit
By saying same type, it means the souls with similar effects but in different rarity. Like common souls increase 55 Piercing damages and uncommon souls increase 70 Piercing damages, they are regarded as same type in this case, as a result, player will not be able to stack both of them on one unit.

For the units which already equipped with same type of souls, we are not planning to do any changes at this update but we probably will deal with them in the future. But we promise that we won’t take back or delete any souls from players.
